job_title: Gauteng Dept of Health: Nursing Traineeship Programme 2027
about_role:
Location: Gauteng
Applicants are invited to apply to the Gauteng College of Nursing to study towards the Diploma in Nursing in 2027 at one of the College campuses: • Ann Latsky Campus • Chris Hani Baragwanath Campus • SG Lourens Campus • Bonalesedi Campus.
To successfully apply and be considered for the training, please take note of the following:
• You are required to register a profile on the system before you can apply.
• Must be a South African citizen, who resides in the Gauteng Province.
• You must be in possession of one of the following school leaving certificates – a Senior Certificate, a National Senior Certificate, currently in Grade 12 or National Vocational Certificate Primary Health
• Applications must be done on the GPG Professional Job Centre system before or on the 26th September;NO late applications will be accepted
• Documents will be uploaded on the system, however you will be required to take supporting documents to the selection centre should you be shortlisted.
• No hand delivered or emailed applications will be accepted, all applications must be done online.
The following subject criteria are required:
• Senior Certificate: English HG D or SG C, Biology HG D or SG C, Mathematics HG D or SG C and an M score of 17
• National Senior Certificate: English Level 4, Life Sciences Level 4, Mathematics Level 4 or Maths Literacy Level 5, and an APS of 27 or more (Life Orientation counts half the score)
• National Vocational Certificate: 50% in Fundamental Subjects (English First Additional Language, Maths/Maths Literacy, Life Orientation) and 60% in the Vocational Subjects (SA Health Care System, Public Health, The Human Body and Mind and Community Oriented Primary Care)
• Current Grade 12 learners must meet the National Senior Certificate requirements in their Grade 11 final results.
COMPETENCIES AND ATTRIBUTES:
Passion for nursing, Problem-solving ability • Patience • Ability to relate to people • Organisational ability • Leadership ability • Flexibility • Calmness during a crisis • Communication, numeracy and life skills • Computer literacy • Study skills • Honesty • Compassionate and caring.
NOTES:
All short-listed applicants will undergo a compulsory psychometric assessment. Successful applicants on psychometric assessment will be required to undergo medical surveillance, including a physical examination and verification of all documentation.
Applicants are required to scan and upload their Senior/National Senior/ National Certificate (Vocational) or statement of Grade 12 results or final Grade 11 results. Candidates can apply via the following link: https://nursingintake.gauteng.gov.za. Completion of all processes during the recruitment and selection process does not guarantee final selection on the programme.
Successful applicants will be required:
• To sign an agreement with the Gauteng Department of Health ,
• Attend lectures. Be prepared to participate in Work Integrated Learning (WIL) which includes shifts and working on public holidays, weekends and nights in Gauteng Department of Health hospitals and clinics as part of the program requirements.
PLEASE NOTE:
• Ensure that you qualify and meet the minimum requirements before you apply you do not receive feedback within 3 months after the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful.

job_title: Cummins: P1 / P2 In-Service Traineeship Programme 2026 / 2027
about_role:
Location: Johannesburg
We are seeking talented students to join our team for a 12-month P1 / P2 programme within our Service, Engineering, and Reliability functions in Johannesburg, South Africa.
The programme develops trainees from foundational learning to practical technical and operational competence in maintenance environments. It incorporates key Reliability and Industrial Engineering principles to enhance efficiency, equipment performance, and productivity, supported by structured training, assessments, and logbook completion to enable a smooth transition to value-adding work.
What the program offers:
• Exposure to both workshop and field service environments
• Gradual development from foundational learning to applied technical capability
• Integration of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering principles
• Hands-on involvement in maintenance, equipment reliability, and performance improvement
• Introduction to workflow optimisation, process efficiency, and continuous improvement
• Supported through formal training, on-the-job learning, mentorship, and structured assessments/logbooks
What you will gain from joining this program:
• Strong technical aptitude and hands-on experience in mechanical systems, tools, inspections, and diagnostic processes.
• Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills for troubleshooting and fault diagnosis.
• High level of safety awareness aligned with health, safety, and environmental standards.
• Key professional strengths including attention to detail, quality focus, teamwork, communication, and continuous learning.
• Apply theoretical knowledge in practical, real-world environments
• Demonstrate safe, compliant, and effective work practices
• Perform maintenance tasks with increasing independence and confidence
• Contribute to operational efficiency, equipment reliability, and successfully complete all assessments/logbooks
To be successful in this role you will need the following:
• Strong willingness to learn, grow, and improve continuously
• Proactive problem-solving mindset with ability to work effectively in teams and engage with technical staff
• High level of attention to detail with commitment to following procedures and maintaining quality standards
• Demonstrates accountability, discipline, reliability, and strong communication skills, including openness to feedback
Education/ Experience
• B-Tech (theory) in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering from a South African university
• Must require and be registered for P1/P2 in-service training to complete qualification
• Strong interest in mechanical systems, maintenance, and field service environments
• Basic technical understanding (advantageous) with a clear commitment to safety, quality, and continuous learning

MAIN PURPOSE OF POSITION:
Manage the allocated debtors’ book by collecting payments on or before they are due and minimizing bad debts by following internal policies and procedures. Establish and maintain excellent relationships with all internal and external parties through constant communication. Work in line with credit legislation. Resolving account-related queries with a matter of urgency and maintaining an elevated level of customer service on all matters related to Accounts Receivable.
Credit Controller Duties and Responsibilities
Banking and Payment Allocations:
• Checking the various bank statements daily to identify payments made for the debtors assigned to the credit controller.
• Capturing the payment receipt on the ERP system.
• Allocating the payment according to the official remittance from the partner or an email from the partner advising which invoices to clear with the specific payment. Payments may NEVER be allocated from the oldest invoices forward UNLESS the credit controller has written confirmation from the Finance manager at the partner’s company.
• Save the payment batch in the specified folder for auditing purposes in line with the payment allocation process.
• If the credit controller has no remittance or instruction email on how to allocate the payment at the time the payment shows on the bank statement, the credit controller must phone and email the partner for the remittance or payment instructions. The credit controller will follow up on the remittance or payment instruction email daily for 2 days, and then the AR Supervisor must request the remittance or payment instruction email from the partner.
• If a remittance or payment instruction email is still not received on day 3 after the payment was received on the account, the credit controller will send a debtor’s aging ledger to the partner, marking which invoices will be cleared with the specific payment, and will then email it to the partner advising that allocation will take place accordingly. Payments allocated in this manner will not be reversed later when a remittance or payment instruction is received.Customer Statements:
• As soon as the Group Credit & AR Manager confirms all statements have been sent after month-end closure, the Credit controller will check System1A daily to ensure that the partners have viewed their statements.
• If the partner has not viewed their statement after the 3rd day, the credit controller will phone and email the partner to confirm the statement link was received and check if it was sent to junk mail or blocked.
• If the partner confirms that the statement has still not been received, the credit controller will resend a statement and ask the partner to confirm receiptInvoices, PODs, Credit notes, and Other Supporting Documents:
• The credit controller must send out Invoices, PODs, Credit notes, and all other supporting documents as and when required by the partner.
• The credit controller must then also educate the partner to use System1A so that they may access any required documents from that system in the future.
Recons:
• The credit controller must have an updated recons with full reasons for non-payment on EVERY account that has queries. This bank reconciliation must be ready and available to be sent to sales, the AR Supervisor, and or the Group Credit and AR Manager as needed.
• Collection process:
• The credit controller must phone each account on their assigned debtors book a minimum of 3 times:
• After the month-end statements are sent to ensure the statement was received and viewed.
• In the middle of the month to ask if there are any queries or issues to address before the month-end payment is due.
• The last week of the month to confirm the amount and date of payment for the payment that is due at the month's end, and to ensure that the payment is made so that it is in our bank on or before the last day of the month.
• It must be made clear to partners that we cannot allow late payments after payments are made.
• The credit controller must pull their age every Monday and work on it for the week by prioritizing the highest and oldest overdue accounts.
• These partners must be contacted once a week until their account is paid for in full
• The credit controller must also contact partners that have unapplied payments (and again remind the partner that this can be viewed on System1A) and or credit notes on their account, and ask the partner to either take back the payment or credits with their next payment or to advise the credit controller how to allocate
• Any unallocated cash (older than 6 months) and unallocated credits (older than 3 months) will be moved off the account.
• The credit controller must ask for the assistance of the sales team when collection efforts have been unsuccessful and ask them to arrange meetings with the partners to discuss the overdue payments, but the credit controller may never expect the salesperson to collect outstanding payments on their behalf.Monthly SPLA Order Process
• After the 8th working day of the new month, a report will be sent to the credit controller (Applicable to credit controllers dealing with Cloud partners) by the Cloud Partner Support team. The Credit controller then must urgently ensure that the following is done before the 15th working day of the new month for the business to release the partner’s SPLA orders:
• Overdue accounts – phone the partner and ask for immediate payment, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account is not paid up to date.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.
• Over-trading accounts - phone the partner and ask for immediate payment to bring their account into credit again, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account does not have sufficient credit limit.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.
• Insufficient credit limit accounts - phone the partner and ask for immediate payment to bring their account into credit limit again, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account does not have sufficient credit limit.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.
• The credit limit must also ask the Vetting team to apply for more cover with CGIC or motivate the Credit Committee to approve an internal lim-it to release the SPLA orders.Reporting On Overdue Accounts:
• The credit controller will receive a weekly Overdue feedback report from the Group Credit and AR Manager, whereby detailed feedback needs to be provided on the TOP 50 Overdue accounts for all the group companies.
• This feedback will be consolidated by the AR Supervisor and sent to the Group Credit and AR Manager no later than COB on Wednesday.Queries:
• The credit controller must log on to all Cloud-related queries as soon as they are identified on the JIRA query system.
• If the query is not resolved within 4 days, the credit controller must escalate to the AR Supervisor to address and must bring to the attention of the Group Credit and AR manager if any large accounts require specialized attention or are in a state of disarray.
• For all other queries, the credit controller must email the relevant product / brand team and copy the sales-person to assist with the resolution of the query. The credit controller must follow the standard escalation process until the query is resolved.
• The credit controller must communicate and provide feedback to the partner regarding the query on a weekly basis until the query is resolved.Adjustments:

About the role
As a Level 3 Support Engineer, you serve as the final escalation point within the technical support structure, responsible for resolving the most complex issues, leading preventative initiatives, and mentoring other engineers. Your core objective is to maintain high availability and reliability across client systems and services while minimizing escalations through a proactive, preventive approach.
Beyond issue resolution, this role requires high-level consulting, project execution, infrastructure management, and cross-department collaboration. You will also play a pivotal role in training and guiding Level 1 and 2 Support Engineers, contributing to service excellence and a learning-oriented support culture.
Why this role matters
In today's IT-driven businesses, operational stability, data integrity, and uptime are paramount. The Level 3 Support Engineer is essential in ensuring these needs are met. You don’t just react to incidents, you prevent them. By resolving deep-rooted technical challenges, mentoring teams, and ensuring compliance and security best practices, you help build confidence with clients and empower your team. Your ability to spot systemic weaknesses and correct them before they escalate directly impacts the quality, trust, and continuity of service.
Key Responsibilities
Advanced Technical Escalations & Incident Resolution
• Act as the final escalation point for complex technical issues from Level 1 and 2 Support Engineers.
• Diagnose and resolve multi-layered issues involving infrastructure, operating systems, cloud platforms, security configurations, and third-party tools.
• Handle priority one incidents (P1s), outages, security concerns, and business-critical failures, applying structured problem-solving methodologies.
• Perform comprehensive root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and document permanent resolutions.
• Interface with vendor escalations (e.g., Microsoft, Mimecast, Veeam) for unresolved third-party issues.
• Step into any incident requiring broad-stack technical understanding, high urgency, or client sensitivity.
• Participate in the after-hours escalation schedule, ensuring round-the-clock support for critical services. Infrastructure, Security & System Health
• Monitor and maintain the health and performance of:
• Windows Server environments (AD, DNS, DHCP, File Services, GPO)
• Azure services (VMs, virtual networks, storage, conditional access, identity)
• Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Compliance)
• Network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, VLANs)
• Ensure system availability through patch management, firmware updates, and system hardening practices.
• Perform backup monitoring, testing, restoration, and remediation using tools such as Datto, Acronis, or Veeam.
• Enforce cybersecurity standards, including MFA, endpoint protection, secure configurations, and data loss prevention.
• Implement, review, and enhance security measures based on threat intelligence and vendor guidance. Proactive Monitoring & Problem Prevention
• Proactively monitor infrastructure through RMM tools and log analysis to identify and correct issues before they impact clients.
• Review service alerts and implement the Remedy, Adjust, Remove approach to fine-tune the alerting system.
• Conduct trend analysis to identify repeat incidents and design system-wide fixes or automated solutions.
• Conduct audits of system configurations, documentation, and procedures to ensure alignment with best practices and compliance standards. Mentorship, Collaboration & Leadership
• Mentor and guide Level 1 and 2 Support Engineers, providing on-the-spot coaching, structured learning sessions, and knowledge reviews.
• Validate and review technical designs, implementation plans, and ticket notes from junior staff for accuracy and completeness.
• Serve as 2IC (second-in-command) in operational planning, workload triage, and technical direction across departments.
• Promote a high-performing support culture, ensuring engineers are empowered and enabled to take ownership of their tickets. Client Support & Relationship Management
• Act as a technical representative of the company, delivering high-touch support during challenging or long-running issues.
• Lead communication during major incidents, keeping clients informed on status, actions taken, and expected resolution timelines.
• Represent the support team during project transitions or professional service handovers.
• Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with clients by demonstrating technical authority and consistency. Project & Change Implementation
• Participate in or lead infrastructure upgrade projects, cloud migrations, hybrid deployments, and IT rollouts.
• Oversee the planning, execution, and post-implementation reviews of changes to ensure minimal client impact.
• Assist in provisioning tasks for new users, systems, and sites during onboarding or project delivery.
• Conduct validation testing and change control documentation in alignment with change management procedures. Documentation, SOPs & Knowledge Management
• Create, maintain, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for complex or critical tasks.
• Contribute to an internal knowledge base (e.g., IT Glue) by documenting issue resolutions, configuration templates, and troubleshooting workflows.
• Ensure all ticket notes and time entries in PSA (e.g., Autotask) are timely, accurate, and useful for historical reference.
• Translate real-world incidents into future training topics or documentation improvements. Process Improvement & Innovation
• Continuously review support processes, technical workflows, and service delivery standards to identify areas for improvement.
• Recommend or implement automation via PowerShell scripting or tool integrations.
• Participate in quarterly service reviews or retrospectives to propose systemic changes to reduce friction or improve resolution times.
• Collaborate with management and other teams to suggest technology upgrades, tool adoption, or workflow redesigns. Cross Departmental and Third-Party Collaboration
• Coordinate with Professional Services, NOC, and Security teams to ensure cohesive execution of shared responsibilities.
• Liaise with third-party vendors (e.g., ISPs, telephony, hosting providers) to escalate or resolve issues affecting service delivery.
• Represent the support team in internal meetings on process alignment, service enhancements, or technical escalations.
• Provide subject matter expertise (SME) in audits, pre-sales consultations, or client onboarding workshops as needed.

Lead engineering operations, project execution, and product development in offshore drilling risers, associated well control equipment, and proprietary engineering systems.
About Our Client
The company works with offshore drilling risers, associated well control equipment, and proprietary engineering systems. It executes projects involving design, manufacturing, maintenance, and repair of capital drilling equipment.
The Role: Senior Mechanical Engineer
This role exists to lead engineering operations, project execution, and product development while fast-tracking immersion into subsea and well control equipment. The main focus areas encompass in-house engineering and development, managing projects from inception to delivery, mentoring junior engineers, and ensuring operational quality and safety.
Key Responsibilities
• Bring a minimum of 6 to 8 years of experience in a relatable engineering environment, including at least 3 years in a relevant mid-level engineering position within heavy engineering, offshore, oil and gas, or subsea sectors.
• Conduct strength calculations from first principles and perform FEA/Simulation when required.
• Perform 3D CAD modeling and drafting using SolidWorks.
• Generate complete manufacturing data packs, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), Quality Control Plans (QCPs), Work Instructions, and Manuals.
• Manage maintenance, repair, design, and manufacturing projects from inception to delivery, including procurement, logistics, resource planning, scheduling, and data book generation.
• Mentor junior mechanical engineers and technicians, review engineering deliverables, draft new procedures, and initiate corrective actions.
• Manage vendors during the fabrication stage and oversee manufacturing, quality control, and closeout.
• Shadow team members and physically participate in inspection and maintenance processes to build operational understanding of capital drilling equipment.
About You
• Minimum of 6 to 8 years of experience in a relatable engineering environment.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in a relevant mid-level engineering position.
• Experience in the Heavy Engineering/Offshore, Oil and Gas, and Subsea sector.
• Mechanical Engineering Degree.
• Registration as a Professional Engineer (PrEng).
• Sound understanding of 3D CAD software (SolidWorks) and FEA software (SolidWorks Simulation).
• Sound understanding of manufacturing processes including fabrication, boilermaking/welding, and precision machining.
• Advanced knowledge of MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Teams).
• Strong interest in design.
• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with organizational, planning, time-management, and personnel management capabilities.
• Strong engineering theory, design expertise, project management experience, and a high safety ethic.

Description
The Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting high-quality software solutions across the full technology stack, including user interfaces, backend services, APIs, databases, and cloud-based infrastructure. Working closely with senior team members, product stakeholders, and cross-functional stakeholders, the role focuses on delivering well-defined product features that are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business requirements.
This role requires a developer who is comfortable taking ownership of scoped work from implementation through testing, review, and deployment while collaborating effectively with the broader engineering team. The successful candidate will contribute to technical excellence through adherence to software engineering best practices, automated testing, secure coding principles, and continuous improvement.
Why This Role Matters
The Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer plays a critical role in transforming business requirements into reliable, scalable software solutions that deliver value to customers. By contributing across the frontend, backend, API, and database layers, this role ensures that product features are developed efficiently while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and maintainability. Through collaboration with senior team members and product stakeholders, the role helps accelerate product delivery, improve platform stability, and support the long-term evolution of the organisation's technology ecosystem. This position also strengthens engineering capability by contributing to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance development practices across the team.
Key Responsibilities
1. Full-Stack Software Development
• Design, develop and maintain application features across frontend, backend, APIs, workers and databases.
• Deliver production-ready functionality using modern software engineering practices.
• Take ownership of assigned features from development through deployment.
• Ensure software meets functional and technical specifications.
• Produce maintainable, scalable and well-structured code. 2. Frontend Development
• Develop responsive user interfaces using React and Next.js.
• Build accessible and user-friendly web applications.
• Implement reusable UI components and layouts.
• Optimise application performance and responsiveness.
• Ensure consistent user experiences across supported browsers. 3. Backend & API Development
• Develop backend services using TypeScript and Node.js technologies.
• Build validated RESTful APIs using Hono, Zod and OpenAPI.
• Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms.
• Apply consistent client-scoping and access control principles.
• Develop integrations with third-party systems and SaaS platforms. 4. Database Design & Data Management
• Create and maintain PostgreSQL database schemas.
• Develop efficient database queries and stored logic where required.
• Design and execute database migrations.
• Implement constraints and row-level security.
• Ensure data integrity, performance and scalability. 5. Application Security & Compliance
• Apply secure coding principles throughout development.
• Implement authentication, authorization and audit capabilities.
• Validate user inputs and protect against common security vulnerabilities.
• Support compliance with POPIA and applicable data protection standards.
• Handle sensitive data with care and professionalism. 6. Testing & Quality Assurance
• Develop unit, integration, contract and browser-based automated tests.
• Participate in Test-Driven Development (TDD) and specification-driven development.
• Verify AI-assisted generated code before implementation.
• Resolve defects identified during testing.
• Maintain high standards of software quality. 7. System Integration & Cloud Technologies
• Develop integrations with external APIs and cloud services.
• Implement asynchronous processing and messaging workflows.
• Support Azure Container Apps and cloud-native deployments.
• Contribute to Infrastructure-as-Code implementations using Bicep and Terraform.
• Assist in maintaining reliable CI/CD pipelines. 8. Defect Resolution & Production Support
• Investigate issues across frontend, backend, database and worker services.
• Troubleshoot production incidents with senior team support.
• Participate in software releases and deployment activities.
• Monitor application behaviour and recommend improvements.
• Contribute to operational stability and system reliability. 9. Collaboration & Agile Delivery
• Work closely with product owners to clarify business requirements.
• Break work into manageable delivery increments.
• Participate in sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
• Collaborate effectively with senior developers and peers.
• Seek guidance when architectural or security decisions require escalation. 10. Code Quality & Continuous Improvement
• Participate in peer code reviews.
• Provide constructive feedback during development reviews.
• Follow established coding standards and architectural guidelines.
• Maintain clear technical documentation and operational runbooks.
• Identify opportunities to improve development practices and engineering processes. 11. Technical Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
• Produce accurate technical documentation.
• Maintain operational runbooks.
• Document implementation decisions and design considerations.
• Share technical knowledge with team members.
• Contribute to continuous learning within the engineering team. 12. Professional Development
• Stay current with emerging development technologies.
• Continuously improve technical capabilities.
• Learn new frameworks and tools where required.
• Develop broader understanding of business processes.
• Demonstrate initiative in expanding technical expertise.

job_title: Paarl Code A 150cc Motorbike Delivery Driver
about_role:
Paarl Code A 150cc Motorbike Delivery Driver
Are you a reliable and experienced rider with an excellent eye for detail? A well-established automotive logistics operation is looking for a dependable Code A Motorbike Delivery Driver to join their dynamic team for a full-time position.
If you take pride in road safety, possess great riding skills, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this is your opportunity to ensure seamless, safe, and on-time parts distribution to workshops and clients.
What’s on Offer?
- Salary: R7,845.00 Gross PM
- Status: Permanent following a successful 3-month probation period
- Benefits (Post-Probation): MICFA Provident Fund (7.5% employee / 8% employer contribution) + Prorated December Annual Bonus
- Leave: 18 days paid annual leave per annum
- Hours: Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00 | Sat 08:00–13:00 (Overtime paid per MIBCO regulations)
Key Responsibilities
- Order Dispatch & Delivery: Safely transport and deliver automotive parts and components to workshops and clients within designated areas.
- Route Planning & Efficiency: Plan delivery routes effectively to ensure timely distribution while maintaining fuel efficiency and road safety.
- Verification & Documentation: Double-check delivery items against invoices/delivery notes before departure and obtain proper customer signoffs.
- Vehicle Maintenance & Care: Conduct daily pre-trip inspections of the company motorbike (oil, tyres, brakes) and keep the vehicle clean.
- Logistics Support: Assist the warehouse team with loading, securing cargo, and sorting delivery batches when not out on the road.
Are You the Perfect Fit?
Minimum Requirements & Legal Qualifications:
- Licencing: Valid, unendorsed South African CODE A DRIVER'S LICENCE IS STRICTLY REQUIRED.
- Essential Experience: Previous commercial motorbike delivery or courier experience in any industry is strictly required (automotive or logistics sector experience is a distinct advantage).
- Skills & Education: Matric certificate (highly advantageous), basic computer literacy, and the ability to navigate routes efficiently using maps or GPS.
- Track Record: High reliability, punctuality, strong road safety awareness, and a stable history with contactable references.
Strict Legal Requirements & Assessments (Non-Negotiable):
Background screening will be conducted. Candidates must have:
- South African-born Citizenship (with valid SA ID).
- Clear criminal record (under no circumstances will candidates with a record be considered).
- Ability to undergo a psychometric/personality assessment during the interview stage.
How to Apply
Ready to drive your career forward? Ensure you have the following documentation ready:
- Detailed CV (with contactable references clearly showing your motorbike delivery history).
- Licence Copy (Clear copy of your valid Code A licence).
- ID Copy (Proof of SA-born citizenship).
- Matric Certificate / Qualifications.
Apply Now: Visit https://www.easternpersonnel.co.za/ and click on Register CV.
Please Note: Only shortlisted candidates who meet all requirements, will be contacted. If you do not hear back within two weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful. Eastern Personnel is fully POPIA compliant, and all personal information will be processed securely and solely for recruitment purposes.

About the Role
The Product Manager: Managed AI Services is responsible for owning, developing and continuously enhancing Numata's Managed AI Services portfolio as a commercially successful recurring managed service. This role exists to ensure that Numata does not simply resell AI platforms but delivers a differentiated managed service that enables clients to continuously realise business value from Artificial Intelligence. The Product Manager serves as the custodian of the product strategy, roadmap, commercial performance, client adoption, vendor relationships, marketing alignment and service evolution.
The role acts as the central point of coordination between Sales, Marketing, Client Experience, Professional Services, Managed Services, Finance and Technology Partners to ensure one cohesive product experience for both clients and internal stakeholders. This position establishes Numata's Product Management capability and will become the blueprint for future Product Management disciplines across additional strategic service portfolios
Why this Role Matters
Artificial Intelligence is transforming the way organisations operate, with new models, capabilities and business applications emerging at an unprecedented pace. As Numata expands its Managed AI Services portfolio, it is essential that the organisation does more than simply provide access to AI technologies, it must deliver a differentiated, continuously evolving managed service that enables clients to realise measurable business value. Without dedicated product ownership, advancements in AI platforms may not be translated into meaningful client outcomes, resulting in inconsistent product messaging, limited client adoption, outdated marketing, missed sales opportunities and reduced customer engagement. Over time, this creates a significant risk to client retention, recurring revenue and Numata's competitive position in the market.
The Product Manager: Managed AI Services plays a pivotal role in ensuring that the Managed AI portfolio remains commercially successful, strategically aligned and focused on delivering exceptional customer value. This role is responsible for connecting technology innovation with business outcomes by translating vendor developments into compelling service enhancements, client communications, go-to-market initiatives, sales enablement, training and measurable value realisation. Acting as the central point of coordination across Sales, Marketing, Client Experience, Professional Services, Finance and Technology Partners, the Product Manager ensures that all stakeholders work together to deliver one coherent and consistently improving product experience.
As Numata's first dedicated Product Manager, this position also establishes the organisation's Product Management discipline and provides the framework for future product leadership across other strategic service portfolios. Through strong commercial judgement, structured product management and cross-functional leadership, the role will drive client adoption, improve retention, increase recurring revenue, identify expansion opportunities and strengthen Numata's position as a trusted Business Technology Strategist and leader in managed AI services

To deliver quality products and services with speed and accuracy through test analysis, test design & test execution through defined processes by the use of automated testing. Output 1: REQUIREMENTS ANALYSIS

• Test evidence/results are stored as proof of testing, required for audit purposes as well.

• Manage the defect lifecycle from inception to closure.

• Provide mitigation and/or solutioning as and when possible. Output 7: TEST CLOSURE
• Ensure all test artifacts are in place for good governance and audit purposes.
• Test cases in correct and up to date statuses/results with attached test evidence on ADO.
• QA signoff certificate to accompany all tested changes, to be used as an artifact for CAB Output 8: RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT AND ATTITUDE

• Suggest innovative ways of doing/executing job responsibilities.

• Actively contribute to cost containment efforts by identifying opportunities for operational efficiencies, optimising resources, and ensuring value-driven decision making in daily activities.

Millwright-Cape Winelands
Looking for a trade-tested Millwright to maintain, fault-find, repair and continuously improve the mechanical and electrical equipment throughout our MegaPlant.
This is a hands-on factory-floor role for someone highly efficient, technically proficient, dependable and able to work independently.
We are looking for an artisan who finds the root cause of failures, not someone who simply replaces failed components
Requirments:
• Trade Test Millwright 5–10+ years relevant post-trade experience
• Industrial/Manufacturing maintenance experience.
• Strong mechanical and electrical fault-finding ability.
• Able to work efficiently with minimal supervision.
• Able to read mechanical and electrical drawings.
• Strong practical problem-solving ability.
• High standard of workmanship and safety.
• Comfortable working in a heavy industrial factory environment.
Strong experience with:
• Motors, gearboxes, bearings and couplings.
• Shaft, pulley and drive alignment.
• Conveyors, belts, chains and sprockets.
• Crushers, screens, mixers and production machinery.
• Pumps, fans and rotating equipment.
• Hydraulics and pneumatics.
• Fabrication and welding.
• Three-phase electrical systems.
• MCCs, contactors and overloads.
• Variable Speed Drives (VSDs).
• Sensors, limit switches and interlocks.
• Basic PLC fault finding and PLC I/O.
• Automated production equipment.
Key Responsibilities
• Respond rapidly and efficiently to production breakdowns.
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, control and process-related faults.
• Identify and correct the root cause of failures.
• Carry out preventative and planned maintenance.
• Inspect machinery proactively and identify developing problems.
• Ensure correct bearing installation, alignment, lubrication and equipment mounting.
• Test equipment properly before returning it to production.
• Record significant failures and corrective actions.
• Identify critical spare-part requirements.
• Support shutdowns and major maintenance work.
Continuous Improvement
• Our Millwrights are expected to improve the factory, not simply maintain it.
• They should actively identify opportunities to:
• Reduce repetitive breakdowns.
• Increase plant availability and production throughput.
• Reduce maintenance costs.
• Improve equipment reliability.
• Improve electrical and mechanical efficiency.
• Reduce unnecessary motor loading and power consumption.
• Improve guarding, safety and maintainability.
• Improve sensors, controls and automation.

The Branch Manager is responsible for the overall management and performance of the branch, ensuring the achievement of sales and profitability targets while delivering excellent customer service.
The role oversees all home textile categories, including bedding, linen, towels, curtains, décor and related products. The Branch Manager is responsible for managing staff, stock, merchandising, customer relationships, operational standards and compliance.

job_title: Head of Amazon Advertising & Performance Marketing
about_role:
Head of Amazon Advertising & Performance Marketing
Location: Remote (Preference for Western / Western-aligned time zones)
Type: Full-Time
Reports to: CEO
Compensation: Top-decile base + aggressive profit-based upside
The Role – In One Sentence
You are the money engine on Amazon.
You own every dollar that comes in the door through Amazon PPC/DSP and retail media — and you know exactly how to turn ad spend into profitable, compounding growth. No excuses, no "seasonality," no "the algorithm changed."
Amazon is your home field. Other channels are tools you wield to support it.
First 90 Days – Non-Negotiable Outcomes
If this doesn't excite you as a challenge, this isn't your role.
• Full Amazon Audit – Nothing Unchecked
• Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, DSP
• Campaign structure, keyword targeting, audience segmentation, placements
• Listing quality: titles, bullets, images, A+ content, reviews, pricing, bundles
Result: full teardown with clear kill/scale/rebuild plan.
• New Testing Machine Live (Amazon-First)
• Minimum 20 new tests/week across: keywords, bids, creatives, angles, funnels, audiences
• Systematic framework for A/B testing and rapid iteration
• Clear "what we test / why we test / how we decide" playbook
• Amazon Profitability Benchmarks Hit or Clearly Tracked Toward
• Target TACoS, ACOS, and blended ROAS defined and tracked
• Path to 3.5x+ blended ROAS across Amazon
• $50k+/month in controlled, profitable ad spend (or ready to scale to that level sustainably)
• Founder Independence
• Zero reliance on the CEO for copy, angles, hooks, or approvals
• You bring the ideas, tests, and decisions — Founder stays in vision and product, not ads. What You Own
You are Head of Amazon Ads, but you understand the whole growth ecosystem.
Amazon – Your Core Battlefield
• Amazon PPC: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display
• Keyword research, search term mining, and negative keyword strategy
• Campaign architecture (structure for scale, not chaos)
• Bid strategies (down-only, up/down, fixed bids, placement adjustments)
• TACoS/ACOS optimization and margin protection
• Launch strategy for new products, variants, and bundles Conversion & Creative
• Listing optimization: titles, bullets, imagery, A+ content, brand store
• Review strategy, social proof, and UGC alignment with Amazon page assets
• Creative strategy for Amazon ads (thumbnails, video, lifestyle, comparison ads)
• Angle and hook testing: performance-driven storytelling specifically for Amazon shoppers Cross-Channel Support (Performance Marketing)
• Using TikTok selectively where they support Amazon growth
• LTV/CAC modeling across channels with Amazon as the core revenue driver Measurement & Economics
• LTV/CAC and payback windows on Amazon-first journeys
• Blended ROAS across Amazon and supporting channels
• Reporting that the CEO can scan in 5 minutes and know exactly what's working You don't just "run ads." You design the acquisition system that scales profitably.
Mandatory Prerequisites – No Exceptions
We will check. This is not a "figure it out as you go" seat.
• You have personally scaled Amazon advertising profitably for a CPG/supplement or similar product brand.
• Not agency "I advised" fluff. Actual ownership of P&L outcomes.
• You can point to real brands, real spend, real results.
• You have taken a brand from weak returns (under 2x ROAS / unprofitable TACoS) to strong performance (4x+ ROAS or materially improved TACoS) in under 6–9 months.
• Before/after numbers and what you changed.
• You still run accounts yourself.
• No "I just manage the team now" distance.
• You're in the platforms, making decisions, and testing ideas.
• You can look at a search term report, listing, or ad creative and have a strong POV in under 30 seconds.
• Pattern recognition from heavy reps, not vibes. How You'll Be Judged
This is a scoreboard role. You will live and die by the numbers:
• Blended ROAS across Amazon and supporting channels
• Amazon TACoS and ACOS by product line
• New customer CAC (Amazon-first and blended)
• Margin after ad spend (not just top-line hero screenshots)
• Speed of learning – a new winning angle or structure every 7–14 days If you need "more time" and "more budget" before you can show results, this will be a painful role. If you love moving fast and pressure-testing your ideas, you'll thrive.
How to Apply
Send your CV + a short Loom video.
In your Loom (5–7 minutes), answer:
• Biggest Amazon (or Amazon-led) turnaround you've ever led — what was the monthly spend, TACoS/ROAS before vs. after, and what levers you pulled.
• Current training routine + proof you live it — show us how you train, compete, or otherwise live the athlete lifestyle.
• One Amazon angle, structure, or campaign strategy you'd test for a fast-growing supplement/CPG brand tomorrow — and why. This is not a "VP of Marketing" vanity title.
This is the Head of Amazon Growth in a brand that intends to dominate its category and expects its acquisition leader to think — and operate — like an owner.
Apply only if you're ready to own the numbers end to end.
I also swapped the × symbols for plain x, since those are the next most likely thing a form chokes on.

Role Purpose
Our client is seeking a passionate and self-motivated Internal Appliance Technician to join their technical team in Cape Town. The successful candidate will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and resolving technical faults on household appliances, while providing high-quality technical support and service to internal and external customers.
The role requires strong electrical fault-finding capabilities, customer service skills, and the ability to work with electronic, microprocessor-controlled, and IoT-enabled appliance systems.
Key Responsibilities
Appliance Repair & Technical Support
• Diagnose and repair household appliances by analysing electrical circuitry and applying effective fault-finding and testing techniques.
• Accurately identify faults and implement appropriate repairs on appliances.
• Provide knowledgeable, professional, and courteous technical service to customers.
• Ensure customer needs are correctly addressed and faulty products are accurately assessed and resolved.
• Provide technical support for customer-related queries and service requirements.
• Assist with urgent technical matters outside normal working hours and on weekends when required.
Service Administration & Call Management
• Complete all required administration throughout the service process.
• Monitor and resolve open service calls and follow up on outstanding spare parts.
• Ensure service calls are progressed and closed efficiently.
• Assist with resolving regional service calls and technical queries.
• Maintain accurate records relating to repairs, service calls, and technical interventions.
Technical Training & Stakeholder Support
• Train call centre staff on fault diagnosis and accurate fault descriptions for job cards.
• Provide technical and installation training to contractors and installers.
• Assist contractors and installers with technical queries and troubleshooting.
• Communicate with international technical teams regarding local product failures where required.
Parts & Stock Management
• Ensure all returned stock is repaired, assessed, and graded appropriately for B-stock sales within the required timeframe.
• Assist the Spare Parts division with technical requirements when needed.
Continuous Improvement & Performance
• Identify opportunities to improve business performance and enhance the customer experience.
• Contribute to initiatives aimed at reducing service costs.
• Work towards achieving divisional and company KPIs.
• Perform additional technical and operational duties as required.

About Wholechain
Wholechain is a supply chain traceability platform that makes product journeys transparent,
helping responsible businesses meet regulatory, customer, and sustainability expectations. Built
on global data standards such as GS1 and GDST, Wholechain supports complex,
multi-commodity supply chains across food, agriculture, and consumer goods industries. The
platform enables interoperable, event-based, and lot-level traceability across suppliers,
processors, distributors, logistics providers, retailers, foodservice operators, and certification
bodies worldwide.
Wholechain helps organizations capture, share, and validate critical supply chain data across
sourcing, transformation, shipping, receiving, and production events. By creating a connected
digital chain of custody, businesses can improve food safety, strengthen recall readiness, verify
sourcing claims, meet ESG and sustainability goals, and comply with evolving regulatory
frameworks such as FDA FSMA 204 and international traceability requirements.
The platform is designed for enterprise scalability and integration, supporting APIs, EDI

ecosystems. Wholechain works closely with industry groups, standards organizations, seafood
and agriculture partners, retailers, and global suppliers to simplify traceability adoption without
requiring all participants to use the same internal systems.
In addition to regulatory compliance, Wholechain enables businesses to build trust and
operational visibility throughout their supply networks. Customers use the platform to manage
traceability programs, verify certified products, monitor supply chain integrity, support
responsible sourcing initiatives, and provide transparent product histories to downstream buyers
and consumers.

The Civil Engineer provides oversight of civil infrastructure across the 128-site South Africa portfolio. The position is responsible for the structural integrity, inspection, maintenance planning, and standards compliance of all civil works — elevated reinforced-concrete reservoirs, tank towers, distribution networks, standpipes, pump houses, borehole chambers, cattle troughs, and solar frame structures — and for coordinating specialist chartered engineering inspections of high-capacity 30-kilolitre tank-class infrastructure in accordance with applicable SANS standards.
The role is central to the Year 1 technical condition assessment of all 128 sites, the site-tier triage (A/B/C), the remediation of named Tier C sites, and the drawdown planning of the Replacement Capex Reserve for civil components.
3. Key Responsibilities
3.1 Technical condition assessment and site-tier triage (Year 1)
• Lead the civil and structural component of the site-by-site technical condition assessment across all 128 South African sites within the first three months of the programme (Stream B of the Day 1 transition), covering tanks, towers, distribution networks, valves and fittings, pump houses, and civil structures.
• Contribute civil condition data to the site-tier triage (Tier A/B/C) to be confirmed by Month 3 and identify civil components requiring Day 1 or Year 1 replacement funded from the Replacement Capex Reserve.
• Support full condition assessment and Tier C remediation at the named priority sites, including Jabulani and the five untested Mpumalanga sites (Igliton Hotel Section, Igliton Mdluli Section, Mihlanguleni, Rhandzekile A, Rhandzekile B), under the 48-hour remediation initiation protocol.
• Verify and reconcile the civil elements of the Innovation: Africa handover package, including as-built and structural drawings (3m, 7m, and 10m tank towers; the 30-kilolitre high-capacity tank class), borehole completion reports, and site asset registers.3.2 Routine civil inspection and maintenance oversight (Years 1-3)
• Design and implement the routine structural inspection cycle for civil infrastructure across the portfolio, integrated into the Tier 2 quarterly inspection programme (structural inspection of concrete towers, reservoirs, and distribution infrastructure).
• Procure, scope, and supervise specialist-chartered engineering inspections of 30-kilolitre reinforced-concrete tanks in compliance with applicable SANS standards, managing the specialist sub-contract and certifying deliverables.
• Develop civil maintenance specifications, bills of quantities, and scopes of work for repairs, rehabilitation, and upgrades; supervise contractors and certify completed works.
• Assess and prioritise Parent-site civil infrastructure within the cluster maintenance model, recognising that a Parent borehole failure cascades to hydraulically dependent Child sites (56 Child sites in South Africa).
• Support reactive repair response for civil failures in line with the tiered service-impact protocol (critical failures within 48 hours; reduced-service issues within five working days).3.3 Standards compliance, quality assurance and reporting
• Ensure all civil works, inspections, and rehabilitation comply with applicable SANS standards and relevant national and municipal regulations, and that water infrastructure supports compliance with SANS 241:2015 water quality requirements.
• Maintain the civil asset register, structural inspection records, drawings library, and defect logs within the programme's field management system.
• Contribute civil infrastructure data and analysis to monthly cluster reports, quarterly donor reports to Donor, and the MEAL dashboard (KPI Categories 1 and 2: sustained service delivery and technical compliance).
• Support the DMEAL team with means-of-verification documentation for infrastructure-related KPIs.3.4 Capacity building and transition
• Train ForAfrika field engineers, community pump attendants, and Water Management Committee members in basic civil infrastructure surveillance (visual inspection of tanks, towers, standpipes, and soakaways) as part of the Tier 1 community operator curriculum.
• Contribute civil O&M content to site-level O&M manuals, sustainability plans, and handover documentation supporting the Year 3 transition to community and Water Services Authority management.
• Advise on civil aspects of Capital Sinking Fund calibration, aligning contribution rates to civil component lifecycles (10/20-year classes).3.5 Stakeholder engagement
• Liaise with the Department of Water and Sanitation (DWS), provincial Water Services Authorities (Ehlanzeni DM, Greater Tzaneen, Makhado, uMkhanyakude DM), and municipal engineers on infrastructure standards, co-maintenance arrangements, and cost-sharing Service Level Agreement negotiations.
• Coordinate with DWS-listed certified solar technical partners and Mvula Borehole Drilling (Pty) Ltd to ensure integrated electromechanical and civil maintenance delivery.
• Represent ForAfrika in technical forums and site meetings with government, communities, and Innovation: Africa counterparts during the transition period.
4. Qualifications and Experience
Essential
• Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering (BEng/BSc Eng) from a recognised institution.
• Registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Candidate Engineer, with Professional Engineer (Pr Eng) or Professional Engineering Technologist (Pr Tech Eng) registration strongly preferred.
• Minimum five (5) years of progressive experience in civil/structural engineering for water supply infrastructure — reservoirs, elevated tanks, pipelines, and rural water schemes.
• Demonstrated working knowledge of SANS standards applicable to water infrastructure (including SANS 241:2015 and structural/civil codes for reinforced-concrete water-retaining structures).
• Proven experience in condition assessment, structural inspection, and rehabilitation of water-retaining structures.
• Experience preparing scopes of work, bills of quantities, and supervising contractors.
• Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel extensively (up to 60%) to remote rural sites across three provinces.Desirable
• MSc/MEng in Civil, Structural, or Water Engineering.
• Experience in the NGO/development sector or donor-funded WASH programmes.
• Familiarity with solar-powered water systems, borehole infrastructure, and rural water utility operations.
• Experience engaging municipal Water Services Authorities and DWS regulatory frameworks (Water Services Act, including Section 19 Water Service Intermediary arrangements).
• Proficiency in AutoCAD/Civil 3D, EPANET or equivalent hydraulic modelling tools, and GIS applications.
• Proficiency in one or more of IsiZulu, Sepedi, or Siswati is an advantage.

job_title: Senior Substation Primary Plant Design Engineer
about_role:
Our client is seeking a highly experienced Senior Substation Primary Plant Design Engineer to lead the delivery of complex transmission and distribution substation projects. This opportunity is ideal for a technically accomplished engineer with extensive experience in high-voltage substation design, strong leadership capabilities, and a proven track record delivering projects up to 400kV. Experience on 765kV projects will be highly advantageous.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead the preliminary, conceptual, detailed design, and construction support for high-voltage substation projects.
• Prepare and review conceptual designs, technical specifications, bills of quantities, and tender documentation.
• Develop detailed primary plant designs for transmission and distribution substations.
• Review contractor designs and ensure compliance with project specifications and applicable standards.
• Provide technical leadership throughout project execution, construction support, testing, and commissioning.
• Participate in design reviews, FATs, SATs, site inspections, and commissioning activities.
• Prepare technical reports, engineering calculations, project methodologies, schedules, and budgets.
• Liaise with clients, contractors, utilities, and multidisciplinary engineering teams.
• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the ongoing development of the engineering team.
• Ensure compliance with SHEQ requirements and industry best practices.
Minimum Requirements
• BSc or BEng in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
• Professional registration with ECSA or an internationally recognised engineering institution.
• Minimum of 15 years' experience in substation design within transmission and distribution environments.
• Extensive experience delivering detailed substation primary plant designs up to 400kV.
• Experience on 765kV substation projects will be highly advantageous.
• Strong knowledge of Eskom standards, IEC, IEEE, NRS, and SANS requirements.
• Experience working within utilities, EPC contractors, or engineering consulting environments.
Advantageous Experience
• Exposure to renewable energy grid connection projects.
• Proficiency with engineering software such as AutoCAD, EPLAN, DigSilent, ETAP, PowerFactory, or PSSE.
• Strong understanding of transmission infrastructure and high-voltage engineering.
Key Competencies
• Excellent technical leadership and engineering judgement.
• Strong client relationship management and communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple projects within demanding schedules.
• Commitment to quality, safety, and engineering excellence.

🚀 We're Hiring: Assistant Accountant
📍 Location: Johannesburg
📊 Reporting Line: Financial Reporting Manager
💼 Function: Finance — Assistant Accountant
💼 Job Purpose
To administer the Lesaka POS rental billing and collections cycle, support general accounting activities, and perform assigned SOX compliance controls. The role ensures accurate rental records, secure processing of merchant information, reliable accounting support and complete audit evidence.
🔍 Key Responsibility Areas
💰 Rentals
• Prepare monthly rental debit-order upload files by extracting, cleansing and validating CRM data.
• Capture monthly and recurring rental invoices.
• Verify banking details, signed mandates, accepted terms and applicable grace periods before processing.
• Process, capture and match collected debit orders to debtor accounts and accounting records.
• Maintain the Master Rental File as the accurate record of active agreements, changes, new management and decommissioned outlets.
• Process threshold exclusions and ensure only eligible merchants are included in rental pay runs.
• Coordinate payment reminders, rental queries and collections activity with merchants, internal teams and third-party collection agents.
• Process bad-debt write-offs relating to incorrect banking details and decommissioned outlets in accordance with approved procedures.
• Calculate and record doubtful-debt provisions for failed debit orders.

job_title: Regional Marketing Specialist – Africa (English & French Markets)
about_role:
Regional Marketing Specialist – Africa (English & French Markets)
Main Responsibilities – Regional Activation & Market Execution
The Regional Marketing Specialist Africa is responsible for the regional activation of the company's marketing strategy, ensuring marketing activities contribute to funnel generation, brand visibility, and the roll-out of regional marketing deliverables in line with agreed strategy and budgets.
The successful candidate must have native-level English proficiency.
The Africa office is located in Umhlanga, South Africa. Office presence is required (minimum 2 days per week). Occasional travel across Africa for events, meetings and visits to the Casablanca office in Morocco is also required. The role reports to the Head of Marketing and Communications EMEA.
The Regional Marketing Specialist Africa comprises of 4 main areas:
1. Event Management
End-to-end planning, coordination, and execution of regional events aligned with the company's marketing strategy and commercial priorities.
This includes:
- Trade shows and exhibitions
- Industry seminars and technical events
- Company-hosted customer and industry events
- Distributor and partner events in company offices or at partner sites
- Technical webinars (native or in cooperation with partners)
Responsibilities include management and delivery of the event KPIs, coordination with internal stakeholders and/or partners, brand messaging, and post-event reporting to ensure activities contribute to the region's sales opportunity funnel.
2. Channel Partner Marketing (Co-op Programmes)
Generation, activation, monitoring and analysis of marketing activities executed jointly with channel partners and distributors. These initiatives may include:
- Sponsorships
- Co-exhibiting at events
- Visibility on partner websites or platforms
- Co-branded literature and promotional assets
- Videos and webinars
- Media packs
- Promotional merchandising
- Other co-op marketing initiatives agreed with partners
The role ensures partner activities align with regional strategy and channel needs, acting as a liaison with partners and distributors to support funnel KPIs.
3. Regional Market Activation
Localisation and activation of central marketing campaigns within the region's markets, as well as development and execution of targeted regional initiatives. This includes:
- Activation of global or central marketing campaigns in the region

The ideal candidate is someone who understands apparel and footwear retail, enjoys working with stock and data, and can turn information into practical action.
This person must not only be able to pull reports, but must also understand what the numbers mean, why stock issues happen, and how to solve them. They must understand the mechanics of inventory planning from the ground up and be able to follow through from planning, to communication, to execution.
The right candidate will be structured, analytical, practical, and hands-on, with a strong ability to solve problems and improve how stock flows through the business.
Job Purpose
The Apparel Inventory Planner is responsible for ensuring that the right products are available in the right stores, in the right quantities, at the right time.
This role manages stock planning, replenishment, allocations, size curves, transfers, stock balancing, and inventory reporting across retail stores, online channels, and warehouse locations.
The role requires someone who understands inventory planning from the ground up — not only the reporting side, but also the working mechanics behind stock movement, replenishment, allocations, store demand, ERP accuracy, warehouse flow, and execution across the business.
The Apparel Inventory Planner plays a critical role in improving stock availability, reducing stock-outs, managing slow-moving stock, supporting better buying decisions, and ensuring that inventory supports sales, customer demand, and profitability.
Key Responsibilities
1. Stock Planning & Replenishment
●    Plan and manage stock levels across all stores, online channels, and warehouse locations.
●    Monitor weekly sales, stock-on-hand, sell-through, weeks-of-cover, and stock availability.
●    Identify fast-moving, slow-moving, and out-of-stock products.
●    Recommend replenishment actions based on sales trends, stock holding, store performance, and customer demand.
●    Ensure key styles, best sellers, and core products are available in the correct quantities and sizes.
●    Maintain proper size curves across footwear, apparel, and accessories.
●    Identify gaps in stock availability before they become sales problems.
●    Support the business in maintaining the correct balance between stock availability and stock efficiency.
2. Allocations & Store Stock Balancing
●    Allocate new stock to stores based on sales history, store grading, product type, size demand, store capacity, and available stock.
●    Review stock distribution regularly and recommend store-to-store transfers where required.
●    Ensure stores are not overstocked or understocked in specific products, categories, or sizes.
●    Support new store openings, promotional launches, campaigns, and seasonal product drops with correct stock allocations.
●    Ensure stock is placed where it has the highest chance of selling.
●    Monitor store stock levels and recommend corrective actions where stores are carrying poor size curves, excess stock, or insufficient depth.
3. Inventory Reporting & Analysis
●    Prepare weekly and monthly inventory reports to support decision-making.
●    Report on key inventory metrics, including:
○    Stock-on-hand
○    Sell-through
○    Weeks-of-cover
○    Stock-outs
○    Slow movers
○    Best sellers
○    Store performance by category
○    Size availability
○    Transfer requirements
○    Replenishment needs
●    Analyse product, store, category, and size performance.
●    Identify risks and opportunities in the stock position.
●    Translate sales and stock data into clear, practical actions.
●    Provide management with meaningful insights, not just reports.
4. ERP & System Management
●    Maintain and monitor accurate product, stock, and planning information on the ERP system.
●    Ensure ERP data supports accurate planning, replenishment, reporting, and stock decision-making.
●    Monitor transfers, shipments, receipts, and stock movements to ensure they are processed correctly.
●    Follow up on unconfirmed shipments, outstanding transfers, receiving issues, and system discrepancies.
●    Work closely with the Stock Controller to identify and resolve stock accuracy issues.
●    Assist with stock take preparation, variance analysis, and stock accuracy improvement.
●    Understand how system transactions impact physical stock, store availability, and reporting accuracy.
5. Planning Principles & Execution
●    Understand planning principles from the ground up through to execution.
●    Understand the full working mechanics of inventory planning, including how sales, stock, replenishment, allocations, transfers, buying, warehouse movement, and store performance all connect.
●    Build planning recommendations that are practical, executable, and aligned with business reality.
●    Identify the root cause of stock issues rather than only reacting to symptoms.
●    Ensure that planning decisions are followed through into action.
●    Work across teams to make sure that plans are implemented properly and that stock movements are completed.
6. Buying & Product Support

The main purpose of the Presales Networking Engineer is to serve as the technical authority for Huawei networking solutions within the distribution channel by enabling, supporting, and empowering partners through expert pre-sales guidance, solution design, and technical mentorship. The role focuses on bridging the gap between Huawei technologies and partner project success by providing architectural expertise, assisting with solution scoping, and ensuring partners are technically certified, capable, and confident to position, design, and deploy Huawei networking solutions independently.
SENIOR PRESALES NETWORKING ENGINEER DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Partner Technical Enablement (Networking Focus)
• Training & Certification: Conduct technical training sessions and workshops for partner engineering teams, focusing on Huawei Datacom (Campus & Data Center), WLAN, and Network Security. Help partners achieve Huawei certifications (HCIA-Datacom, HCIP-Datacom.)
• Content Creation: Develop networking-specific enablement materials such as solution playbooks, network topology templates, competitive comparisons (e.g., Huawei vs. Cisco/HPE Aruba), and technical white papers for partners.
• Lab & Demo Support:Manage a demo environment where partners can test Huawei networking hardware and software to build their own competence.
• Networking Solution Design & Pre-Sales Support
• Technical Pre-Sales: Serve as the Level 2 technical escalation point for partners. Support them in translating client requirements into high-performance, secure, and scalable Huawei network solutions.
• Architecture & BOM: Design network architectures (spanning campus, branch, data centre, and WAN), create precise Bills of Materials (BOM), and provide technical justifications for proposals and tenders.
• Proof of Concept (POC): Assist with the design and execution of POCs for partners to validate Huawei networking performance, interoperability, and features for their end-customers.
Strategic Project Support
• Troubleshooting & Tuning: Assist partners with high-level troubleshooting during the pre-sales phase and provide guidance on network optimization to ensure proposed solutions meet performance SLAs.
• RFP/RFQ Response: Provide input for partner responses to public and private sector tenders, ensuring technical compliance and differentiation of Huawei solutions.
• Vendor & Market Collaboration
• Liaise with Huawei: Act as a technical liaison with Huawei’s local Networking team. Stay updated on product roadmaps, software versions (VRP), and security patches to keep partner’s current.
• Market Intelligence: Gather feedback from partners on competitive threats, market demands, and pricing pressures in the networking space, and relay this information to both internal management and Huawei
REQUIREMENTS:
Internal training associated with competencies:
• During the first week of your employment, you'll be presented with a meticulously crafted learning map designed to seamlessly guide you through your on-the-job training experience.
Requirements:
• HSCA, HCIP Telecommunications, or a related field.
• 2+ years of experience in a pre-sales, network engineer, or solution architect role focused on enterprise networking.
• Proven experience working within a Channel/Distribution model or with a System Integrator is highly preferred.
• Experience with network migration projects (from legacy vendors to Huawei) is a strong plus.Skills and Abilities:
• Experience in Huawei Enterprise Networking Products:
• Switching: CloudEngine series (data center), S-series (campus).
• Routing: AR series gateways, NetEngine series.
• WLAN: AirEngine Wi-Fi 6/7 access points and AC controllers.
• Good understanding of core networking protocols: OSPF, BGP, IS-IS, MPLS, VXLAN, QoS, and multicast.
• Knowledge of SDN/SD-WAN technologies (Huawei iMaster NCE, SD-WAN solution).

About the Role
We are looking for a skilled and adaptable Multi-Brand Repair Technician to join our Service Centre team.
This is not a single-brand repair role. As our product portfolio continues to grow, we need a technician who is comfortable working across different consumer electronics categories, learning new technologies quickly and developing the technical capability required to support new brands as they enter the business.
You will be responsible for the diagnosis, repair, testing, technical assessment and after-sales support of products across an expanding multi-brand portfolio.
A key part of the role will also be helping us build repair capability for new product categories — including completing manufacturer certifications, understanding new diagnostic and repair requirements, ensuring the correct tools and processes are in place and transferring technical knowledge to the wider Service Centre team.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Repairs & Diagnostics
• Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, test and release products across multiple consumer electronics categories.
• Accurately identify customer-reported faults and ensure issues are fully resolved before products are released.
• Complete technical assessments and prepare accurate repair quotations where required.
• Work according to manufacturer repair guides, warranty policies and technical procedures.
• Manage units requiring referral to manufacturers or approved third-party repair partners.
• Maintain strong turnaround times while ensuring repair quality and accuracy.New Brand & Product Capability
• Complete manufacturer certification and accreditation for newly introduced brands and product categories.
• Develop technical knowledge across new and unfamiliar product categories.
• Support workshop readiness by identifying tooling, diagnostic software, firmware, test equipment and parts requirements.
• Assist in developing repair procedures and diagnostic checklists for new products.
• Identify technical capability, tooling and training gaps and escalate these appropriately.
• Share product knowledge and technical learnings with other members of the Service Centre team.Quality & Process Management
• Maintain a consistently high standard of workmanship across all repairs.
• Follow prescribed quality-control processes before releasing repaired devices.
• Handle customer devices carefully throughout the repair process.
• Use repair tools and equipment correctly to prevent damage or secondary faults.
• Maintain accurate intake and post-repair photographic records where required.
• Maintain an organised, safe and professional workshop environment.
• Minimise repeat repairs, repair-related damage and quality failures.Repair Administration
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date repair records within the Service Centre systems.
• Capture clear diagnostic findings, fault codes, repair actions and customer-facing notes.
• Produce accurate quotations based on technical diagnosis and parts requirements.
• Ensure parts are ordered against the correct device, serial number and warranty status.
• Complete all relevant repair documentation before units are passed through quality control.
• Maintain accurate evidence and documentation for manufacturer warranty claims.
• Ensure device serial numbers, physical condition and repair records remain aligned throughout the repair process.Parts & Stock Accountability
• Maintain accountability for parts and spares allocated to repairs.
• Return used, faulty and scrap parts according to required warehouse and manufacturer processes.
• Ensure returned parts are correctly labelled and documented.
• Assist in identifying slow-moving, obsolete or superseded parts associated with new product categories.
• Maintain accurate alignment between physical units, repair status and system records.Technical Certification & Continuous Learning
• Maintain all required manufacturer and product certifications.
• Stay current with manufacturer technical bulletins, service articles, repair procedures and product updates.
• Complete required refresher, certification and self-study programmes.
• Maintain a strong continuous-learning mindset as the product and brand portfolio evolves.Customer Experience
• Provide clear and accurate technical information to customer-facing teams.
• Support realistic repair turnaround times and customer expectations.
• Ensure repair notes can be clearly understood by both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Minimise escalations caused by repair quality, communication or avoidable delays.
• Take ownership of the customer experience associated with each repair.Health, Safety & Technical Compliance
• Follow all required ESD procedures and controls.
• Maintain a safe and compliant technical workshop environment.
• Follow OHS requirements and manufacturer safety standards.
• Comply fully with lithium-ion battery handling, charging, storage, quarantine and transportation requirements.
• Immediately report safety incidents, risks and near-misses.Qualifications
Essential:
• Matric.
• Recognised technical qualification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical discipline.
• N4–N6, NQF Level 4–5 or equivalent technical qualification.Experience
• Minimum 3 years' hardware repair experience within consumer electronics.
• Demonstrated fault-finding, diagnostics and component or hardware repair capability.Advantageous:
• Board-level repair and/or micro-soldering experience.
• Previous experience within an authorised service centre.
• Experience working across more than one electronics brand or product category.
• Exposure to manufacturer warranty and repair portals.Key Competencies
We are looking for someone with:
• Strong technical troubleshooting and fault-finding ability.
• The ability to repair across multiple and potentially unrelated product categories.
• Excellent attention to detail.
• Strong administrative and system accuracy.
• Good written and verbal communication skills.
• A strong customer-service mindset.
• Personal accountability and ownership of work.
• The ability to meet deadlines and SLA-driven turnaround times.
• Strong problem-solving ability.
• A continuous-learning mindset and willingness to self-study.
• The ability to remain composed and prioritise effectively in a busy repair environment.
• Adaptability and the ability to move between different technologies and repair disciplines.
• The ability to document technical processes and procedures clearly.
• Strong safety awareness, particularly when working with lithium-ion batteries.What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means delivering accurate, efficient and high-quality repairs, while continuously developing the technical capability required to support an expanding multi-brand product portfolio.
You will be someone who enjoys understanding how things work, solving technical problems, learning new technologies and taking ownership from diagnosis through to final quality control.
As new brands and product categories are introduced into the business, you will play an important role in ensuring that our after-sales technical capability grows with them.

The Head of Legal, Governance & Executive Affairs serves as a trusted adviser and execution partner to the Executive Directors. The role consolidates high-level legal support, corporate governance, statutory and regulatory compliance, executive-office coordination and selected operational responsibilities into one accountable function.
