1. Programme Background
ForAfrika is a leading African humanitarian and development organisation operating in eight countries, with a vision of an Africa that thrives. Under a three-year grant from the donor, ForAfrika South Africa will assume full operational responsibility for solar-powered rural water systems across Mpumalanga, Limpopo and KwaZulu-Natal.
Each system comprises five integrated sub-systems: solar power generation and storage (2–4 kWp PV arrays with MPPT charge controllers and battery banks), a borehole with a Grundfos SQFlex or equivalent solar-direct submersible pump, automated inline chlorination, a 10 m³ elevated reservoir with gravity-fed distribution, and a standpipe network with volumetric metering. ForAfrika's role is to maintain, operate, and transfer these systems to community ownership, with water quality compliance against South African National Standard SANS 241:2015 as a Day 1 obligation.
2. Purpose of the Position
The WASH Field Engineer is part of the programme's technical delivery role — the qualified engineer responsible for quarterly full-system inspections, preventive and reactive maintenance, water quality field monitoring, and first-line technical problem-solving across an assigned cluster of sites. The position sits between trained community pump operators performing daily checks and specialist contractors performing manufacturer-level servicing, and is accountable for keeping systems operational, compliant, and well-documented.
The Field Engineer plays a central role in the technical condition assessment of all sites in the assigned cluster.
3. Key Responsibilities
3.1 Technical condition assessment
• Conduct the site-by-site technical condition assessment across the assigned cluster within the first three months: pump, controller, panels, batteries, tank and tower, distribution network, valves and fittings, and civil structure.
• Participate in joint site visits with Water supply system contractor including asset register verification, documentation review, and monitoring dashboard familiarisation.
• Support country team activities: tiered water quality field testing, sanitary surveys at risk-flagged sites, GPS verification, and yield measurement at sites with missing yield records.
• Contribute technical findings which need to be confirmed by Month 3, and identify end-of-life components for replacement under the Year 1 Replacement Capex Reserve.
• Execute Tier C remediation works at named priority sites under the 48-hour remediation initiation protocol and support the portfolio-wide water quality baseline assessment within 90 days of operational kickoff.3.2 Preventive and reactive maintenance
• Perform quarterly full-system inspections at all assigned sites: borehole yield testing, pump efficiency assessment, solar panel output measurement, battery and charge controller checks, chlorination system verification, structural inspection of concrete towers, and water committee performance review.
• Deliver reactive repairs in line with the tiered service-impact protocol: critical failures; reduced-service issues within five working days; minor issues at the next quarterly inspection.
• Diagnose faults using Water supply system contractor remote monitoring telemetry and support the shift from schedule-driven to condition-based, predictive maintenance at monitored sites.
• Escalate manufacturer-level pump servicing, borehole rehabilitation, and solar system overhauls to DWS-listed certified solar technical partners and supervise their work on site against service-level agreements.
• Prioritise Parent-site maintenance within the cluster maintenance model, recognising that Parent borehole failures cascade to hydraulically dependent Child sites
• Manage cluster-level spare parts inventories at Hub anchor locations, forecast consumables and coordinate replenishment with the Finance and Logistics Officer.3.3 Water quality monitoring and compliance
• Conduct monthly water quality field testing at all assigned sites using portable field kits and maintain calibration of field instruments.
• Collect and dispatch quarterly bacteriological samples (E. coli, total coliforms) to SANAS-accredited laboratories and apply elevated (monthly) sampling frequency at sites until restored.
• Verify automated inline chlorination performance (0.2–0.5 mg/L free chlorine residual at the most distant standpipe) and adjust dosing as required.
• Maintain water quality records in the programme database, flag non-compliance against SANS 241:2015 immediately, and initiate corrective action plans in coordination with the WASH Programme Manager.3.4 Community technical capacity building
• Train and mentor community pump operators in daily system checks, monthly pump performance logging, and water quality field testing, cross-referencing operator logs with remote monitoring telemetry.
• Deliver pump-attendant training cohorts and support the certification pathway from community operator toward established standard for community-hired technicians.
• Support Water Management Committees with technical inputs to O&M planning, tariff-setting consultations and Capital Sinking Fund calibration against component lifecycles (5/7/10/20 years).
• Contribute technical content to site-level O&M manuals any other documentation.3.5 Documentation, reporting and coordination
• Complete site inspection reports, maintenance job cards, and asset register updates in the field management system after every visit.
• Contribute technical data to monthly cluster reports, the MEAL dashboard, and quarterly donor reports, in coordination with the DMEAL team.
• Coordinate site visit scheduling with Community Mobilisation Officers so that maintenance activities are communicated to and coordinated with communities.
• Support the pump overhaul cycle for 2018-vintage systems and solar system overhauls for remaining vintage systems
4. Qualifications and Experience
Essential
• Bachelor's degree or national diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Water Engineering, or a closely related engineering field.
• Registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Candidate Engineer or Candidate Engineering Technologist (or eligibility to register); DWS registration/recognition as applicable.
• Minimum three (3) years of hands-on experience in the operation and maintenance of rural water supply systems, with demonstrable experience on solar-powered pumping systems (solar-direct submersible pumps, PV arrays, MPPT controllers, battery systems).
• Working knowledge of water quality monitoring and SANS 241:2015 requirements, including use of portable field test kits and bacteriological sampling protocols.
• Practical fault-diagnosis and repair skills across electromechanical, hydraulic, and basic civil components of borehole-based water systems.
• Valid driver's licence (Code B minimum; Code C1 an advantage) and willingness to travel extensively (up to 75%) to remote rural sites, including overnight stays — the KwaZulu-Natal position requires residence in-region, as day trips to the uMkhanyakude sites are not feasible from other bases.Desirable
• Grundfos certification or documented experience servicing Grundfos SQFlex or equivalent solar submersible pump fleets.
• Experience with remote monitoring/telemetry platforms and condition-based (predictive) maintenance approaches.
• Experience training community-based operators or artisans.
• Familiarity with borehole yield testing, sanitary survey methodology, and inline chlorination systems.
• Prior experience on donor-funded WASH programmes in the NGO/development sector.
• Proficiency in the dominant language of the assigned cluster (IsiZulu, Sepedi, or Siswati) in addition to English.

The main purpose of the Huawei Network Presales Engineer is to serve as the technical authority for Huawei networking solutions within the distribution channel by enabling, supporting, and empowering partners through expert pre-sales guidance, solution design, and technical mentorship. Partner Technical Enablement (Networking Focus)

Strategic Project Support
• Troubleshooting & Tuning: Assist partners with high-level troubleshooting during the pre-sales phase and provide guidance on network optimization to ensure proposed solutions meet performance SLAs.

• Liaise with Huawei: Act as a technical liaison with Huawei’s local Networking team. Stay updated on product roadmaps, software versions (VRP), and security patches to keep partner’s current.

• Switching: CloudEngine series (data center), S-series (campus).

A well-established manufacturing operation in Greylingstad is seeking a reliable and safety-conscious Boiler Operator to join its production team. Operations
• Be able to start up boiler fire properly.
• Monitor water holding JoJo tanks hourly and keep them full of water at all times.
• Monitor low level water alarm on your hotwell tank.
• Complete daily boiler maintenance checklist and ensure supervisor signed it after completion.

• Keep boiler drains clean all the time.
• Change the use of boiler water pump weekly with the standby pump.

• Continuously communicate with the production operator on steam demand hourly.
• Monitor and control boiler performance and settings by reading gauges, meters and charts to track boiler operation.

Turn Your Commercial Experience into Entrepreneurial ImpactAre you a financially astute business professional who understands more than just the numbers?
Perhaps you are a financial analyst, commercial manager, finance leader, business operator or entrepreneur with a strong understanding of how business finance, strategy, sales, and operations work together. You may have reached a point in your career where you are looking for something different: an opportunity to use your experience to guide business owners, develop entrepreneurs and create measurable impact.
If you have run your own business, understand the realities of entrepreneurship and are ready to move from analysing or managing businesses to helping entrepreneurs build stronger ones, this could be the career change you have been looking for.
Raizcorp is looking for a seasoned, well-rounded business professional to join us as a business coach.
This is a full-time, salaried role in which you will coach a portfolio of entrepreneurs across every area of their businesses, including finance, strategy, sales, marketing, operations, people and personal development.
You do not need any previous coaching experience. Raizcorp will train you in our internationally recognised coaching methodology. What you do need is substantial business experience, strong commercial judgement, empathy for entrepreneurs and a genuine desire to help others succeed.
What you’ll do
· Hold structured monthly one-on-one coaching sessions with entrepreneurs.
· Help business owners interpret their financial information and use it to make better commercial decisions.
· Guide entrepreneurs in strengthening their strategies, sales approaches, marketing activities, operational systems and people practices.
· Facilitate business simulations and group learning sessions using Raizcorp’s proven programmes and methodology.
· Manage a defined portfolio of entrepreneurs and track progress in areas such as revenue, profitability, business capability and founder development.
· Challenge entrepreneurs to think critically, evaluate trade-offs and take accountability for their decisions.
· Connect the different areas of a business so entrepreneurs can make integrated, forward-looking decisions.
· Remain informed about economic conditions, market shifts and regulations that may affect entrepreneurs and their businesses.
· Collaborate closely with other coaches and specialists to support each entrepreneur’s development journey.
This role may be a strong fit for you if you are:
· A financial analyst or finance professional who has developed a strong understanding of business operations and commercial decision-making.
· A commercial or operational leader who wants to use your experience in a more purpose-driven role.
· A current or former entrepreneur who understands both the rewards and pressures of building a business.
· An experienced business professional looking for a meaningful career change.
· Someone who enjoys developing people, asking insightful questions and helping others arrive at better decisions. Empathy in this role is super important.
· Motivated by the opportunity to influence real business results rather than simply report on them.
What you’ll need
· Between 10 and 15-plus years of experience across corporate, commercial and entrepreneurial environments.
· Experience owning or running your own business at some point in your career. This is a non-negotiable requirement.
· Strong financial and commercial acumen, with the ability to interpret business performance beyond the income statement.
· Experiential depth in business finance, strategy and sales.
· A practical understanding of how marketing, operations, people and finance influence one another.
· The ability to identify patterns, challenge assumptions and help entrepreneurs evaluate business trade-offs.
· High emotional intelligence and genuine empathy for the realities of entrepreneurship.
· A mature, accountable and non-judgemental approach.
· Strong communication and facilitation skills.
· An organised, systematic and proactive working style.
· Confidence using technology and business systems, including Microsoft 365 or Microsoft Office and learner management systems.
· A commerce-related tertiary qualification. An MBA or other master’s-level qualification will be an advantage.
· A valid driver’s licence and your own vehicle.
What you’ll gain
· The opportunity to turn years of commercial and entrepreneurial experience into meaningful impact.
· A career in which you work directly with entrepreneurs and their businesses every day.
· Formal training in an internationally recognised business-coaching methodology.
· Continuous professional development and exposure to businesses across different industries and stages of growth.
· The opportunity to influence revenue, profitability, founder capability and long-term business sustainability.
· A supportive, fiercely caring team culture that backs the jockey—the entrepreneur—not only the horse.
· A rare opportunity to build a new career without leaving the world of business behind.
Ready for a different kind of business career?
You have spent years analysing businesses, leading teams, making commercial decisions or building something of your own.
Now, you could use that experience to help entrepreneurs make better decisions, build stronger businesses and become more capable business leaders.
Move from measuring business performance to helping create it.

about_role:
We are looking for an experienced, strategically minded Head of Service Operations & Transformation to take ownership of our end-to-end service operation across Africa and lead the transformation of how we deliver repairs, after-sales support and customer service.
This is a senior Head of Department opportunity for an individual who combines Industrial Engineering expertise, operational leadership, commercial acumen and transformation capability with the ability to manage complex, multi-site operations across multiple African markets.
You will be responsible for building a scalable, efficient and commercially sustainable service operating model while ensuring that our operations consistently deliver an exceptional customer experience and meet Apple Authorised Service Provider standards.
As the Head of Service Operations & Transformation, you will provide strategic and operational leadership across the iStore Africa service network.
You will own the complete service journey – from customer collection and diagnostics through repair, parts management, logistics and cross-border movement to final delivery and customer recovery.
A key focus of the role will be to assess the existing operating model, identify inefficiencies and opportunities, redesign processes and implement scalable solutions that improve productivity, turnaround times, quality, cost, customer experience and commercial performance.
This is an opportunity to shape and scale a critical function across Africa while working with world-class technology brands and diverse teams and markets.
Key Responsibilities
Service Strategy & Leadership
• Develop and execute the service operations strategy in alignment with the broader iStore Africa and Core Group strategy.
• Provide strategic direction across all service locations and countries.
• Build a scalable operating model capable of supporting future regional growth.
• Establish clear performance standards, governance structures, KPIs and operating rhythms.
• Identify opportunities to improve capability, productivity, efficiency, customer experience and profitability.
• Provide executive leadership with clear insight into performance, risks, opportunities and strategic priorities.
• Act as the senior escalation point for significant operational, technical, customer, compliance and commercial matters.
• Review and optimise the complete end-to-end service and repair operation.
• Map, analyse, redesign and standardise processes across service locations.
• Identify bottlenecks, duplication, control gaps, inefficiencies and automation opportunities.
• Design scalable processes that can be consistently implemented across multiple markets.
• Improve capacity planning, workforce utilisation, workflow design and resource allocation.
• Lead continuous improvement and operational transformation initiatives.
• Use data and operational insights to drive measurable improvements in cost, turnaround time, quality and customer experience.

• Oversee workshops, service desks, repair queues, technician productivity and repair quality.
• Manage collections, parts movement, logistics, courier networks and cross-border repairs.
• Drive same-day repair capability where workshop capacity and parts availability allow.
• Monitor demand and capacity across the network and implement corrective action where required.
• Ensure all service centres operate consistently against defined operational standards.
Financial & Commercial Management
• Own the service division's budget, forecasts, cost management and financial planning.
• Improve the financial and commercial contribution of the service function.
• Manage key cost drivers including parts, labour, logistics, repeat repairs, stock losses, write-offs and third-party service costs.
• Identify opportunities to reduce waste and improve productivity and operational value.
• Develop business cases for new locations, technology, equipment, tooling, staffing and process improvements.
• Evaluate investments and measure return on operational initiatives.
• Manage external suppliers, service providers and logistics partners against agreed commercial and operational outcomes.

• Establish robust governance and control frameworks.

• Lead root-cause analysis and ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained.
• Maintain strong risk, safety, security and compliance controls across all service environments.

• Define and deliver a premium after-sales experience aligned with the iStore and Apple brands.
• Ensure customers receive accurate, clear and timely communication throughout the repair journey.
• Establish consistent service and escalation standards across markets.
• Monitor customer satisfaction, complaints, service recovery and customer effort.
• Drive rapid resolution of complex customer escalations.
• Partner with Retail, Customer Experience, Marketing and regional teams to continuously improve the customer journey.
• Use customer feedback and operational data to identify improvement opportunities.
Stock, Parts & Asset Management
• Ensure effective stock and parts management across the service network.
• Improve parts forecasting, availability, replenishment and allocation.
• Ensure parts availability supports service-level and turnaround-time commitments.
• Oversee workshop assets, tools, equipment and security controls.
• Manage shrinkage, obsolete stock, lost parts, write-offs and inventory inaccuracies.
• Establish strong operational and financial controls.
• Partner with Supply Chain, Finance and regional teams to improve stock accuracy and availability.
Regional Growth & Expansion
• Lead operational readiness for new service locations across Africa.
• Assess demand, infrastructure, staffing, technical capability and operational risk in new markets.

• Develop scalable processes, systems, structures and training models to support growth.
• Partner with country leaders and regional stakeholders on expansion initiatives.

• Analyse trends and translate insights into operational action.
• Partner with IT and relevant stakeholders to improve service technology and systems.

• Hold external partners accountable for agreed service and performance standards.

a fast-growing FMCG distributor operating in the nicotine and vaping category across Southern Africa. Are seeking a Sales Operations Manager to take that on.

Preferred experience – strong differentiators
Experience stepping into a business with a known execution gap and personally turning it around
History of working alongside – not replacing – a National Sales Manager or Head of Sales
FMCG experience in a founder-led, fast-scaling or entrepreneurial environment
Experience in the nicotine, vaping, tobacco or regulated consumer goods category

The successful candidate will act as custodian of the Regal brand and will be accountable for marketing activity across the organisation , including branches, key accounts, projects, corporate branding, product brands, digital channels, e-commerce and retail execution.
The role operates in a fast-paced, high-volume B2B environment and requires a marketing leader who can combine strategic thinking with strong execution, sound commercial judgement and proven people-management capability.
The successful candidate must be comfortable working closely with executive management, sales teams, Product Managers, Product Specialists, external agencies, suppliers and other key stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Marketing Strategy & Brand Management
• Act as custodian of the Regal brand and maintain consistent brand standards across the organisation.
• Develop, implement and monitor the annual marketing strategy and advertising plan for Regal and the brands within its portfolio.
• Develop measurable marketing initiatives aligned with business objectives.

• Develop strategies to attract new customers, retain existing customers and strengthen Regal’s market position.
• Identify and develop appropriate co-branding and partner marketing opportunities.
• Work closely with senior executives to ensure effective marketing across branches, key accounts, projects and corporate channels.
Budget Management & Commercial Performance
• Develop and manage the annual marketing budget.
• Ensure marketing expenditure is appropriately controlled and delivers value to the business.
• Track the effectiveness and return on investment of marketing campaigns and initiatives.
• Prepare regular marketing reports, analysis and presentations for executive management.
• Adjust marketing plans and campaigns in response to performance data, market conditions and business priorities.

• Research and analyse market trends, customer demographics, competitor activity, pricing and relevant industry information.
• Use market intelligence to develop effective marketing strategies and campaigns.
• Develop targeted promotional campaigns to support sales and address ageing or strategic stock.
• Work with OEMs and brand partners to secure promotional funding and support where appropriate.
• Oversee campaign development from concept through to execution and measurement.
Digital Marketing & Communications
• Develop and lead digital marketing initiatives across relevant platforms.
• Oversee email marketing, social media, website content, industry publications, third-party blogs and other digital channels.
• Provide strategic direction for content creation, creative development and campaign execution.
• Oversee public relations and sponsorship activities that support brand awareness and reputation.
• Maintain effective customer database segmentation to support targeted and relevant communications.
Website & E-Commerce
• Work with Product Managers and Product Specialists to develop accurate and compelling product and solutions content.
• Oversee product photography and presentation standards.
• Work closely with the E-Commerce Manager and web developers to improve website functionality, layout and user experience.
• Ensure website content remains relevant, accurate and commercially effective.
• Drive ongoing SEO optimisation to improve organic search visibility and rankings.
• Support the continued development and effectiveness of Regal’s digital and e-commerce platforms.
Design Studio & Creative Management
• Lead and oversee the marketing and design function.
• Manage departmental briefs, workflow, priorities and deadlines.
• Ensure creative projects are delivered accurately, professionally and within agreed timelines.

We are looking for a career-driven, reliable, highly organised and detail-oriented Office Administrator / Bookkeeper to join our team on a full-time basis.
Experience in the property, rental or property management industry will be highly advantageous, as the role involves both general office administration and day-to-day bookkeeping responsibilities relating to tenants, rentals, suppliers, contractors and property expenses.
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 – 17:00
Key Responsibilities – Office Administration
• Answering and managing incoming phone calls professionally
• Managing general office correspondence and enquiries
• General office administration and day-to-day office management
• Filing, printing, scanning and maintaining accurate physical and electronic records
• Data capturing and ensuring information is kept accurate and up to date
• Preparing documents, letters, schedules and reports when required
• Maintaining organised tenant, supplier, contractor and property files
• Coordinating plumbers, electricians and other contractors
• Dispatching contractors to different properties/sites as required
• Following up on maintenance jobs and ensuring work is completed
• Keeping records of maintenance requests, quotations, invoices and completed work
• Liaising with tenants regarding maintenance, accounts and general property matters
• Following up on outstanding documents, quotations, invoices and information
• Working confidently with Microsoft Excel
• Maintaining spreadsheets, schedules and administrative reports
• Ensuring tasks are followed through from start to completion
• Assisting management with general administrative duties as required
Key Responsibilities – Bookkeeping & Accounts
The successful candidate will also be responsible for various bookkeeping and financial administration duties, including:
• Preparing, capturing and processing invoices
• Capturing supplier invoices and expenses accurately
• Preparing customer/tenant invoices and statements
• Rental collection and monitoring monthly rental payments
• Following up with tenants regarding outstanding and overdue rental payments
• Maintaining accurate tenant account records
• Allocating rental payments received to the correct tenant accounts
• Recording deposits, rental payments, utilities and other charges
• Monitoring outstanding debtors and preparing debtor reports
• Following up on overdue accounts and maintaining records of collection efforts
• Processing and reconciling supplier accounts
• Preparing supplier payment schedules
• Checking supplier invoices against quotations, statements and work completed
• Ensuring contractors and suppliers are paid correctly and that supporting documentation is available
• Capturing payments and receipts into the accounting/property management system
• Performing bank reconciliations
• Reconciling bank statements against payments received and expenses paid
• Identifying and investigating discrepancies on accounts
• Maintaining accurate cashbooks
• Processing petty cash transactions and reconciling petty cash
• Maintaining records of income and expenses
• Capturing municipal, electricity, water, levy and other property-related accounts where applicable
• Allocating expenses to the correct property or account
• Preparing monthly income and expense summaries
• Assisting with monthly management accounts and financial reports
• Maintaining creditor and debtor ledgers
• Reconciling creditor statements to the accounting system
• Preparing age analysis reports for debtors and creditors
• Monitoring outstanding supplier invoices and payments
• Ensuring all financial documents are properly filed and supported by invoices, receipts or proof of payment
• Assisting with VAT documentation and preparation where required
• Assisting accountants or auditors with supporting documents and information
• Maintaining organised financial records for year-end and audit purposes
• Checking figures carefully and ensuring all capturing is accurate
• Assisting with budgeting, expense tracking and cash-flow information where required
• Generating financial and rental reports for management
• Maintaining confidentiality of company and financial information
Property / Rental Administration
Because this role is connected to property administration, the candidate should ideally understand or be willing to learn:
• Tenant accounts and rental statements
• Rental collections and arrears
• Deposits and tenant balances
• Property expenses
• Maintenance costs
• Contractor invoices
• Municipal and utility accounts
• Lease-related administration
• Tenant queries
• Property inspections and maintenance coordination
• Keeping individual property records accurate and up to date
• Allocating income and expenses to the correct properties
• Following up with tenants, landlords, suppliers and contractors when necessary
Requirements
• Previous office administration experience
• Previous bookkeeping, accounts or financial administration experience
• Experience in the property, rental or property management industry is highly preferred
• A good understanding of tenants, rentals, maintenance, contractors and general property administration
• Good understanding of basic bookkeeping principles
• Experience with debtors and creditors
• Experience with invoicing, payments, reconciliations and account follow-ups
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel
• Ability to work confidently with spreadsheets and formulas
• Experience with MDA, Pastel, Sage, Xero or similar property/accounting software will be highly advantageous
• Excellent telephone and communication skills
• Strong numerical ability
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy
• Able to identify discrepancies and resolve problems
• Able to multitask and work under pressure
• Well organised and able to prioritise responsibilities
• Able to follow tasks through to completion without constant supervision
• Professional, responsible and dependable
• Proactive and willing to take initiative
• Honest and trustworthy, particularly when dealing with financial information
• A driven, career-oriented individual who takes pride in their work
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who understands that accuracy, organisation, accountability and follow-through are essential.
The successful candidate must be comfortable handling both administrative and bookkeeping responsibilities, must take ownership of their work and must ensure that accounts, records, rental collections, maintenance matters and office duties are kept up to date.
This position would suit someone who is looking for a long-term career opportunity, wants to grow within the company and is prepared to take responsibility for ensuring that the administrative and financial side of the office runs efficiently.
Position: Full-Time Office Administrator / Bookkeeper
Hours: 08:00 – 17:00, Monday to Friday

The Stock Controller is responsible for maintaining accurate, well-organised, and readily traceable inventory across PABT's warehouse and stores environment. The role owns the day-to-day flow of stock from goods receipt through to issue and dispatch and the integrity of the bin location system

• Good numeracy and problem-solving skills for resolving stock discrepancies
• 2–4 years' experience in a stock control, inventory, or warehouse role, ideally within a manufacturing, engineering, or industrial parts environment

Role Purpose
The Sourcing Specialist is responsible for securing continuity and security of supply through effective sourcing, supplier management, commercial negotiations, tender processes and contract administration. The role supports the achievement of competitive pricing, reduced contractual risk and improved supplier performance while ensuring procurement activities align with business, supply chain and financial objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Sourcing & Procurement
• Identify, evaluate and select suitable suppliers based on quality, cost, capability and business requirements.
• Analyse market dynamics, cost drivers, supplier alternatives and areas of innovation to support sourcing decisions.
• Manage procurement processes from sourcing and supplier evaluation through to appointment and implementation.
• Develop and maintain sourcing strategies for key or high-risk categories.
• Support the preparation and execution of procurement plans and sourcing activities.
• Ensure procurement activities comply with relevant policies, procedures, legislation and BBBEE requirements. Supplier & Contract Management
• Manage a portfolio of suppliers and monitor supplier performance against agreed requirements and service levels.
• Build and maintain effective supplier relationships and address performance gaps.
• Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, service levels and contractual requirements with suppliers.
• Manage contracts, including contract administration, service-level agreements, amendments and changes.
• Identify opportunities to renegotiate, improve or replace supplier arrangements where required.
• Monitor contract compliance, supplier deliverables and associated risks. Tender & Bid Management
• Prepare and coordinate Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Tenders (RFTs) and other sourcing documentation.
• Gather and analyse information relating to tender requirements and assess feasibility.
• Coordinate tender evaluation processes and ensure the correct evaluation criteria and methodology are applied.
• Analyse supplier proposals, pricing and commercial submissions and provide recommendations.
• Coordinate stakeholder input and communication throughout the tender process.
• Ensure tender submissions and procurement documentation are complete, accurate and submitted within required timelines. Commercial & Financial Management
• Analyse supplier pricing, cost structures and commercial information to identify value and cost-saving opportunities.
• Apply financial and quantitative information to support procurement and sourcing decisions.
• Assist with costing, budgeting and expenditure management relating to procurement activities.
• Evaluate the overall commercial value, risks and benefits of alternative sourcing solutions.
• Monitor supplier invoices, payments and contractual financial obligations where applicable. Data, Analysis & Reporting
• Collect, analyse and interpret procurement, supplier and market data to support decision-making.
• Identify trends, cost drivers, supplier risks and opportunities for improvement.
• Prepare accurate procurement, supplier performance, tender and management reports.
• Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier information and supporting documentation.
• Ensure information is properly captured, structured, controlled and accessible. Stakeholder Management
• Build effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, suppliers and external partners.
• Understand and balance the requirements of multiple stakeholders when developing sourcing solutions.
• Communicate procurement requirements, recommendations and commercial outcomes clearly.
• Negotiate effectively with stakeholders and suppliers to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
• Escalate procurement, supplier and contractual risks appropriately. Administration & Process Improvement
• Provide effective administrative support across sourcing, procurement and contract management activities.
• Prepare routine correspondence, reports, tender documentation and procurement records.
• Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails throughout procurement processes.
• Identify opportunities to optimise procurement processes, systems and ways of working.
• Support continuous improvement and the implementation of efficient procurement practices.
• Maintain knowledge of relevant legislation, regulations, technology, market developments and industry best practice.

Dis-Chem Pharmacies in Pretoria  has a an opportunity for a security guard to Render a security service in terms of the Private Security Industry Regulations Act 56 of 2001 as amended for the Dis-Chem Group that meets Dis-Chem’ security requirements to protect assets, property and staff by creating a safe and secure environment, through identifying signs of criminal activities or disorder and investigating disturbances while adhering to legislation relevant to the industry and best practice.
Minimum Requirements…
Essential:
• Grade 12 – Matric or a Senior Certificate
• Grade C accreditation with the PSIRA
• A general minimum exposure of at least 3 years in the retail industry, such as shopping malls and warehouses
Advantageous:
• At least 1 year specific previous experience in a similar role
Job Specification…
• Be vigilant and alert of surroundings to identify suspicious activities and apprehend criminals or remove violators according to the legal authority invested in the industry and Dis-Chem standard operating procedures for the specific post through.
• Random patrols of the premises on regularly basis to ensure optimal visibility and reduce risks.
• Monitor and control access to the premises by documenting and regulating entrance into the site by vehicles or pedestrian’s access points to allow entry only to individuals with the correct authorization.
• Investigate and report signs of damage or unlawful entry as it occurs to management and act accordingly in the best interest of protecting Dis-Chem assets.
• Be clearly visible as far as reasonably possible as deterrent to discourage criminal activities, prevent theft, - damage, - personal injury, and other dishonourable acts.
• Be professionally courteous and friendly, approachable, and willing to help others when receiving guests, customers and employees.
• Access control – searching of staff, suppliers and company merchandisers.
• Maintain and complete all registers and occurrence books.
• Cancel staff purchasers and goods declared.
• Supervise and check refuse removal according to Dis-Chem standards
• Protect the property and assets of the business from all dishonest persons, action or any acts of malicious behaviour that could result in the company suffering loss.
• Be present at your post at all times when on duty.
• Practice good customer service relations for all Dis-Chem internal and external customers.
• Report any unusual or suspicious behaviour by staff, customer or suppliers.
• Opening and closing procedures-to be present observant and vigilant at the opening and closing of the site.
• Ensure that all doors and windows are locked at the end each day.
• Ensure that all water taps turned off when applicable.
• Do continuous personnel frisking and searches on a daily basis.
• Do thorough and proper vehicle searches throughout the day.
• Report any suspicious incidents verbally to management in detail with the submission of a written detailed report as soon as conveniently possible.
• Contact policing and emergency authorities and make written or verbal reports to law enforcement officers when needed as legally required and in accordance of Dis-Chem procedures.
• When problem situations or crisis arise or have been dealt with to maintain observing surroundings and report to management on findings and or changes in identified that intensify the situation.
• After a crisis, report the incident to management, the police or the appropriate authorities (such as the fire services in the case of a fire outbreak) with a detailed written report concerning the incident and your activities around the incident.
• Monitor the alarm systems and or video cameras and operate detecting/ emergency equipment when needed.
• When working during the night or alone e.g. after hours render on-going surveillance of the premises by patrolling the grounds and using closed-circuit camera monitoring or alarm systems to detect and investigate suspicious activities to ensure that only legal entrance to the premises is maintained.
• In emergency situations provide assistance and the emergency teams e.g. alert first responders, clinic sisters, managers etc.
• Maintain order during evacuation procedures and at assembly points by providing exact directions or decisive actions to ensure the safety of lives and property by preventing stampedes and breakdown of law and order or illegal entrance to the premises.
• Offer on-going security advice and safety warnings and tips to ensure that all security and safety precautions are adhered to.
• Be vigilant - watch out for any suspicious activities that may mean a breach in security measures that have been put in place on the site.
• Interpret quickly whatever is seen and act accordingly.
• Respond quickly and correctly during crisis - be alert to avoid being caught unaware.
• Know how best to respond to various dangerous situations according to industry and Dis-Chem standard operating procedures.
• Getting help - During some very dangerous situations (such as armed robbery attacks or assaults with deadly weapons), waste no time in calling the police to prevent loss of lives or property.
• Take accurate notes of unusual occurrences and daily activities.
• Enforce rules and regulations to prevent criminal activity before it happens.
• Perform special duties - receive phone calls, respond to text and email messages, and run vital errands for the department according to Dis-Chem and industry standard operating procedures.
Competencies
Essential:
• PSIRA knowledge
• Fire emergency and relevant Health and Safety Training and exposure
• English – Read, write and speak well as it is the organization’s official language.Advantageous:
• 3rd LanguageSpecial conditions of employment:
• PSIRA registered.
• Grade C PSIRA accreditation.
• South African
• MIE, clear criminal and credit.
• Driver’s license and own reliable transport and PDP when deployed as a driver.
Remuneration and benefits:
• Market related salary
• Kaelo
• Provident fund (PSSPF)

Role Purpose
The Fuel & Convenience Manager is responsible for the overall management and performance of a fuel and convenience retail site. The role oversees daily operations, sales, customer service, staff performance, stock and cash control, financial management, compliance and administration.
The incumbent is accountable for driving sales and profitability while ensuring a safe, efficient, compliant and customer-focused operation. The role requires a visible, hands-on leader who takes ownership of site performance, develops a high-performing team and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement and growth.
Key Responsibilities
Site & Operational Management
• Manage the day-to-day operations of the fuel and convenience site.
• Conduct regular site inspections and operational checks to ensure standards are maintained.
• Ensure the site is safe, clean, well maintained and operating efficiently.
• Monitor fuel operations, convenience retail activities and value-added services.
• Ensure operational procedures, systems and controls are consistently implemented.
• Identify operational challenges and implement practical solutions to improve efficiency and productivity.
• Take ownership of overall site performance and operational results. Sales & Business Growth
• Drive sales growth across fuel, convenience retail and value-added services.
• Monitor sales performance against targets and implement corrective actions where required.
• Identify opportunities to increase revenue, customer traffic and average customer spend.
• Support and execute promotional activities and initiatives designed to increase sales and customer engagement.
• Develop a strong understanding of products, customers and local market requirements.
• Identify opportunities for innovation, growth and improved customer experience. Financial Management & Cost Control
• Prepare and manage the site's annual budget and expenditure requirements.
• Monitor operating expenses and maintain effective cost controls.
• Analyse financial and operational variances and implement corrective actions.
• Monitor profitability and ensure financial objectives and sales targets are achieved.
• Manage cash controls, banking processes and daily cash reconciliations.
• Ensure all financial controls and procedures are consistently followed.
• Identify opportunities to improve margins, reduce costs and minimise financial losses. Stock & Inventory Management
• Maintain effective stock management and inventory control processes.
• Monitor fuel and convenience stock levels to ensure product availability.
• Conduct regular stock counts and investigate discrepancies and variances.
• Identify and minimise stock losses, wastage and shrinkage.
• Ensure accurate stock reconciliations and investigate potential causes of losses.
• Maintain appropriate controls over stock receiving, storage and movement.
• Work with suppliers and internal teams to ensure effective stock availability and replenishment. Customer Experience
• Promote and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.
• Set the standard for professional, friendly and consistent customer service.
• Interact directly with customers and address complaints and service concerns.
• Ensure customer complaints are resolved promptly and appropriately.
• Monitor service standards and implement improvements where required.
• Identify opportunities to enhance the customer experience and encourage repeat business. People Management & Leadership
• Lead, manage and develop a high-performing site team.
• Set clear performance and service expectations for employees.
• Monitor employee performance and address performance issues appropriately.
• Promote a positive, professional and customer-focused team culture.
• Build trust and effective working relationships across diverse teams.
• Coach and develop employees to improve productivity, service delivery and performance.
• Lead by example through professionalism, integrity, accountability and visible involvement in daily operations. Compliance, Health & Safety & Risk Management
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures and operational controls.
• Monitor compliance with relevant external legislation and regulatory requirements.
• Ensure health and safety standards are consistently maintained across the site.
• Conduct operational checks and address identified risks or non-compliance.
• Ensure appropriate controls are in place to manage cash, stock, shrinkage and operational risks.
• Maintain accurate records and documentation relating to operational and compliance requirements. Systems & Digital Optimisation
• Ensure effective utilisation of retail operating systems and digital platforms.
• Use operational and performance data to identify trends, inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
• Support the automation and optimisation of digital processes and inventory control systems.
• Maintain accurate operational information and reporting.
• Use technology and data to improve productivity, stock control and business performance. Stakeholder Management
• Build and maintain effective relationships with the Regional Manager, Operations Control Manager and wider retail operations team.
• Collaborate with finance and accounting teams on financial controls, reporting and reconciliations.
• Maintain effective relationships with suppliers and service providers.
• Communicate operational issues, opportunities and performance insights to relevant stakeholders.
• Work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders to achieve site objectives. Administration & Reporting
•  Maintain accurate operational, financial, stock and administrative records.
• Prepare and submit required site reports accurately and timeously.
• Monitor key performance indicators and provide feedback on site performance.
• Analyse operational results and recommend improvements.
• Ensure all required documentation and administrative processes are completed in accordance with company standards.

about_role:
Role Purpose
The Operations Manager is responsible for the effective and efficient management of Centre operations, facilities, maintenance, security, cleaning and tenant-related operational services. The role oversees service providers and contractors, ensures the Centre is maintained to a high standard, manages operational budgets and expenditure, and ensures compliance with health, safety, environmental and statutory requirements.
The incumbent is also responsible for maintaining strong relationships with tenants, suppliers and contractors, supporting operational planning and ensuring the Centre delivers a safe, well-maintained and professional environment.
Key Responsibilities
Centre Operations & Facilities Management
• Manage the day-to-day operational requirements of the Centre and its facilities.
• Oversee maintenance, security, cleaning and other contracted service providers.
• Ensure plant, machinery, mechanical and electrical systems are effectively maintained in line with preventative maintenance schedules.
• Implement and maintain Planned Preventative Maintenance programmes.
• Conduct regular building and facilities inspections and ensure identified issues are addressed promptly.
• Ensure the Centre remains clean, well maintained and in good repair.
• Maintain accurate asset registers, maintenance records and operational documentation.
• Monitor utility consumption and costs and identify opportunities for improved efficiency.
• Maintain emergency planning and business continuity procedures and ensure these remain current and effective.
• Maintain Centre shop-fitting guidelines and tenant criteria documentation and assist with monitoring tenant fit-outs. Maintenance & Contractor Management
• Coordinate maintenance activities and ensure operational requirements are completed within agreed standards and timeframes.
• Manage relationships with maintenance, security, cleaning and other service providers.
• Monitor contractor performance against agreed service levels and contractual requirements.
• Ensure maintenance agreements and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) remain current.
• Review contractor performance and address service deficiencies where required.
• Procure and coordinate operational and capital expenditure projects.
• Prepare tender documentation and support the evaluation and appointment of contractors.
• Ensure contractors comply with Centre policies, procedures, safety requirements and contractual obligations. Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance
• Ensure compliance with applicable health, safety and environmental legislation, regulations and industry best practice.
• Conduct regular Occupational Health and Safety inspections and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
• Maintain accurate health, safety and environmental compliance records.
• Assist with the implementation and monitoring of the Centre's health and safety policies and procedures.
• Ensure new tenants, contractors and visitors receive appropriate health, safety and environmental information and induction.
• Monitor compliance by tenants, contractors and other site users with applicable safety procedures and regulations.
• Ensure accidents and incidents are appropriately reported, documented and investigated.
• Ensure the Centre complies with insurer requirements and relevant statutory obligations.
• Coordinate and maintain emergency procedures and risk management initiatives. Security Management
• Oversee the security operation and ensure effective protection of Centre facilities, tenants, staff and visitors.
• Identify security risks and develop appropriate preventative and corrective action plans.
• Monitor security systems and equipment and recommend improvements where required.
• Coordinate security personnel and ensure appropriate staffing and deployment.
• Maintain effective security procedures and information systems.
• Liaise with tenants regarding security concerns and requirements.
• Maintain relationships with SAPS, local authorities and other relevant stakeholders.
• Promote security awareness among staff, tenants and visitors.
• Respond appropriately to emergencies and security-related incidents. Budgeting & Financial Management
• Assist with the preparation and management of operational, repairs and maintenance (R&M) and capital expenditure budgets.
• Monitor operational expenditure against approved budgets.
• Ensure facilities operations remain cost-effective and within established financial limits.
• Assist with financial forecasting and long-term budget projections.
• Authorise invoices in accordance with delegated authority.
• Calculate operational costs and ensure appropriate tenant recoveries.
• Monitor utility billing and ensure discrepancies are investigated and resolved.

Die primêre doel van die pos is om kliënte se monsters te ontleed en akkuraat te pas, met 'n spesifieke fokus op kleur, smaak en algehele gehalte—veral ten opsigte van witpeper en ander gemaalde speserye.
Pos Pligte en Sleutelwerksaamhede:
• Monster-analise: Ontvangs en deeglike ontleding van kliëntemonsters vir kleur, aroma, tekstuur en smaak.

• Aangesien die rol spesifieke laboratorium- en fynmotoriese take behels, word vroulike kandidate verkies.

Content Creator
Core objective. Shoot, edit and optimise native short form video and photography that drives awareness, engagement and sales for Curve Gear across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube Shorts.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Content production and editing
• Shoot and capture. Record vertical and horizontal video, clean audio and photography on mobile and studio gear, on location at farms, sites, workshops and stores.
• Rapid editing. Cut raw footage fast in CapCut, DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro with dynamic captions, sound design and pacing built for each platform.
• Format repurposing. Turn single long form assets into multiple high performing short clips. One interview should yield five posts.
• Brand voice. Write hooks, captions, on screen text and calls to action that sound like Curve Gear, not like an advert.
Paid media and UGC creative
• Ad creative. Build creative made to run on Meta and TikTok, not repurposed organic posts.
• Hook testing. Deliver multiple hook variations of every concept so the media buyer can test openings against each other.
• Scaling winners. When an ad performs, cut new angles off it rather than starting from zero.
• UGC production. Script, cast, direct and edit UGC style content. A real person talking to a phone camera about a real experience.
• UGC craft. Hook in the first two seconds. One message, not a feature list. Specific over general. Phone quality on purpose, because over polished UGC stops working.
Strategy and trend agility
• Trend tracking. Monitor audio, formats, comment culture and algorithm shifts daily, and pitch content while the trend is still alive.
• Content pipeline. Source and book real customers and crews. Keep a rolling pipeline of at least six confirmed shoots.
• Cross platform fit. Match content style to the audience on each platform. Facebook carries our core customer, TikTok carries the growth.
Analytics and optimisation
• Performance tracking. Review views, hold rate, watch time, saves and shares weekly across organic and paid.
• Iterative learning. Use what the data says to sharpen the next round of hooks, formats and posting experiments.
• Reporting. Report monthly on what worked, what died and what you are repeating.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS
Technical skills
• Video and photo software. Proficiency in mobile and desktop editors. CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Lightroom or Canva.
• Production fundamentals. Solid grasp of lighting, framing and clean mobile sound recording.
• Platform native literacy. Deep personal or professional familiarity with how TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube actually work.
• Copywriting. Hooks, captions and short scripts in plain English.
Soft skills
• Adaptability. Comfortable in a fast environment where priorities shift daily around what is trending.
• Storytelling. Turns brand messaging into human, entertaining content.
• People skills. Puts a stranger at ease on camera in two minutes.
• Resilience. Works early, works in the field, and keeps going when a post flops.
Other requirements
• Valid code B driver's licence, willingness to travel across South Africa and stay overnight where a shoot requires it
• Availability for early morning and occasional weekend shoots
• South African citizenship or a valid work permit
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
• Portfolio. A live portfolio or active social channel showing content you produced and the engagement it earned.
• Background. One to three years in digital marketing, video production or organic social media management. A relevant diploma or degree is an advantage, not a requirement.
• Paid exposure. Experience producing paid social or UGC ads, and reading creative performance data in Meta Ads Manager.
• Sector. Retail, apparel, agriculture, construction or industrial experience.
WORKING CONDITIONS
• Office based editing combined with regular field work on farms, construction sites, workshops and retail floors
• Travel is required, including overnight stays. Travel and accommodation costs are covered by the company
• Shoots may begin before sunrise. Hours are managed flexibly against a standard full time week
HOW TO APPLY
• A curriculum vitae of no more than two pages
• A link to a portfolio, showreel or social media account showing your own work

The Customer Service Technician will be responsible for ensuring the safe and efficient delivery and collection of products in both liquid and gaseous forms, via Orca tankers, cylinders, minitanks, and maxitanks, to and from customer sites and facilities.
The key responsibilities of the role include but are not limited to:
1. Responsible for Vehicle inspection pre- and post-journey.
2. Liquid Loading at depot and off-loading of vehicle at customer sites.
3. Ensure safe driving and manoeuvring of vehicle at assigned destinations.
4. Accurate completion of all paperwork and administrative requirements.
5. Adherence and compliance to all EHS&Q requirements.
6. Ad-hoc assistance with manual or forklift loading & delivery of cylinders from direct superior.

The Creditors Clerk will be responsible for managing the payment of accounts payable and ensuring accurate reconciliation of creditors’ statements with the payables ledger.
The key responsibilities for this role include but not limited to:
1. Ensure all invoices are processed promptly for payment.
2. Follow up on GRN’s, verify invoices against GRN’s and purchase orders, and clear items on the GRN listing.
3. Liaise with suppliers to ensure accurate recording of all required documentation for payments.
4. Reconcile accounts payable transactions, monitor payments, and resolve invoice discrepancies and related issues.
5. Ensure timely processing of BEE invoices for payment.
6. Assist auditors by providing necessary documentation.

job_title: Sales & Marketing Manager - Blackheath, Cape Town - Salary dependent on experience
about_role:
Sales & Marketing Manager - Blackheath, Cape Town - Salary dependent on experience
Drive sales growth and lead the sales and marketing function in a hands-on, commercially focused management opportunity.
About Our Client
Our client manufactures standard and custom-designed mobile products, including mobile toilets, showers, kitchens, offices, and site-based infrastructure solutions. The company provides specialized trailer-based units and custom solutions to B2B clients across various industries, including construction, mining, agriculture, and events.
The Role: Sales & Marketing Manager
This role exists to lead and manage the Sales & Marketing function while remaining actively involved in the full sales cycle. The position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, managing client relationships, driving sales through to closure, and overseeing the external website and SEO service provider to support lead generation and business growth.
Key Responsibilities
• Must have a minimum of 8–10 years’ proven sales experience, with strong exposure to B2B sales and new business development.
• Proactively identify, target, negotiate, and close new business opportunities to achieve company revenue and growth targets.
• Lead, coach, and manage a small Sales & Marketing team, setting objectives and monitoring performance against KPIs.
• Maintain and update the company price list while costing new, modified, and custom products based on materials, manufacturing requirements, and margins.
• Manage the external website, SEO, and digital marketing service provider, holding them accountable for deliverables, timelines, and search performance.
• Develop and execute sales and marketing strategies, including content creation, market research, client visits, cold calling, and pipeline management.
• Provide technical advice, practical solutions, and troubleshooting support to clients and internal sales teams.
• Prepare accurate sales forecasts and regular reports covering sales pipeline, performance, market opportunities, and digital marketing results.

·       Recommend financial solutions based on client needs
·       Seek expertise in internal resources to identify opportunities and solutions for clients
·       Maintain appropriate record-keeping and supervision files
·       Stay abreast of products, industry rules and regulations, and financial planning
·       Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

We are seeking an experienced Civil Construction Foreman to join our construction team in the Northern Cape.
The successful candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day supervision, coordination and execution of civil construction activities, ensuring projects are completed safely, within programme, budget and required quality standards.
Key responsibilities include:
• Manage day-to-day site activities across civil construction projects, including the supervision of labour, skilled workers, subcontractors and plant operations.
• Plan and organise daily crew activities, allocate tasks and monitor productivity to ensure work is completed according to the construction programme and budget.
• Supervise roadworks, earthworks, layerworks, stormwater and drainage works, concrete structures, building works and associated civil infrastructure.
• Review and interpret construction drawings, blueprints, specifications and technical documentation to determine work requirements, resources and construction activities.
• Coordinate the required labour, plant, materials and subcontractors for scheduled construction activities.
• Monitor construction levels, measurements, setting out and completed works against approved drawings and specifications.
• Prepare and maintain periodic site cost sheets and monitor site expenditure and resource utilisation.
• Identify operational challenges, inefficiencies and potential unnecessary costs and implement practical measures to minimise avoidable expenditure.
• Monitor project progress and maintain accurate daily site records, logs, labour records, plant usage and work-completed reports.
• Assess construction-related risks and implement appropriate measures to minimise operational, safety and project risks.
• Implement and monitor quality-control measures to ensure workmanship complies with project specifications and required construction standards.
• Enforce site health and safety procedures, PPE requirements and safe working practices.
• Identify and report construction defects, non-conformances, delays, plant breakdowns and other matters that may affect project delivery.
• Train, mentor and provide technical guidance to junior employees and construction team members.
• Monitor employee performance and provide constructive feedback where improvement or additional development is required.
• Liaise with the Site Agent, Construction Manager, Engineers, subcontractors and other project stakeholders regarding site progress and operational requirements.

We are seeking an experienced and certified Grader Operator x2 to join our construction team.
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
• Operating graders including CAT 140, CAT 140K, CAT 140H, Komatsu GD655 or similar equipment.
• Performing final trimming and levels to required specifications.
• Constructing and maintaining roads and haul roads.
• Preparing and maintaining stockpile and loading areas.
• Carrying out grading, levelling, shaping and surface preparation.
• Conducting daily pre-start inspections of the grader.
• Completing daily equipment inspection and operator checklists.
• Identifying and reporting mechanical defects or equipment faults.
• Ensuring equipment is operated in accordance with manufacturer and site requirements.
• Complying with all applicable site health and safety procedures.
• Complying with PPE requirements and company/site safety rules.
• Reporting equipment defects, damage and unsafe operating conditions immediately.
• Working shifts and overtime where operationally required.

The Chief Financial Officer is responsible for providing strategic and operational financial leadership across a multi-entity, project-driven business. The role oversees the full finance function, ensuring sound financial governance, accurate reporting, effective cash-flow and working-capital management, commercial decision-making, financial controls and regulatory compliance. • Provide strategic and hands-on financial leadership across the Group, including operating and project entities.

• Lead accurate monthly and annual financial close processes, Group consolidations, intercompany accounting, management reporting and annual financial statements.
• Manage audit preparation and ensure the finance function remains audit-ready.

• Develop financial and operational reporting to support informed business decision-making.
• Identify financial risks, trends and opportunities and provide recommendations to Executive Management and the Board.
• Lead, mentor and develop the finance team, promoting accountability, service excellence, professional development and continuous improvement.
• Build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including auditors, financial institutions, professional advisors and business partners.
• Ensure the finance function operates efficiently and supports the commercial and operational objectives of the business.

We are looking for a confident, customer-focused and highly communicative Customer Service Advocate to join our Service Centre team.
This role is ideal for someone who genuinely enjoys engaging with customers, solving problems and taking ownership of customer queries from start to finish. You will communicate with customers regarding repairs, quotations, parts availability and service updates, while ensuring that every interaction is handled professionally, accurately and within agreed service levels.
You will also play an important role in identifying potential customer concerns early and resolving them before they become formal complaints.
Key Responsibilities
• Handle inbound customer calls relating to repairs and service queries.
• Respond to customer emails and Zendesk cases promptly and professionally.
• Proactively contact customers regarding repair quotations and explain the quotation clearly.
• Follow up with customers regarding outstanding quotations and required decisions.
• Keep customers updated when repairs are awaiting parts, including providing updated expected timelines.
• Manage customer callback requests as a priority.
• Provide customers with clear and easy-to-understand information regarding their repair or service query.
• Prioritise telephonic customer engagement where appropriate and follow up conversations with written confirmation.
• Proactively identify possible customer complaints or escalations and work to resolve them before they escalate.
• Respond to formal customer complaints in line with company processes.
• Monitor customer feedback and highlight recurring customer concerns to the Customer Service Supervisor.
• Communicate effectively with technicians regarding customer queries, feedback and repair requirements.
• Escalate potential service issues to the Customer Service Supervisor when required.The KPA places a strong emphasis on proactive communication, including contacting quoted customers, responding to Zendesk cases within defined service levels, managing customers waiting for spares and maintaining strong inbound call performance.
Administration & System Management
• Accurately record all customer interactions on FileMaker and Zendesk.
• Ensure customer cases are correctly categorised and updated.
• Check quotations for accuracy before confirming acceptance with customers.
• Ensure repair statuses are updated correctly following customer feedback.
• Action all customer advocacy items appearing on the daily priority list.
• Ensure customer queries and actions remain within agreed service levels.
• Maintain accurate and complete customer records at all times.Accuracy is particularly important in this role, with the KPA requiring high levels of data accuracy across both FileMaker and Zendesk and daily completion of priority-list actions.
Customer Experience & Communication
We are looking for someone who can build trust with customers, particularly when dealing with complex or potentially frustrating service situations.
You will be expected to:
• Communicate professionally, confidently and empathetically.
• Listen carefully to understand the customer's concern.
• Explain technical or service-related information in a way the customer understands.
• Take ownership rather than simply passing queries on.
• Remain calm and solution-focused when dealing with unhappy customers.
• Follow through on commitments and customer callbacks.
• Ensure accurate communication between customers and technical teams.

Our client operates a tax or accounting practice environment. The firm handles an even split of tax profiles across Individuals, Trusts, Corporate Entities, and NPOs, ranging from simple to complex structures.
The Role: Tax Compliance Officer
The primary purpose of this role is back-office execution focused on the accurate preparation, timeous submission, and thorough SARS query management for a portfolio of roughly 300 clients. It exists to ensure strict compliance with statutory submission deadlines and to manage tax affairs across simple and complex tax profiles. Key focus areas include tax calculations, SARS administration, complex reconciliations, supporting documentation collation, and financial management calculations.

• Possess 3–5 years of proven tax compliance experience, ideally within a tax or accounting practice environment.

• Calculate third-period and additional top-up tax payments when required.

about_role:
EVA Shoe Injection Moulding Supervisor / Technician (JB6245)
Industria, Johannesburg
R30 - R35 000 CTC per month (depending on experience and technical ability)
Permanent
Seeking a hands-on EVA Injection Moulding Supervisor / Technician to operate, set up, troubleshoot and maintain EVA shoe-sole injection moulding machinery while supervising the production team.
This role combines practical machine fault-finding and repair with production supervision, operator training, quality control, safety and the achievement of daily production targets.
This is not a purely supervisory position. The successful candidate must personally diagnose and repair hydraulic, mechanical, basic electrical, temperature-control, injection and material-feeding faults. Candidates unable to troubleshoot and repair injection moulding machinery will not be suitable.
Minimum Requirements:
Grade 12 / Matric or equivalent; a mechanical, electrical, fitter or millwright qualification will be advantageous.
Minimum 3 to 5 years' practical experience with injection moulding machinery; EVA footwear or sole production, Chinese EVA machines, mould changes and EVA raw materials will be highly advantageous.
Demonstrated ability to diagnose machine faults, carry out first-line repairs and return machinery to production - essential.
Strong mechanical and hydraulic troubleshooting experience, including pumps, valves, cylinders, hoses, motors, couplings and bearings.
Basic electrical and PLC fault-finding ability covering switches, sensors, relays, contactors, wiring, heating elements and temperature controllers.
Able to set operating parameters, injection pressure, timing, temperatures, hydraulic pressure and moulding cycles.
Experience supervising production employees, allocating staff, monitoring performance and training machine operators.
Able to identify production and quality problems caused by the machine, mould, material, operator or process.
Able to read technical manuals, keep accurate records and follow machine-safety, isolation, PPE, guarding, emergency-stop and hydraulic-pressure-release procedures.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Start, operate and shut down EVA injection moulding machines correctly and ensure consistent, safe production output.
Set and adjust machine parameters, injection pressure, timing, temperatures, hydraulic pressure, moulding cycles, moulds and material feeding.
Monitor production cycles and identify abnormal noises, leaks, pressure changes, temperature fluctuations and other signs of machine failure.
Diagnose hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, temperature-control, injection-system and material-feeding faults and carry out repairs or adjustments within the limits of competence.
Safely isolate machinery, identify the likely cause and provide accurate technical information when specialist assistance is required, then assist with and test completed repairs.
Complete daily machine inspections and preventative maintenance covering oil levels, lubrication, hoses, fittings, electrical connections, pumps, motors, heating systems, clamping systems, safety switches and emergency stops.
Identify worn components before failure, maintain the preventative-maintenance schedule and keep accurate breakdown, repair and maintenance records.
Allocate operators and production employees to machines and workstations and ensure production schedules and daily targets are followed.
Monitor attendance, punctuality, machine utilisation, hourly output, downtime, bottlenecks, material wastage, rejection rates and employee productivity.
Train operators on the correct and safe use of machinery, prevent unauthorised machine adjustments and ensure only competent employees operate equipment.
Inspect finished EVA products for incomplete injection, deformation, bubbles, overheating, colour, dimensions, surface defects, flash, weight and mould-definition problems.
Determine whether quality defects are caused by the machine, material, mould, operator or process and implement corrective action.
Enforce PPE, guarding, emergency-stop, housekeeping and machine-isolation requirements and immediately stop unsafe work practices.
Report accidents, near misses, dangerous conditions, significant production failures and extended breakdowns to management without delay.
Maintain daily production, machine-operation, downtime, wastage, quality, rejection, attendance and inspection records and submit accurate reports to management.

If you thrive in a bustling, fast-paced retail trade environment and have hands-on experience managing point-of-sale controls, daily cashing up, banking, debtor accounts, and supplier reconciliations up to Trial Balance, this is an exceptional opportunity. Reporting to the Store Manager with direct dotted-line reporting to Head Office Finance, you will enforce strict financial discipline, maintain tight internal controls across the sales counter and warehouse, and confidently handle retail operating hours (including rostered Saturday shifts).

- Career Advancement: Potential growth and long-term stability within a reputable, expanding automotive parts group.

- Environment: Fast-paced, vibrant retail shop counter and parts warehouse environment.
