Role Overview:
Job Title: Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Officer (Sole Administrator / Structured Multi-Site)
Industry Sector: Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) Manufacturing & Logistics
Location: Kempton Park (Based at main manufacturing plant, with planned weekly travel to a nearby local satellite site)
Reports to: Technical Manager
Primary Purpose of the Role:
Position requires a highly organized, completely hands-on HSE Officer to take full, end-to-end ownership of our health, safety, and environmental portfolio. In this role, you are the entire department. There is no administrative backup. You will spend the majority of your week managing the high-speed machinery risks, waste streams, and digital compliance tracking at our main FMCG manufacturing plant. Additionally, you will provide critical safety oversight at our nearby satellite facility. This satellite site is unstaffed; you will coordinate with one other mobile staff member to travel there during specific loading and offloading windows, which are planned and scheduled a week in advance, allowing you to structure your time efficiently.
Key Responsibilities & Focus Areas:
1. Multi-Site Digital System Management:
Personally design, build, and populate a centralized, cloud-based digital safety file and legal register covering both facilities.
Act as the sole gatekeeper of this system, ensuring that any compliance document, training certificate, or permit for either site can be pulled up in under two minutes during an audit.
Maintain clear, digital tracking dashboards so management always has instant visibility of safety and waste metrics across both locations.
2. Dual-Site Floor-Level Risk Management & Scheduled Oversight:
Primary FMCG Plant: Manage the daily high-speed manufacturing hazards, machinery risks, and floor safety. Physically integrate daily safety checks into the factory’s visual management and 6S floor routines.
Satellite Facility (Planned Weekly): Review the advance logistics schedule and coordinate with the other mobile staff member to be physically present at the satellite site during designated loading/offloading windows. Oversee heavy vehicle safety, securing of loads, and safe material handling.
Personally lead and document every single incident or near-miss investigation across both sites using Lean tools like the 5 Whys.
3. Hands-On Waste Management & Environmental Compliance:
Physically monitor and manage our manufacturing waste streams at the main plant, ensuring hazardous, general, and recyclable materials are properly separated at the source.
Take full ownership of our third-party waste vendors, tracking every single shipment and personally indexing all Safe Disposal Certificates (Waste Manifests) to keep both sites fully compliant with NEMWA.
Constantly look for practical ways on the factory floor to reduce raw material scrap and packaging waste.
4. Administering Training, Appointments & COID:
Organize and manage our on-site statutory structures, ensuring all SHE Representatives, First Aiders, and Fire Marshals are trained and legally appointed.
Own and update the digital training matrix, proactively identifying upcoming certificate expirations and scheduling training before lapses occur.
Personally handle the entire administrative process for injury-on-duty (IOD) claims across both sites, submitting all Annexure 1 and W.Cl.2 files directly to the Compensation Commissioner online within 24 hours.

Dis-Chem Pharmacies has a an opportunity for a security guard to Render a security service in terms of the Private Security Industry Regulations Act 56 of 2001 as amended for the Dis-Chem Group that meets Dis-Chem’ security requirements to protect assets, property and staff by creating a safe and secure environment, through identifying signs of criminal activities or disorder and investigating disturbances while adhering to legislation relevant to the industry and best practice.
Minimum Requirements…
Essential:
• Grade 12 – Matric or a Senior Certificate
• Grade C accreditation with the PSIRA
• A general minimum exposure of at least 3 years in the retail industry, such as shopping malls and warehouses
Advantageous:
• At least 1 year specific previous experience in a similar role
Job Specification…
• Be vigilant and alert of surroundings to identify suspicious activities and apprehend criminals or remove violators according to the legal authority invested in the industry and Dis-Chem standard operating procedures for the specific post through.
• Random patrols of the premises on regularly basis to ensure optimal visibility and reduce risks.
• Monitor and control access to the premises by documenting and regulating entrance into the site by vehicles or pedestrian’s access points to allow entry only to individuals with the correct authorization.
• Investigate and report signs of damage or unlawful entry as it occurs to management and act accordingly in the best interest of protecting Dis-Chem assets.
• Be clearly visible as far as reasonably possible as deterrent to discourage criminal activities, prevent theft, - damage, - personal injury, and other dishonourable acts.
• Be professionally courteous and friendly, approachable, and willing to help others when receiving guests, customers and employees.
• Access control – searching of staff, suppliers and company merchandisers.
• Maintain and complete all registers and occurrence books.
• Cancel staff purchasers and goods declared.
• Supervise and check refuse removal according to Dis-Chem standards
• Protect the property and assets of the business from all dishonest persons, action or any acts of malicious behaviour that could result in the company suffering loss.
• Be present at your post at all times when on duty.
• Practice good customer service relations for all Dis-Chem internal and external customers.
• Report any unusual or suspicious behaviour by staff, customer or suppliers.
• Opening and closing procedures-to be present observant and vigilant at the opening and closing of the site.
• Ensure that all doors and windows are locked at the end each day.
• Ensure that all water taps turned off when applicable.
• Do continuous personnel frisking and searches on a daily basis.
• Do thorough and proper vehicle searches throughout the day.
• Report any suspicious incidents verbally to management in detail with the submission of a written detailed report as soon as conveniently possible.
• Contact policing and emergency authorities and make written or verbal reports to law enforcement officers when needed as legally required and in accordance of Dis-Chem procedures.
• When problem situations or crisis arise or have been dealt with to maintain observing surroundings and report to management on findings and or changes in identified that intensify the situation.
• After a crisis, report the incident to management, the police or the appropriate authorities (such as the fire services in the case of a fire outbreak) with a detailed written report concerning the incident and your activities around the incident.
• Monitor the alarm systems and or video cameras and operate detecting/ emergency equipment when needed.
• When working during the night or alone e.g. after hours render on-going surveillance of the premises by patrolling the grounds and using closed-circuit camera monitoring or alarm systems to detect and investigate suspicious activities to ensure that only legal entrance to the premises is maintained.
• In emergency situations provide assistance and the emergency teams e.g. alert first responders, clinic sisters, managers etc.
• Maintain order during evacuation procedures and at assembly points by providing exact directions or decisive actions to ensure the safety of lives and property by preventing stampedes and breakdown of law and order or illegal entrance to the premises.
• Offer on-going security advice and safety warnings and tips to ensure that all security and safety precautions are adhered to.
• Be vigilant - watch out for any suspicious activities that may mean a breach in security measures that have been put in place on the site.
• Interpret quickly whatever is seen and act accordingly.
• Respond quickly and correctly during crisis - be alert to avoid being caught unaware.
• Know how best to respond to various dangerous situations according to industry and Dis-Chem standard operating procedures.
• Getting help - During some very dangerous situations (such as armed robbery attacks or assaults with deadly weapons), waste no time in calling the police to prevent loss of lives or property.
• Take accurate notes of unusual occurrences and daily activities.
• Enforce rules and regulations to prevent criminal activity before it happens.
• Perform special duties - receive phone calls, respond to text and email messages, and run vital errands for the department according to Dis-Chem and industry standard operating procedures.
Competencies
Essential:
• PSIRA knowledge
• Fire emergency and relevant Health and Safety Training and exposure
• English – Read, write and speak well as it is the organization’s official language.Advantageous:
• 3rd LanguageSpecial conditions of employment:
• PSIRA registered.
• Grade C PSIRA accreditation.
• South African
• MIE, clear criminal and credit.
• Driver’s license and own reliable transport and PDP when deployed as a driver.
Remuneration and benefits:
• Market related salary
• Kaelo
• Provident fund (PSSPF)
ONLY SUCCESSFUL APPLICANTS WILL BE CONTACTED. IF YOU HAVEN`T BEEN CONTACTED WITHIN TWO WEEKS AFTER THE CLOSING DATE CONSIDER YOUR APPLICATION AS UNSUCCESSFUL.

VACANCY: COMMERCIAL ADMINISTRATOR
Location: Cornubia, Durban, KwaZulu-Natal
Employment Type: Permanent
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 08h00-17h00
Start Date: As soon as possible
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
The Commercial Administrator will provide comprehensive administrative and transactional support to the business, with a particular focus on RFQs, quotations, tender administration, purchase orders, invoicing and commercial documentation.
The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Finance, Procurement, Operations, Warehouse, Customer Support and other internal departments to ensure that commercial and administrative processes are completed accurately, efficiently and within required deadlines.
The role requires a highly organised, detail-oriented and proactive individual who is comfortable working with multiple priorities and handling confidential customer, supplier and commercial information.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Commercial Administration
• Provide day-to-day commercial and administrative support to the business and relevant departments.
• Administer Requests for Quotations (RFQs) from receipt through to completion.
• Prepare, capture, distribute and maintain accurate customer quotations.
• Follow up on outstanding quotations and provide relevant stakeholders with status updates.
• Process and maintain purchase orders, sales documentation and related commercial records.
• Ensure that pricing, product information, supporting documentation and approvals are accurate before submission.
• Liaise with Sales, Finance, Procurement, Operations and Warehouse teams to resolve commercial and administrative queries.
RFQ & Tender Administration
• Coordinate and administer RFQ and tender documentation.
• Ensure all required information, supporting documents, pricing and approvals are obtained before submission.
• Maintain accurate registers and trackers for RFQs, tenders, quotations and submission deadlines.
• Monitor tender and RFQ deadlines and proactively follow up with internal stakeholders.
• Assist with the preparation, formatting, collation and submission of tender documentation.
• Maintain an organised electronic filing system for completed and pending tenders and RFQs.
• Ensure that submitted documentation is complete, accurate, appropriately authorised and submitted within required timeframes.
• Track outcomes and maintain records of tender and RFQ submissions.
Invoicing & Transactional Administration
• Assist with the preparation and processing of customer invoices.
• Capture and verify invoice information accurately.
• Match and reconcile relevant quotations, purchase orders, delivery documentation and invoices where required.
• Liaise with Finance regarding invoicing queries, discrepancies and outstanding documentation.
• Follow up on missing or incomplete transactional documentation.
• Maintain accurate records of invoices and supporting commercial documentation.
General Administration & Document Control
• Maintain accurate electronic and manual filing systems.
• Capture, update and verify information on company systems, registers, trackers and spreadsheets.
• Maintain accurate customer and supplier information.
• Compile routine reports and provide administrative information as required.
• Track outstanding documentation, approvals, action items and deadlines.
• Ensure documents are correctly named, filed, version-controlled and readily accessible.
• Check documentation for completeness, accuracy and authorisation before submission.
• Assist with internal reviews, audits and compliance-related documentation.
Customer & Supplier Support
• Respond professionally to routine customer and supplier enquiries.
• Provide customers with quotation, order and documentation updates where required.
• Liaise with suppliers and internal departments regarding documentation and transactional queries.
• Ensure customer and supplier information is maintained accurately and confidentially.
• Escalate queries or issues to the relevant department or manager when required.
• Maintain a high standard of customer service in all written, telephonic and face-to-face communication.
Internal Coordination
• Work collaboratively with Finance, Sales, Procurement, Operations, Warehouse, Technical, Regulatory, Customer Support and other departments.
• Follow up with relevant stakeholders on outstanding information, approvals and documentation.
• Assist with coordinating administrative processes across multiple departments.
• Identify discrepancies, delays or missing information and escalate these promptly.
• Support management with reporting, document preparation and general commercial administration.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
• Grade 12 / Matric.
• A certificate, diploma or qualification in Business Administration, Commercial Administration, Office Administration, Finance or a related field will be advantageous.
• Minimum 2-3 years' relevant experience in commercial administration, sales administration, tender administration, quotations, invoicing or a similar role.
• Proven experience administering RFQs, quotations and/or tenders.
• Experience with invoicing, purchase orders and commercial documentation.
• Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
• Experience working on an ERP, CRM or business management system; Zoho experience will be advantageous.
• Experience within the medical, pharmaceutical, healthcare, distribution or regulated environment will be advantageous.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Strong numerical and administrative accuracy.
• A valid driver's licence will be advantageous.
KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
The successful candidate should demonstrate:
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong organisational and time-management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple RFQs, quotations, tenders and administrative tasks simultaneously.
• Strong follow-up and deadline-management skills.
• Ability to work under pressure and meet strict submission deadlines.
• Good numerical and data-capturing ability.
• Strong document management and filing skills.
• Professional written and verbal communication.
• Strong customer-service orientation.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
• Proactive and solutions-focused approach.
• High level of confidentiality and discretion.
• Sound judgement and problem-solving ability.
• Reliable, accountable and adaptable work ethic.
WORKING CONDITIONS
• Office-based position at Tara Healthcare's Cornubia, Durban office.
• Monday to Friday, 08h00-17h00.
• Fast-paced commercial and healthcare environment.
• The role requires the ability to manage competing priorities and meet time-sensitive RFQ, tender and commercial deadlines.
IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
The ideal candidate will be an experienced Commercial Administrator who is comfortable working across the full administrative and transactional cycle.
They should have practical experience with RFQs, tenders, quotations, purchase orders and invoicing, combined with strong administrative discipline and attention to detail. The successful candidate should be proactive, deadline-driven and confident communicating with internal departments, customers and suppliers.
Experience in a healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, distribution or other regulated environment would be advantageous.
APPLICATION
If you are an organised and detail-oriented Commercial Administrator with experience in RFQs, tenders, quotations and invoicing, and are looking for an opportunity to join a leading healthcare organisation, we encourage you to apply.

• Industry financing in terms of the industry's statutory requirements.
• Market related risks such as exchange rates and interest.
• Key banking relationships to negotiate banking facilities.
• Ad-hoc expert financial and treasury services to SASA divisions and the industry such as reviewing major financing decisions, internal financing arrangements etc.
This unique position will put you at the heart of both SASA and the decision-making processes of the sugar industry partnership between the growers and millers. It will provide you the opportunity of applying your financial, banking and treasury skills.

A person with good stature who is comfortable dealing with senior management and who likes to work with established procedures and regulations and pay close attention to detail is needed.
Reporting to the Finance Director, the main purpose of this position is to perform the role of a Treasury Manager. The key objectives of this position together with the assistance of a Treasury Planning Officer are as follows:
Management of Treasury Process

Management of Treasury Process
• Manage the treasury process by ensuring that it is regularised and effectively manages SASA's working capital requirements, liability management and exposure to market related risks, such as currency and interest rate risks:

Industry Financing

Banking and Banking Relationships

External Borrowings, Investments & Loans
• Manage external borrowings, internal and external investments and internal loans.
Secretariat and Compliance

Hedging Mandates

QC PAINTING INSPECTOR
1. JOB PURPOSE
The QC Painting Inspector is responsible for ensuring that painted and sandblasted components meet the Company’s established quality standards, OEM specifications, customer requirements and applicable industry standards before products are released for further processing or dispatch.
The position is responsible for inspecting surface preparation and coating quality through various inspection and testing methods, accurately recording inspection results, identifying non-conformances and ensuring that corrective actions are implemented where required.
The QC Painting Inspector plays a critical role in maintaining the quality, durability and integrity of painted components manufactured and supplied by the Company.
2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
2.1 Quality Inspection and Testing
• Conduct Brinell Hardness Tests on applicable components to verify that material hardness meets specified requirements.
• Conduct Dry Film Thickness (DFT) tests on painted components to ensure coating thickness complies with OEM, customer and internal specifications.
• Conduct surface roughness/profile tests on sandblasted components to ensure the required surface preparation standard has been achieved before painting.
• Conduct dust tests to verify that surfaces are sufficiently clean and free from dust and other contaminants before coating.
• Conduct visual inspections of painted components for defects, including but not limited to:
• Runs and sags
• Orange peel
• Uneven coating
• Pinholes
• Blistering
• Peeling
• Poor coverage
• Contamination
• Overspray
• Incorrect colour or finish
• Damage to the coating
• Verify that components have been correctly prepared prior to painting.
• Confirm that the correct paint/coating system has been applied in accordance with the applicable specification.
• Inspect components at various stages of the painting process where required.2.2 Quality Documentation and Record Keeping
• Accurately record all inspection and test results.
• Complete QC inspection reports, checklists and relevant quality documentation.
• Maintain accurate records of DFT, surface profile, dust and hardness testing.
• Ensure inspection records are completed accurately, legibly and timeously.
• Maintain traceability of inspection results to the relevant component, job, order or serial number.
• Report quality issues and non-conformances to the relevant Supervisor, QC Manager or responsible department.
• Ensure that inspection equipment readings and results are properly documented.2.3 Non-Conformance Control
• Identify and report defective or non-conforming components.
• Place non-conforming products on hold where required and prevent them from being released without the necessary approval.
• Assist with investigations into painting and surface-preparation defects.
• Assist with determining possible root causes of recurring quality issues.
• Monitor corrective actions and verify that defects have been rectified before final approval.
• Escalate serious or repeated quality concerns to management.2.4 Compliance
• Ensure all inspections and tests are conducted in accordance with:
• Company quality procedures;
• Applicable industry standards;
• OEM specifications;
• Customer specifications;
• Approved coating specifications; and
• Relevant inspection procedures.
• Ensure inspection equipment is used correctly and maintained in accordance with Company requirements.
• Verify that measuring and testing equipment is within its required calibration period.
• Immediately report damaged, defective or out-of-calibration inspection equipment.2.5 Production and Operational Support
• Work closely with the Painting Department, Production, Quality Control and other relevant departments to resolve quality issues.
• Provide feedback to painters and supervisors regarding recurring coating defects.
• Assist production personnel in understanding applicable quality requirements.
• Conduct inspections within required production timelines without compromising quality standards.
• Assist with customer or third-party inspections when required.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing painting defects, rework and customer complaints.3. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
Minimum Requirements
• Matric / Grade 12.
• Previous experience in a quality control, painting inspection, coating inspection or manufacturing environment will be advantageous.
• Experience working with inspection and measuring equipment will be advantageous.
• Knowledge of painting and surface preparation processes will be advantageous.
• Knowledge of slurry pumps, castings, fabricated components or industrial equipment will be advantageous.4. REQUIRED SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
• Excellent attention to detail.
• Strong quality awareness.
• Ability to identify defects and deviations from specifications.
• Good numerical and measurement skills.
• Ability to accurately interpret specifications and inspection requirements.
• Good written and verbal communication skills.
• Good administrative and record-keeping skills.
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
• Ability to work under pressure and meet production deadlines.
• Ability to work effectively within a team.
• Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
• High level of accuracy and consistency.
• Ability to maintain professional relationships with production and operational staff.
• Computer literacy, particularly Microsoft Excel and relevant quality systems, will be advantageous.

Job Title: Expeditor
Location: Rustenburg

Job Duties:
1. Tracking Orders and Deliveries
An expeditor ensures that materials, equipment, or services are delivered on time. They monitor purchase orders and follow up with suppliers to avoid delays.
2. Supplier Coordination
They act as the link between the company and suppliers—checking progress, confirming timelines, and resolving issues that could impact delivery.
3. Schedule Management
Expeditors make sure procurement aligns with the project schedule. If something is late, they escalate and push for faster turnaround.
4. Problem Solving
When delays or shortages occur, the expeditor finds solutions—alternative suppliers, revised delivery plans, or prioritising critical items.
5. Documentation & Reporting
They maintain records of orders, delivery dates, and supplier performance, and provide regular updates to project managers or procurement teams.
6. Quality & Compliance Checks
In some roles, they verify that goods meet required specifications before dispatch or upon arrival.
7. Site Coordination (in construction/projects)
They ensure materials arrive at the right place, at the right time, and in the correct quantities to avoid site downtime.

· Good planning and organisational ability

CFW Environmental, part of the established CFW Industries Group, has been delivering engineering solutions since 1966. We specialise in air systems and ventilation engineering, with extensive experience across the mining, power generation, industrial processing, agricultural, marine/fishing, poultry, commercial and HVAC sectors.
Our projects are typically large-scale and turnkey, taking clients from design and engineering through to manufacture, installation and commissioning.
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on HVAC Installation Project Manager to take responsibility for one of our two dedicated site installation teams.
This is a key role within our growing business and would suit someone who enjoys being on site, solving problems, coordinating people and equipment, and taking ownership of getting projects completed safely, efficiently and to a high standard.
The Role
As Site Manager, you will take ownership of the day-to-day execution of ventilation and HVAC installation projects. You will work closely with our Mechanical Engineers, Project Managers, Production Manager and Draftsmen to ensure projects move efficiently from planning through to successful completion.
Key responsibilities include:
• Manage the day-to-day activities of ventilation, HVAC and ducting installation projects.
• Lead, coordinate and motivate a dedicated site installation team.
• Plan and coordinate site activities to ensure projects are completed on time and within requirements.

• Monitor project progress and provide regular updates to management and relevant stakeholders.
• Identify potential delays, risks and issues and take proactive action to resolve them.

• Ensure effective communication between the site team, engineering, production and project management.
• Assist with the successful handover and commissioning of completed installations.

• Proven experience managing mechanical, HVAC, ventilation or ducting installation projects.
• Strong ducting installation experience is essential.
• Experience managing and coordinating site installation teams.
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and engineering plans.

job_title: Junior Specialist: Identity & Access Management (Azure / Entra ID) & Security
about_role:
homechoice is a leading South African homeware retailer. For over 40 years we’ve helped our customers create beautiful homes they love with an innovative range of quality products they can afford.
We're looking for a security-minded, detail-oriented Specialist to join our IT Infrastructure team, focused primarily on Identity & Access Management and security within our Microsoft Azure / Entra ID environment. This is a junior-to-intermediate role: the core work is managing who has access to what, ensuring it's appropriate and secure, and helping strengthen our overall identity security posture.
It's an excellent growth opportunity. While the primary focus is cloud identity and access, you'll also be exposed to our wider environment, on-premises Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Intune, and server and storage infrastructure, so you can broaden your skills and build a strong all-round foundation over time, supported by our senior specialists.
Where the role fits
You'll report to the Infrastructure Team Leader and work as part of the infrastructure team. Although the Service Desk is not a primary function of this role, you'll work closely with them on access-related requests and escalations, and you'll collaborate regularly with the security team, HR, application owners and the rest of infrastructure. Clear communication and a careful, trustworthy approach matter as much as technical ability.
What you will love doing in this role
Primary focus — Azure / Entra ID access management & security
• Administer identity and access in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD): user and group lifecycle, role assignments, and entitlement/access-package management.
• Grant, review and revoke access strictly in line with approved requests, applying least-privilege and Zero Trust principles.
• Support and help maintain Conditional Access policies, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and authentication methods.
• Support Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and privileged-access requests and approval workflows.
• Assist with identity governance: access reviews, certification campaigns and segregation-of-duties (SoD) controls.
• Help monitor and respond to identity-related security alerts, report security incidents, and support security-posture improvements (e.g. Microsoft Secure Score).
• Maintain accurate records and support audit and compliance activities, handling personal information in line with POPIA.Broader exposure & growth (with mentoring)
• On-premises Active Directory: user and group objects, password resets, and hybrid identity (synchronisation with Entra ID).
• Microsoft 365 administration: licensing, groups, and everyday service administration.
• Microsoft Intune / endpoint management: device compliance and policy basics.
• Server hardware and storage: hands-on exposure to on-premises infrastructure to build broader foundational knowledge.Collaboration & ways of working
• Work closely with the Service Desk on access-related requests and escalations (this is a key partnership, though not the primary function of the role).
• Collaborate with the security team, HR, application owners and infrastructure colleagues.
• Log and track work in the ITSM tool (Halo) and follow incident, request and change procedures.
• Take part in knowledge-sharing and process-improvement initiatives.
What you’ll need to do this role
• Matric / Grade 12.
• Around 3 to 5 years' experience in IT, with hands-on exposure to identity and access administration, ideally in Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD.
• A solid grasp of access fundamentals: least privilege, role-based access, approvals and MFA.
• Familiarity with Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
• A careful, accurate and security-minded approach to handling access and sensitive data.
• Good communication and collaboration skills.
• The right to work in South Africa, and willingness to undergo pre-employment vetting.
Advantageous (preferred, not essential)
• A relevant IT qualification (certificate, diploma or degree).
• Relevant certifications, for example SC-300 (Identity & Access Administrator), SC-900, AZ-900, AZ-500, AZ-104, MS-900 or ITIL Foundation.
• Exposure to Conditional Access, PIM, or identity governance / access reviews.
• Exposure to Intune, hybrid identity, or on-premises server and storage environments.
• Experience with Halo (or a similar ITSM tool).
What we will love about you
Core technical
• Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) identity and access administration; user, group and role management.
• Role-based access control and least-privilege provisioning; access reviews and approvals.
• Working (or growing) knowledge of MFA, Conditional Access and privileged access concepts.
• Basic identity security monitoring and an understanding of good security hygiene.Areas you'll grow into
• On-premises Active Directory and hybrid identity.
• Microsoft 365 and Intune administration.
• Server hardware and storage fundamentals.Behavioural
• Security-minded and meticulous — the kind of person who double-checks before changing access.
• Curious and eager to learn across new technologies.
• Trustworthy and discreet with confidential information.
• A clear communicator and willing collaborator.
Behaviors we love

• Walk in my customers’ shoes

• Treat the business as my own
• Take accountability

job_title: Senior Application Support Engineer – Client Platform
about_role:
Our client is seeking a technically strong Senior Application Support Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of enterprise client deployments and complex production issues. This is not a traditional help-desk role; the successful candidate will work across C#, Vue.js, Electron, .NET, Windows, Linux, networking and Azure observability to diagnose problems in environments outside of direct organisational control.
Key Responsibilities
• Act as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise clients experiencing application and deployment issues.
• Own remote support cases from initial triage through verified resolution and provide clear written root-cause summaries.
• Lead remote installations, upgrades and post-deployment validation within corporate environments.
• Diagnose issues across the application, desktop client, server application and surrounding infrastructure.
• Read and interpret C# application code, stack traces and logs to identify probable root causes.
• Diagnose Vue.js and Electron issues using browser DevTools, including renderer/main-process failures, IPC issues, packaging, code signing and auto-updates.
• Troubleshoot the .NET Server Connect application across Windows and Linux environments.
• Investigate firewalls, proxies, certificate trust chains, TLS, allowlisting and network-path issues.
• Use Azure Monitor and Log Analytics to investigate telemetry and operational issues.
• Develop PowerShell and/or Bash scripts to automate recurring diagnostics.
• Distinguish between configuration, environment and genuine product issues and escalate with structured reproduction information where required.
• Identify recurring problems and drive permanent improvements through product changes, documentation or installation processes.
• Contribute to small bug fixes and stability improvements across C#, Vue.js/Electron and, secondarily, Angular.
• Participate in occasional escalation support for confirmed client incidents outside standard South African business hours.
• Contribute to Azure networking discussions and feed recurring technical issues into engineering planning.
Essential Requirements
• 5+ years' experience in technical support, solutions engineering, platform engineering or a related technical role.
• At least 2 years' client-facing experience.
• Hands-on C# experience sufficient to read, debug and interpret application code, stack traces and logs.
• Strong Vue.js and Electron diagnostic experience.
• Experience debugging Electron main/renderer processes, IPC, packaging and auto-update issues.
• Working knowledge of Angular, including components, services, routing and state management, with the ability to make small bug fixes.
• Comfortable working from the command line across both Windows and Linux.
• Experience installing, configuring and troubleshooting .NET applications in Windows and/or Linux environments.
• Proven experience diagnosing enterprise networking issues involving firewalls, proxies, certificates, PKI, TLS, allowlisting and network paths.
• Proficiency with Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
• Experience conducting remote installations and technical troubleshooting sessions with enterprise IT teams.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to take ownership of complex issues and drive them through to resolution.
Advantageous
• Azure networking experience, including VNets, NSGs, private endpoints, Azure DNS and Application Gateway.
• Electron packaging, code signing and auto-update experience.
• Linux administration, including systemd, journald and package management.
• PowerShell and/or Bash scripting.
• Enterprise PKI and certificate management.
• Azure Entra ID, SAML or OIDC/SSO experience.
• Basic SQL knowledge.
• Azure certifications such as AZ-900, AZ-104 or AZ-204.

Our client is seeking an experienced Python / Spark / AI Developer to help replatform legacy T-SQL workloads onto modern Spark and Delta Lake pipelines while developing robust APIs and AI-enabled capabilities. This intermediate-to-senior role is suited to a developer who is comfortable working autonomously in a specification-driven environment and delivering production-quality, well-tested code.
Key Responsibilities
• Build production-grade Spark/PySpark pipelines using Delta Lake.
• Replatform legacy T-SQL logic into Spark SQL while preserving functional parity.
• Develop modern, type-safe Python using strong testing and static-analysis practices.
• Build REST APIs using FastAPI or equivalent frameworks.
• Implement authentication, idempotency and reliable job-status semantics.
• Validate migrated pipelines against legacy systems and provide evidence of output parity.
• Work from design documents and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
• Contribute tests and documentation alongside code changes.
• Participate in Git-based, PR-driven development and CI processes.
Essential Requirements
• 4+ years' professional Python development experience.
• 2+ years' production experience building Spark/PySpark or comparable distributed data pipelines.
• Strong Python 3.12 experience, including type hints, Pydantic, modern packaging and static analysis.
• Strong Apache Spark/PySpark knowledge, including DataFrame API, Spark SQL, partitioning and performance tuning.
• Understanding of Spark driver/executor architecture and Spark Connect.
• Production experience with Delta Lake or equivalent lakehouse technologies such as Iceberg or Hudi.
• Strong SQL skills and the ability to translate legacy T-SQL logic into Spark SQL.
• Experience with MERGE operations, schema evolution, idempotent writes, hashing, surrogate keys and deduplication.
• Strong automated testing experience using pytest.
• REST API development experience, preferably with FastAPI.
• Experience with Docker-based development environments.
• Strong Git and CI/CD discipline, including linting, type-checking and automated testing.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience.
• Ability to work independently from written specifications and technical requirements.
Advantageous
• LLM integration and AI feature development.
• Experience with Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, LM Studio or hosted AI APIs.
• Data governance, PII protection and privacy engineering.
• Experience with Hive Metastore, Trino or Apache Ranger.
• Azure data technologies including ADLS Gen2, Synapse/ADF, Key Vault or Service Bus.
• Observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, OpenLineage or structured logging.
• Data migration and output-parity experience.
• Databricks Certified Developer for Apache Spark or equivalent certification.

1.Implement Lean Practices:
Lean Warehousing focuses on waste reduction, continuous improvement, and employee involvement.
ABC analysis to prioritize inventory based on demand/movement.
Warehouse Layout Optimization to reduce travel time and streamline workflows.
Streamline workflows: Map out your processes, identify and eliminate unnecessary steps, and use lean practices to reduce waste and improve efficiency.
2. Invest in Technology:
Investing in warehouse technology can significantly boost efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction through solutions like automation, AI, and real-time inventory tracking
Warehouse Management System (WMS): fully integrate and digital system to enable real-time visibility, accurate inventory tracking, and automated rule-based task allocation.
ePOD system to increase efficiency at stock hand over point, reduce costs of paperwork, and mitigate against PODs getting lost.
Delivery Management System (DMS): to optimize and automate the delivery process from start to finish.
Paperless environment.
3. Implement Warehouse Metrics and KPI:
Managing a warehouse and its logistics requires a core set of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to monitor efficiency, control costs, and ensure customer satisfaction. These essential metrics can be broken down by category, providing a comprehensive view of the entire operation.
Inventory Management KPIs:
These metrics help you control costs associated with holding inventory.
Inventory accuracy: Compares your recorded inventory with the physical count. High accuracy (ideally 100%) is crucial for preventing errors and stockouts.
Carrying cost of inventory: The total cost of owning, storing, and holding inventory over a period. This includes costs for capital, insurance, storage, and potential obsolescence.
Inventory shrinkage: Represents the value of lost inventory due to theft, damage, or administrative errors. A low shrinkage rate indicates good inventory control.
Warehouse capacity usage: Warehouse capacity utilisation measures the percentage of available warehouse space that is currently being used.
Receiving and Putaway KPIs:
These metrics measure the efficiency of getting inbound goods processed and onto warehouse shelves.
Receiving efficiency: Assesses the productivity of your receiving team by measuring the volume of inventory received against labor hours.
Receiving cycle time (Dock-to-stock): The average time from when goods arrive at the dock until they are stored and ready for sale. Shorter times indicate greater efficiency.
Putaway accuracy rate: The percentage of items placed in their correct storage location on the first attempt. High accuracy is key to preventing picking errors later.
Dock door utilization: Measures the percentage of loading docks being used during receiving or shipping hours. High utilization can indicate a need to expand, while low utilization may point to scheduling issues.
Order fulfilment and picking KPIs:
These indicators measure the speed, accuracy, and overall cost of fulfilling customer orders.
Order picking accuracy: The percentage of orders picked without any item errors. High accuracy is essential for customer satisfaction and avoiding costly returns.
Order fill rate: The percentage of orders that can be completely filled from existing stock. A low rate can point to inventory management or stockout issues.
Internal order cycle time: The time from when an order is placed to when it is ready for dispatch from the warehouse. A shorter cycle time leads to faster deliveries.
Picking productivity: The number of orders picked per hour. This is a primary metric for gauging the efficiency of your picking team.
Cost per order: The total warehouse costs associated with fulfilling a single customer order. This financial metric helps track and reduce operational expenses.
Perfect order rate: The percentage of orders that are delivered on time, in full, with no damage, and with accurate documentation.
Shipping and transportation KPIs:
These metrics focus on outbound logistics, measuring delivery performance and transportation costs.
On-time delivery (OTD): The percentage of orders delivered to customers by the promised date. It is one of the most important customer-facing logistics metrics.
Freight cost per unit: The average cost to ship one unit of product. Tracking this helps manage transportation costs and measure shipping efficiency.
Truck turnaround rate (or dwell time): The time a carrier spends at your facility for pickup or delivery. A lower rate indicates efficient loading and unloading processes.
Vehicle capacity utilization: Measures the percentage of a vehicle's capacity that is used during a trip. Maximizing this metric reduces fuel costs and the number of trips.
First-attempt delivery rate: The percentage of orders successfully delivered on the initial attempt. This indicates effective routing and scheduling.
Safety and employee performance KPIs:
These indicators focus on protecting your workforce and ensuring regulatory compliance.
Safety incident rate: Tracks the frequency of workplace accidents and injuries. A lower rate indicates a safer working environment and effective safety measures.
Time since last accident: Measures the number of days since the last reportable incident. The longer this period, the more effective your safety protocols are.
Labor productivity: Measures output per labor hour. This can be tracked for specific tasks, like units processed per hour, to evaluate workforce efficiency.
Employee turnover rate: The percentage of staff that leaves the organization over a specific period. High turnover can signal issues with morale, training, or management.
4. Training and Development:
Implement continual training and development programs to help staff improve their skills and enhance warehouse efficiency.
5.  Exhibit Personal Attributes:
A great warehouse manager combines strong leadership and communication skills with excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities. They are also technologically savvy, prioritize safety, and can effectively motivate and train their team to ensure efficient, error-free operations.
Leadership and People Management:

Lead by example: They demonstrate integrity, stay calm under pressure, and remain fair in their dealings with employees.

Solve problems: They can quickly address issues like inventory discrepancies or staffing challenges and use problems as opportunities for continuous improvement.

Job Description: Costing Accountant (Project & Operations Alignment)
Overview:
The Costing Accountant is a business-critical financial role physically and operationally embedded within the manufacturing and project management environment. Rather than sitting isolated in a corporate finance wing, this role is co-located with the Project Manager at the head office and production facility.
Reporting directly to the Finance Executive, this position serves as the real-time financial engine driving project execution, new product development (NPD), and plant optimizations. By sitting shoulder-to-shoulder with Project Management, the Costing Accountant ensures that engineering, toolroom, and manufacturing decisions are backed by rigorous data integrity, variance tracking, and margin protection from day one
2. Key Responsibilities & Duties:
1. Project Costing, Capital Expenditure (CapEx) & NPD Support:
Real-Time Project Tracking: Partner with the Project Manager to track capital spend, tooling modifications, and product launches against budgeted projections.
NPD Margin Modeling: Build financial cost models for new product developments from the initial design phase, ensuring raw material selection and manufacturing routings hit gross margin targets.
CapEx Auditing: Prepare pre-project cost-benefit analyses (ROI, payback period) and conduct post-implementation reviews to verify if capital projects achieved expected efficiencies.
2. Standard Costing & Bill of Materials (BOM) Governance:
BOM Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with the Project Manager, engineers, and plant teams to establish and audit accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs), machine cycle times, and labor routing rates.
System Updates: Maintain, review, and adjust standard costing structures within the ERP system to mirror the physical shop-floor realities of new or optimized production lines.
3. Operational Variance Analysis & Material Tracking:

Master Toolmaker / Toolroom Manager (NPD Specialist)
Overview
The Master Toolmaker / Toolroom Manager is a specialized technical leadership role dedicated entirely to New Product Development (NPD), prototyping, and tooling innovation.  This position transforms conceptual consumer product designs into highly efficient, high-volume production realities.
Rather than focusing on routine plant maintenance, this role operates at the cutting edge of the business, working embedded within the NPD project triangle alongside the Project Manager and the Stainless Steel Project Manager. The ideal candidate combines the elite craftsmanship of a master toolmaker with a strategic mindset for design-for-manufacturing (DFM), ensuring new houseware and cookware ranges are launched on time, at the right quality, and within strict margin constraints.
Key Responsibilities & Duties:
1. NPD Tooling Evaluation & Design-for-Manufacturing (DFM)
Pre-Production Review: Review initial concept sketches and 3D CAD models from the design team, assessing technical feasibility, draw depths, and material limitations before tools are commissioned.
Tooling Architecture: Design, program, and engineer highly precise progressive dies, deep-draw press tools, and specialized molds tailored for new product geometric profiles.
Prototyping & Sampling: Fabricate alpha/beta prototypes and soft-tooling variants to test structural integrity, material flow, and aesthetic finishes.
2. Cross-Functional Project Triangle Integration:
Project Manager Partnership: Align daily toolroom priorities directly with the Project Manager's master NPD Gantt charts, ensuring prototype runs and pilot testing milestones are achieved without friction.
Costing Accountant Collaboration: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Costing Accountant to run cost-benefit analyses on raw tool steels, estimate machining/labor hours per die, and ensure tooling projects stay within approved capital expenditure (CapEx) targets.
3. Trialing, Commissioning & First-Article Sign-Off:
Press Trials & Debugging: Lead physical press trials and tryouts on the factory floor, tuning new dies, adjusting clearances, and debugging tool behaviors to eliminate wrinkling, tears, or dimensional variations.
First-Article Inspection (FAI): Collaborate with Quality Assurance to run initial batch inspections, optimizing the tool until parts systematically hit target design tolerances.
Handover to Operations: Seamlessly transition approved, verified, and locked NPD tooling over to the general production and maintenance teams, providing clear operating guidelines.
4. Toolroom Asset & Team Leadership:
NPD Toolroom Oversight: Supervise, train, and guide a precision-focused team of toolmakers, CNC programmers, and machinists dedicated to development work.
Advanced Machinery Management: Manage and optimize advanced toolroom equipment (CNC milling, Wire EDM, precision grinders) utilized for high-accuracy prototype machining
3. KPIs and Performance Measurables:
Performance will be evaluated quarterly against the following development-focused and financial metrics:
1. First-Time-Right (FTR) Tooling Verification:
Metric: Percentage of new tools that pass First-Article Inspection (FAI) with minimal secondary revisions.
Target: Achieve an 85% or higher First-Time-Right rate on newly designed tooling. Prevent avoidable post-trial tooling modifications that cause commercial or engineering delays.
2. NPD Project Timeline Compliance:
Metric: On-time delivery of verified tools against the Project Manager's milestone schedule.
Target: 100% on-time readiness of tooling for scheduled pilot production runs. Any technical bottlenecks must be flagged to the Project Manager at least 72 hours before the deadline.
3. Tooling CapEx & Scrap Budget Integrity:
Metric: Variance between budgeted tool development costs and actual toolroom expenditure.
Target: Maintain tool development costs within +/- 2.5% of the financial baseline established with the Costing Accountant. Minimize raw tool-steel waste and trial-run scrap materials.
4. Turnaround Speed on Prototype Iterations:
Metric: Time taken to modify a tool following a design change or failed trial.
Target: Execute minor tool modifications within 24 hours and major geometry re-cuts within 5 business days of receiving updated engineering data.

job_title: Sales Order 3 yrs, full-cycle processing exp., from quote to invoice to delivery, SAP (Mnfr. Alrode)
about_role:
This is a great multi-skilled opportunity for a candidate with a strong customer services background with the experience of the full sales order process cycle, using SAP. The related tasks relating to purchasing and import / export control can be trained.
The role is with the South African subsidiary of an established global technical manufacturing group, and is based in Alrode, Alberton, an industrial area in Johannesburg South.
A strong work ethic, performance driven with stable work history are valued attributes.
This closely-knit successful SA team value their people and have an extremely low turnover.
Remuneration - Approximately R25 000 - R26 000 gross basic per month + Excellent benefits i.e., Co. contributes 50% of medical aid up to Discovery Cassic Priority regardless of dependents; Co. contributes up to 10.5% of basic in terms of retirement fund; guaranteed 13th + discretionary additional bonus based on individual & Co.'s performance up to 12% of  annual salary.
Overview - Role requires an individual who communicates effectively with customers, suppliers & colleagues, addresses their concerns and ensures a seamless exerience with their products and services. Strong problem-solving skills & a customer-centric approach is necessary. You would be performing clerical / administrative support duties for the sales & purchasing departments. Prepare & distribute various sales reports when required. Maintain customer & supplier files, assist sales team & handle inquiries about products or services. Project a professional company image through all interactions.
Key Responsibilities:
Customer Interation -  Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email and online channels regarding required services and parts. Check & assist with reviewing internal costings leading to preparing customer quotations.
Supplier Interaction - Obtain RFQ's from suppliers based on customer requirements. Respond to vendor inquiries via phone, email and online channels. Prepare Vendor Purchase Orders, monitor supplier deliveries.
Order Management -  Process customer orders, ensuring accuracy in product specifications, delivery dates, Incoterms and payment details. (Capture orders and goods received notes on relevant systems, eg: SAP/Service Next. Procure spares, co-ordinate deliveries, Raise, send & save documentation.
Import & Export Control - Prepare & collate required documentation and deal with freight forwarders to obtain Import Licenses, enure that correct Inco-terms are being applied.
Issue Resolution - Handle customer complaints or issues, escalating to the appropriate department when necessary, while maintaining a professional and positive demeanor.
Sales Support - Assist with upselling parts, service agreements, and additional products based on customer needs.
Documentation - Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, transactions, inquiries, and complaints in relevant systems.
Collaboration - Work closely with the sales, technical support, and stores teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of products and services as well as controlling/maintaining stock levels in relation to open sales orders and customer contracts. Liase with the workshop  regarding processing of Job cards/picking lists and production orders.
Follow-up - Proactively follow up on customer satisfaction, order status and any post-purchase support needs.

LEARNING DESIGN PARTNER
Location: Gauteng (Work from home / Hybrid)
Salary: Market-related; to be discussed during the screening process
Purpose of the Role
The Learning Design Partner serves as a business developer and trusted advisor to clients, translating market intelligence and organisational and individual development needs into commercially viable, academically rigorous learning solutions.
The role also supports the learning process as a Learning Process Facilitator (LPF) to fulfil the company's Client Promise.
Requirements
Qualifications / Education / Certification
• Minimum postgraduate degree, preferably at master’s level.
• Formal certification in coaching or process facilitation would be advantageous.
• Registration with a professional body such as HPCSA, SABPP, or COMENSA would be advantageous.
Experience and Track Record
• At least five years’ experience in a business environment, specifically in a learning and development role, preferably executive education.
• In-depth knowledge of adult learning principles and trends, as well as the competitive landscape relating to the design, marketing, sales, and rollout of learning interventions.
• Proven credibility in liaising with clients as a trusted advisor/consultant at senior, executive, C-suite, and board level.
• Demonstrated ability to build long-standing relationships and networks to mutual benefit.
• Experience in a coaching or senior management role within corporate and public-sector environments, or as a bona fide consultant, would be an added advantage.
Other Requirements
• Must be able to travel locally and internationally and support relevant structures.
• Valid driving licence.
• Own reliable transportation.
• Quiet, suitable work-from-home office space.
• High-speed internet access.
Functional Competencies
• Understanding of adult learning principles globally, including learning styles and all aspects of diversity.
• Well-developed conceptual, systems-thinking, analytical, and decision-making skills, with a solution-driven approach to challenges and the ability to think long-term and beyond immediate responsibilities.
• Ability to set clear objectives, plan activities and their sequence well in advance, and manage own and other resources and time effectively, with exceptional attention to detail.
• Commercial acumen, including contributing to programme budgets, guiding the development of business cases, driving innovation, managing change required for implementation, and demonstrating return on investment to decision-makers and clients.
• Creative thinking in originating design, content, and delivery modes in collaboration with subject matter experts; contextualising existing resources; introducing new concepts; and applying academic research to programme design.
• Ability to apply academic theory and frameworks to business contexts in the public and private sectors, particularly action learning principles, group dynamics, research and academic writing, and business-case development and presentation.
• Competence in process facilitation, with a preference for influence rather than control.
• Applied knowledge of:
• Microsoft Office 365
• Moodle
• Zoom and Microsoft Teams
• Online learning platforms such as LinkedIn Learning, Skillsoft, and Coursera
• Social media platforms such as LinkedIn and WhatsApp
• Teaching and learning technologies such as Articulate and business simulations
• Accounting software such as Acumatica
• Excellent written and verbal English. Other languages are advantageous.
Behavioural Competencies
• Superior work ethic and a clear understanding of who the organisation serves.
• Ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with clients and stakeholders and network effectively within and outside the organisation.
• Ability to relate to and communicate with individuals at all levels while role-modelling empathy, patience, tolerance, respect, confidence, and humility.
• Genuine interest in and willingness to build a relationship with every participant.
• Takes responsibility for ensuring each participant has an effective learning experience, unlocks the wisdom in the room, connects learning across modules, and enables systemic group and organisational learning.
• Demonstrates a growth mindset, perseverance, and the ability to navigate challenges effectively within a demanding environment.
• Ability to prioritise work under pressure, meet deadlines, and demonstrate resilience in the face of adversity.
• Client-centric team player who can work productively, independently, and collaboratively in a remote and uncertain environment.
• Willingness to share knowledge, learnings, challenges, and successes.
• Long-term thinker who takes responsibility and initiative and makes decisions when required, including under difficult circumstances or where there is no precedent.
• Sensitive to diversity, adaptable to changing circumstances, embraces change, and deals effectively with ambiguity.
• Adventurous, energetic, driven, self-motivated, and entrepreneurial in identifying and owning opportunities.
Key Performance Areas
The following Key Performance Areas represent the primary requirements of the role. This is not an exhaustive list.
1. Represent the Company
• Serve as an ambassador of the company's brand to the broader corporate learning and development market.
2. Develop Business
• Align with the company and channel strategy.
• Work collaboratively with Channel Directors, channel teams, Business Development, and Marketing.
• Develop business through new and existing revenue streams.
3. Interpret Market Intelligence
• Respond to inbound requests and identify outbound opportunities.
• Gather, interpret, and disseminate market intelligence to enable informed decision-making and action.
4. Identify Needs
• Scope individual, client, industry, and market needs through:
• Market research.
• Monitoring industry and people-development trends.
• Analysing tender and request-for-proposal/request-for-quotation documents.
• Attending briefing and client meetings.
• Listening deeply and clarifying requirements appropriately.
5. Architect Learning Solutions
• Design integrated learning journeys aligned to:
• Client objectives and market needs.
• Business challenges.
• Participant needs.
• Organisational outcomes.
• Curate learning ecosystems incorporating faculty expertise, coaching, psychometrics, action learning, digital learning, experiential methodologies, and workplace application.
• Maximise learning impact and return on learning.
6. Learn, Innovate, and Collaborate
• Remain abreast of emerging trends, research, technologies, and practices in executive education, leadership development, and organisational learning.
• Attend conferences and professional forums.
• Evaluate new service providers.
• Contribute ideas that enhance learning design, participant experience, delivery methodologies, and client value.
• Share insights and contribute to innovation across The company's portfolio and ways of working.
7. Consider Cost
• Provide input into programme budgets.
• Consider all elements of the learning intervention, including development costs, channel and organisational overheads, and gross profit.
• Ensure alignment with company guidelines.
8. Create Proposals
• Write, submit, and present proposals that articulate the offering and outcomes.
• Ensure proposals are aligned to the purpose and appropriate level of work.
• Meet specified deadlines.
9. Assure Quality
• Adhere to quality-control procedures prescribed by the Council on Higher Education (CHE) and the University Short Course Policy.
• Capture all required data on the Faculty Management System (FMS) for submission on the Short Course Registration System (SCRS) via the Academic Assurance Specialist.
• Attend panel reviews.
• Ensure programmes are registered appropriately and timeously in accordance with prescribed quality-control procedures, standards, and processes.
10. Secure Resources
• Secure and collaborate

• Install, commission and hand over A3 and A4 multifunction devices, printers and large-format machines for Western Cape business customers
• Diagnose and resolve complex faults across mechanical, electronic, firmware and network layers — first-time-right, with proper root-cause analysis rather than part-swapping
• Configure devices onto customer networks: static IP and DHCP addressing, scan-to-email, scan-to-folder, secure print release and driver deployment
• Own your call list end to end — accept, attend, update and close every service call accurately and on the day it is worked
• Meet contracted SLA response and resolution times, and tell us early when a call is going to breach so we can manage the customer
• Manage the parts and consumables on your vehicle: order accurately, account for what you fit, return what you do not
• Capture correct meter readings and serial numbers so that our billing is right the first time
• Explain the fault, the fix and the prevention to the customer in plain language that earns their trust
• Lift the technicians around you — set the bar on cable management, machine presentation and workmanship, then hold it
• Feed the sales and service teams what you see in the field: ageing fleets, repeat faults, customers at risk Probation: 4 months
Why This Role Matters
A managed print contract is only worth what the service behind it is worth. Customers do not renew because of a brochure — they renew because the machine works, and because when it does not, the person who arrives knows exactly what they are doing.
Cape Town is a growth market for us. The senior technician we appoint here will set the technical reputation United Business Solutions carries in the Western Cape for the next several years, and will have the run of a customer base that includes some of the region's best-known businesses.
Our Hiring Funnel (Read Carefully)
Only candidates who follow the full process will be considered.
• Submit your CV to shaun@unitedbusiness.co.za. Applications are open until the role is filled — we review CVs as they arrive and interview on a rolling basis, so do not wait for a closing date. There isn't one.
• Include a written answer to this question in the body of your email: "Tell me about the hardest operational or technical problem you have ever solved in the field. How exactly did you solve it? Describe every step." Do not summarise — describe every step.

• Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a structured technical interview and asked to complete a short practical assessment.
• Final-stage candidates will undergo two verified reference checks. Applications that do not follow all five steps will not be considered.

Our client is looking for an experienced renewable energy professional to lead its Asset Management Team. This is a senior, client-facing role with end-to-end ownership of thee company’s portfolio under management: the performance of the assets, the commercial agreements that govern them, the service providers who maintain them, and the team of energy analysts who deliver the service.
The successful candidate will be the senior point of contact for asset owners, facilities managers and O&M service providers across a national portfolio of commercial, industrial, retail and utility-scale solar PV and battery storage assets.
Lead the Asset Management Team
• Lead, mentor and develop a team of energy analysts (engineers) and interns, setting standards for reporting quality, client communication and turnaround times.
• Allocate client portfolios and manage team capacity, reassigning work as client demands change and escalating resourcing needs early.
• Recruit, onboard and train new analysts as the portfolio grows.
• Hold weekly and monthly reporting cycles to schedule across the full portfolio.
Own the client relationship
• Act as the senior point of contact and escalation for asset owners, asset managers, facilities managers and property fund clients.
• Negotiate, maintain and renew Company service level agreements, including site additions, contract structuring across multiple owning entities, fee tier reviews and billing commencement terms.
• Prepare proposals for new and expanded scopes of service, including company’s asset management tier.
• Work with the accounts team on invoicing, purchase orders and pass-through costs.
• Support new business through platform demonstrations, portfolio reviews and client references.
Oversee project onboarding
• Lead the onboarding of greenfield and brownfield projects onto the SOLTRAK monitoring platform, from telemetry and data access through to fi rst report.
• Resolve onboarding blockages with EPCs and service providers, escalating to client and internal stakeholders where information is withheld or delayed.
• Maintain the onboarding pipeline and hold both the team and third parties to timelines that protect the monthly reporting run.
Oversee O&M contracting and service providers
• Run O&M procurement on behalf of clients: preparing and issuing RFPs, hosting site briefings, adjudicating submissions and advising on appointment.
• Negotiate and administer O&M agreements, including scope, service extensions, pricing and the framework for adjudicating underperformance.
• Lead penalty and underperformance discussions with service providers, supported by company’s performance evidence.
• Appoint and manage third-party inspection and electrical contractors, including scoping, quotations and pricing methodology.
Drive asset performance
• Oversee monthly, quarterly and annual performance reporting across the portfolio, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and clarity.
• Undertake and review performance evaluation assessments of PV and BESS systems together with company’s energy analysts.
• Interpret plant performance to identify underperformance, quantify lost yield and assess opportunities to improve output.
• Own the alerting and incident escalation process, ensuring incidents are triaged, communicated to the responsible party and driven to resolution.
• Oversee physical site inspections and translate findings into maintenance actions and capital recommendations.
• Coordinate actionable items arising from performance assessments through to closure.
Shape the company platform
• Work with the company software development team to prioritise, specify, test and roll out new platform features and releases.
• Represent the end user in the platform roadmap, translating asset owner and analyst needs into product requirements.
• Support the development of the company's automated reporting framework, introducing new features and identifying bugs and fi xes.
• Support the development of telemetry schemas, protocols and third-party API integrations with inverter, metering and monitoring vendors.
• Evaluate third-party analytics, diagnostic and machine learning tools for use within the service.
• Support technical due diligence and plant valuation instructions on asset transactions.
• Provide performance data and technical input to wheeling, REC and embedded generation workstreams.
• Advise clients on portfolio-level decisions such as spares holding, EPC engagement and repowering.

CCG Systems is an ICT sector and is well known to specialize in the implementation and support of ERP systems as well as Payroll & HR Systems to which our clients are made of mostly Municipalities throughout South Africa. Our company is looking for a potential candidate to join our IT team in the capacity of a Database Administrator, to be based at our Head Office.
The Database Administrator is responsible for the availability, performance, security, integrity, reliability and recoverability of the organisation's databases. The role will administer and support production, development and UAT database environments, with particular focus on Microsoft SQL Server and databases supporting critical business applications, ERP, financial, billing and reporting systems. The DBA will ensure that databases are properly maintained, monitored, secured and backed up, while providing technical support for database-related incidents, performance issues, system implementations, upgrades and disaster recovery activities. The position requires a high level of technical discipline because the databases support business-critical and financially sensitive applications.
Formal Qualification required
• Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Database Administration; or a related field. Relevant Microsoft SQL Server certification.
• Microsoft Azure database-related certification. ITIL Foundation or equivalent service-management certification. Relevant cybersecurity certification
Legal Requirements
• Valid code B driver’s license and own transport
• Passed credit and criminal checks
• S.A Citizen, Resident or Valid S.A Work PermitDatabase Administration
• Install, configure and maintain Microsoft SQL Server environments.
• Create, configure and maintain databases.
• Manage database instances, databases, schemas and database objects.
• Monitor database health and availability.
• Perform routine database maintenance.
• Manage database growth and storage requirements.
• Monitor database capacity and proactively identify potential capacity constraints.
• Maintain accurate database documentation and configuration records.
• Support production, development, testing and UAT database environments.
Database Performance Management
• Monitor database and SQL Server performance.
• Investigate slow-running queries and database performance issues.
• Analyse execution plans and identify inefficient queries.
• Perform query optimisation and performance tuning.
• Manage indexes and statistics.
• Investigate blocking, deadlocks and long-running transactions.
• Identify CPU, memory, disk I/O and storage-related database bottlenecks.
• Establish performance baselines and monitor deviations.
• Recommend infrastructure or database configuration improvements where required.Backup and Recovery
• Design, implement and maintain database backup strategies.
• Monitor the successful completion of scheduled backups.
• Perform full, differential and transaction-log backups as required.
• Regularly test database restoration procedures.
• Maintain backup retention policies.
• Investigate and resolve failed backups.
• Ensure databases can be recovered within defined recovery requirements.
• Participate in Disaster Recovery planning and testing.
• Maintain appropriate Recovery Point Objective (RPO) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) proceduresDatabase Security
• Manage SQL Server users, roles and permissions.
• Implement role-based access controls.
• Ensure the principle of least privilege is applied.
• Monitor privileged database access.
• Support integration with Windows/Active Directory authentication where applicable.
• Implement database security controls and encryption where required.
• Ensure appropriate protection of sensitive and financial information.
• Participate in database security assessments and remediation activities.
• Ensure database access is aligned with organisational security policies

Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement strategic business plans for each Key Account, aligned to the customer's objectives and our company's growth strategy.
Develop individual strategies and growth plans for each product group, identifying opportunities to increase turnover, ranging, market share and profitability.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior buyers, category managers and key decision-makers.
Engage with buyers at a strategic and commercial level, understanding their business, challenges, targets and requirements.
Lead range reviews, product presentations, negotiations, promotions and annual trading discussions.
Identify opportunities for new products, new ranges, additional stores, increased ranging and improved product positioning.
Analyse sales performance, margins, stock levels, ranging and market opportunities and translate this information into actionable strategies.
Prepare and present professional account reviews, business plans, forecasts and commercial proposals.
Negotiate pricing, promotions, rebates, trading terms and other commercial agreements while protecting company profitability.
Work closely with internal Sales, Production, Planning, Logistics and Finance teams to ensure customer commitments can be delivered.
Monitor competitor activity and market trends and use these insights to develop account and product strategies.
Take full ownership of account performance, from strategy through to execution.
Identify risks within each account and proactively develop plans to address them.
