iStore Finance is looking for an experienced Collections Manager to lead our collections operation and drive effective recovery across the arrears portfolio.
The role is responsible for the end-to-end collections and payments management function, covering early-, mid- and late-stage delinquency. You will lead the internal collections team while also managing the performance of external debt collection partners.
As a key operational link between Collections, Credit Risk, Finance, Customer Experience, Compliance and IT, you will use data and performance insights to improve recovery strategies, identify trends and drive operational efficiencies.
The successful candidate will balance strong recovery performance with a fair, compliant and customer-focused approach to collections.
Key responsibilities
Team leadership & people management
• Lead, coach and performance-manage the internal Collections team.
• Set clear daily, weekly and monthly recovery, productivity and quality targets.
• Conduct regular one-on-ones, coaching sessions and call/interaction quality reviews.
• Develop collector capability and drive a high-performance, compliant collections culture.
• Recognise strong performance and address performance gaps through appropriate coaching and corrective action.
• Support succession planning and the ongoing development of team members.
• Manage rostering, leave and workforce planning to ensure adequate operational coverage.
Arrears collections & payments management
• Own the full arrears collections lifecycle across early-, mid- and late-stage delinquency.
• Manage collections activity across inbound, outbound and digital channels.
• Oversee payment arrangements, promise-to-pay (PTP) processes and payment plan compliance.
• Ensure collection strategies are applied in line with policy and affordability requirements.
• Monitor individual collector and overall portfolio performance and take corrective action where required.
• Ensure accurate and timely account updates, collection dispositions and payment processing across relevant systems.
• Identify opportunities to improve recovery rates, payment behaviour and collections effectiveness.
External debt collection agency management
• Manage relationships with external and third-party debt collection agencies.
• Monitor agency performance against agreed SLAs, recovery targets and compliance requirements.
• Identify and address agency underperformance and escalate issues where appropriate.
• Oversee the placement and recall of accounts between internal Collections and external agencies.
• Ensure accurate account handovers, reporting and reconciliation between iStore Finance and external partners.
• Participate in regular agency performance reviews.
• Support the onboarding, renewal and offboarding of external collections partners.
Stakeholder management
• Act as the primary link between Collections and internal functions including Finance, Credit Risk, Legal/Compliance, IT and Customer Experience.
• Collaborate with Credit and Risk teams on portfolio segmentation, collection strategies and strategy adjustments.
• Share collector, campaign and portfolio insights with the Senior Operations Manager.
• Work with internal stakeholders to resolve operational issues affecting collections performance.
• Build effective working relationships with external collections partners and ensure alignment with iStore Finance requirements.
Systems, MI & reporting
• Operate confidently across collections systems, diallers and CRM/case management platforms.
• Act as a super-user and point of support for the Collections team.
• Produce accurate daily, weekly and monthly MI covering collections performance, portfolio recovery, agency performance and team scorecards.
• Use reporting and data to identify trends, root causes and opportunities for improvement.
• Identify system and data issues affecting collections performance and work with IT/digital teams to resolve them.
• Use MI to support evidence-based collection strategies and operational decision-making.
Customer experience, queries & complaints
• Take ownership of escalated customer queries, disputes and complaints arising from collections activity.
• Ensure customer concerns are resolved fairly, professionally and within agreed turnaround times.
• Monitor query and complaint trends to identify recurring issues and root causes.
• Drive corrective action within the internal team or with external collection agencies where required.
• Ensure all collections interactions are conducted professionally and consistently with customer experience standards.
• Monitor complaint resolution turnaround times and report on customer experience outcomes.
Risk, compliance & quality assurance
• Ensure all internal and external collections activity complies with applicable legislation, including the National Credit Act (NCA), POPIA and Debt Collectors Act.
• Conduct and/or oversee quality assurance reviews of collector interactions.
• Ensure accurate records and documentation are maintained across the collections operation.
• Identify and escalate potential compliance, conduct or reputational risks.
• Ensure external collection agencies operate in accordance with agreed compliance and service requirements.
• Promote a culture of responsible, fair and compliant collections.
Required
• 5–8 years' experience in collections, credit or a related operational environment.
• 2–3 years' experience managing a team of collectors.
• Proven experience managing or working closely with external or third-party debt collection agencies.
• Strong knowledge of collections systems, diallers and CRM/case management platforms.
• Strong MI and reporting capability, with advanced Excel skills.
• Sound understanding of the South African credit and collections regulatory environment, particularly the NCA, POPIA and Debt Collectors Act.
• A Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance or a related field will be advantageous, but is not essential.
Advantageous
• Experience with digitally enabled collections platforms and diallers.
• Experience managing digital and self-service collections channels.
• Experience managing multiple external debt collection agency relationships.
• Experience within consumer lending, retail finance or financial services.We are looking for someone who demonstrates:
• Strong people leadership, coaching and performance management capability.
• A strong understanding of collections performance and recovery strategies.
• Analytical and MI-driven decision-making.
• Strong stakeholder management across internal teams and external partners.
• A customer-focused approach to query and complaint resolution.
• Confidence working across multiple technology systems and platforms.
• High levels of integrity, accountability and compliance awareness.
• Clear and confident communication with customers, teams, stakeholders and external partners.
• The ability to balance commercial recovery objectives with fair and responsible customer outcomes.
Working conditions
• Based at 1 Sandton Drive, Johannesburg.
• Standard office hours, with flexibility required to respond to urgent arrears and recovery escalations and month-end collections cycles.
• Regular collaboration with Credit Risk, Customer Support, Finance and IT/Systems teams.
• Ongoing engagement and performance management of external debt collection agencies.

BACKGROUND:
African Parks is a non-profit conservation organisation that takes on responsibility for the long-term management of protected areas in partnership with governments and local communities. African Parks manages 24 protected areas in 13 countries covering over 20 million hectares.
In South Sudan, African Parks supports the management of the Great Nile Migration Landscape (GNML), centred around Badingilo National Park, Boma National Park, and the Jonglei landscape. Covering more than 120,000 km², the landscape supports the world’s largest remaining terrestrial mammal migration and is of major ecological importance regionally and globally
JOB OVERVIEW:
The Community Development Manager leads African Parks’ community programme for Badingilo National Park and its surrounding communities and is accountable for the delivery of the Community Development Plan (CDP). As the Park’s lead for community and external stakeholder engagement, the role builds and maintains strong relationships with local communities, traditional authorities, county and payam authorities, government partners and relevant organisations, while building a strong constituency for conservation through the 3E+ Strategy—Engagement, Education and Economy—and the development of community-based natural resource management (CBNRM) approaches. The role also contributes to the development and implementation of participatory land-use plans by supporting community engagement, consultation and local-level validation.
MAIN ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Community and Stakeholder Engagement
• Serve as the Park's lead relationship manager with communities, traditional authorities, county and payam authorities, community institutions and relevant partners.
• Maintain a regular field presence and build trusted relationships across the Lafon, western boundary and Mangalla North-Gemeiza community zones.
• Develop and implement engagement plans that reflect the governance arrangements, needs, risks and conservation priorities of each zone.
• Establish and support representative community engagement mechanisms, with meaningful participation by women, youth, displaced people and other groups that may be excluded.
• Maintain an up-to-date stakeholder map, identify emerging concerns early and advise the Park Manager and relevant departments on appropriate responses.
• Represent the Park in community and local-government forums as delegated, and ensure that commitments are authorised, recorded and followed through.
• Community Development Plan and 3E+ Delivery
• Translate the CDP into annual workplans, budgets, implementation schedules and measurable performance targets.
• Lead delivery of the 3E+ strategy across engagement, education and economic opportunity, calibrated to the priorities and conditions of each community zone.
• Develop and manage education, livelihood, enterprise and community-capacity initiatives included in approved park plans and budgets.
• Use clear selection criteria and transparent communication so that communities understand the Park's role, available resources and limits.
• Develop partnerships with government, civil-society organisations and technical specialists where they add practical value to programme delivery.
• Participatory Land Use Planning and Demarcation
• Lead community-facing implementation of participatory land-use planning, boundary engagement and related consultation within the Badingilo landscape.
• Support the MWCT-led demarcation process through local-authority engagement, consultation with chiefs and landholders, participatory mapping and community validation, consistently presenting the work as clarification of the existing designation.
• Ensure that customary rights, seasonal resource use, settlement patterns, livelihood needs and culturally important areas are documented and incorporated into planning processes.
• Organise and facilitate FPIC processes where required, in accordance with approved safeguards procedures and in coordination with the Safeguards Manager.
• Work with the Land Use Coordinator on methodology and landscape integration.
• Community Governance and CBNRM
• Assess community readiness for community-based natural resource management using clear and evidence-based criteria.
• Support legitimate and representative community institutions to define membership, decision-making procedures, accountability arrangements and natural-resource management rules.
• Advance viable conservancy and community-conservation initiatives adjacent to the Park, subject to community readiness and government approval.
• Lead community consultation on conservation-compatible livelihoods and approved opportunities linked to sustainable resource use, tourism and other forms of benefit sharing.
• Support the development of policy and regulatory approaches where requested, while ensuring that policy ownership remains with the appropriate government and African Parks functions.
• Rights Safeguards and Operational Integration
• Implement approved safeguards and consultation requirements in all community-facing activities and maintain complete records of information shared, representation, concerns and decisions.
• Provide community information and facilitate consultations required for environmental and social due diligence and action plans led by the Safeguards function.
• Support accessible grievance and feedback mechanisms and work with the Safeguards Manager and Human Rights Coordinator to ensure that complaints are recorded and referred appropriately.
• Work with Law Enforcement, Conservation, GIS, Infrastructure and other departments to integrate community perspectives and reduce avoidable conflict in park operations.
• Coordinate community responses to human-wildlife conflict and deliver approved awareness activities on relevant wildlife, land and local-government legislation.
• Department Management Monitoring and Reporting
• Recruit, lead and develop a capable, field-oriented and accountable community team with clear responsibilities and performance expectations.
• Manage the department's budget, logistics and field operations in accordance with approved plans and African Parks procedures.
• Maintain practical monitoring systems that track participation, expenditure, outputs, outcomes and lessons learned, supported by credible field evidence.
• Produce timely weekly, monthly and annual reports and contribute to proposals, donor reporting and management reviews as required.
• Ensure consistent coordination and information-sharing within the community team and across all Park departments.EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
• A qualification in community development, development studies, social science, natural-resource management or a related field.
• At least 7 years of relevant experience spanning community-facing fieldwork and programme management, including supervision of teams in difficult and changing field conditions.
• Demonstrated experience building relationships with rural communities, traditional authorities, local government and external partners.
• Experience in participatory land-use planning, community mapping, FPIC, community governance or community-based natural resource management.
• A working understanding of rights-based conservation, customary tenure, safeguards and grievance mechanisms, with the ability to apply them in contested settings.
• Strong programme, budget, staff-management, monitoring and reporting skills.
• A skilled facilitator and listener who can manage disagreement, communicate clearly and maintain neutrality across competing community claims.
• Culturally sensitive, conflict-aware, resilient and willing to work extensively in remote and insecurity-affected areas.
• Excellent written and spoken English. Knowledge of relevant South Sudanese languages is an advantage.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to maintain clear, accurate programme and consultation records.

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented CNC Operator to set up, program adjustments, and operate advanced Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machinery. In this safety-critical manufacturing environment, you will produce high-precision OEM components for the mining, mineral processing, and industrial equipment sectors. • Machine Operation: Set up, calibrate, and operate advanced CNC machinery—including Precision CNC Milling (ranging from 20mm up to 3000mm length with a 1000mm height capacity)[cite: 3] and Precision CNC Turning (up to 3000mm length, 780mm max swing diameter, and 350mm over the saddle)[cite: 3].

With more than 34400 students, and approximately 1700 members of staff, the Durban University of Technology (DUT) is a leading university of technology proudly located in the beautiful cities of Durban and Pietermaritzburg, along the warm east coast of South Africa. Founded in April 2002 through the historic merger of the former ML Sultan Technikon and Technikon Natal, DUT has evolved into a modern, metropolitan, multi-campus university with roots tracing back to 1907.
Today, DUT is recognised nationally and internationally for its excellence in teaching and learning, research, innovation, entrepreneurship and engagement. A proud member of the International Association of Universities, DUT continues to expand its influence across South Africa and the world. In the 2025 Webometrics Rankings, DUT was ranked among the Top 6% of all universities and colleges worldwide, reflecting its academic excellence, research impact and strong global visibility.
DUT’s Philosophy of Education, “Our creativity and innovation shapes adaptive graduates who transform society” reflects the institution’s deep commitment to meaningful impact for societal transformation. Guided by its inspirational and aspirational ENVISION2030 strategy, which is rooted in DUT’s DNA of being ‘people-centred and engaged’ and ‘innovative and entrepreneurial’ and underpinned by its bespoke Living Values Framework, DUT focuses on ‘contributing to the improving lives and livelihoods’.
The University comprises six diverse Faculties:

about_role:
Senior Short-Term Actuary (Cell Captive) - Johannesburg, Gauteng – Market Related
Industry: Non-Life Insurance / Cell Captive
Reporting To: Chief Executive Officer (Functional line to Chief Financial Officer)
Executive Summary
A prominent and innovative cell captive insurer based in Johannesburg is seeking an experienced Company Actuary to lead its actuarial function. In this high-impact position, you will drive strategic oversight, technical governance, and operational excellence across all cell captive arrangements. Serving as the internal technical authority, you will collaborate with external statutory actuarial consultants to maintain regulatory alignment with the Prudential Authority, oversee SAM capital modeling, and lead IFRS 17 standards.
Key Responsibilities
• Actuarial Governance: Serve as the internal primary interface for actuarial governance, collaborating with external statutory actuarial consultants on regulatory submissions, capital calculations, and reports for the Prudential Authority.
• Pricing & Structure: Evaluate and refine pricing models for new and existing cell captive arrangements to ensure financial viability, competitive positioning, and optimal risk-adjusted returns.
• Technical Reserving: Lead the technical calculation of actuarial liabilities, technical provisions, and unearned premium reserves across all business lines in compliance with regulatory and IFRS 17 frameworks.
• Capital Modeling: Oversee Solvency Assessment and Management (SAM) requirements, calculating Solvency Capital Requirements (SCR) and Minimum Capital Requirements (MCR) while maximizing capital efficiency for cell owners.
• Reinsurance & Risk Strategy: Assess and optimize reinsurance structures and risk-retention strategies to protect capital and ensure long-term cell stability.
• Financial Integration: Partner with the CFO and finance team to refine actuarial assumptions, discount rates, and Contractual Service Margin (CSM) calculations under IFRS 17.
• External Consultancy Oversight: Oversee external actuarial consultancies holding statutory sign-off authority, managing scopes of work, deliverables, and performance for outsourced valuation functions.
• Strategic Executive Advisory: Provide actuarial insight and guidance to executive leadership and cell partners to develop custom risk solutions.
• Team Leadership: Provide direct management to 1–2 internal technical analysts while overseeing external modeling partners.

job_title: Head of Technical - (Senior Technical & Scientific Authority)
about_role:
My Client that develops, Manufactures, and Supplies a wide range of Feed additives, Biosecurity, and Hygiene solutions for the feed, Livestock, and Food industries. As a South African manufacturer, they combine science, innovation, and care to strengthen food safety, productivity, and operational performance across Africa and parts of Asia. There proprietary Universal Dosing System (BUDS) sets them apart, integrating formulation expertise with precision application technology for their customers. There area of expertise is food safety, which is woven right through the ‘farm to fork’ chain.
The Opportunity: Head of Technical - An expert in Technology, Equipment, Manufacturing, R&D, Quality.
We are looking for a Head of Technical to serve as the senior technical and scientific authority for the company. This is a pivotal, hands-on leadership role for someone who can take our products from laboratory formulation, through scale-up and commercial manufacture, and ultimately into successful application at our customers’ sites. As Head of Technical, you will be the critical link between R&D, manufacturing and field operations, taking technical ownership of the product life cycle from initial formulation and development through pilot production, process scale-up, industrialisation and commercialisation, while ensuring products can be manufactured consistently, perform reliably and deliver the intended results in real-world customer applications.
This is not a desk-based technical leadership position. We are looking for someone who is pragmatic, decisive and technically accomplished, with the ability to move comfortably between the laboratory, production environment and customer site. Whether you are troubleshooting a formulation in the laboratory, resolving a scale-up challenge on the production floor, reviewing validation protocols, supporting a commercial manufacturing trial, or solving a technical application issue at a customer site, you will be expected to take ownership and drive solutions through to completion. If you are a hands-on technical leader who combines strong scientific capability with practical manufacturing expertise and a passion for turning great formulations into reliable commercial products, this could be your ideal next role.
Key Accountabilities
Technical leadership, governance and risk management.
R&D, Scale-Up & Commercialisation (The "Lab-to-Plant" Bridge)
• Translate approved product concepts and laboratory formulations into safe, reproducible, and commercially viable manufacturing processes.
• Lead technical transfer activities across the entire lifecycle: Laboratory → Pilot → First Commercial Production → Routine Manufacturing.
• Provide hands-on process development and optimisation for key unit operations, including mixing, dispersion, reaction, dilution, heating/cooling, filtration, transfer, filling, and process control.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, reliability, yield, and manufacturing cost-efficiency.
Manufacturing technology, equipment and facility technical oversight.
• Continuous improvement of manufacturing processes, equipment, product quality, reliability, yield and cost.
• Product Stewardship, Quality & Regulatory Governance
• Act as the senior technical authority for product safety, regulatory compliance, and formulation governance across the full product portfolio.
• Provide technical oversight of the Quality Assurance department, including audit support, change control, deviation management, and structured root-cause investigations.
• Lead CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) initiatives to resolve complex technical issues and prevent recurrence.
• Own and maintain all technical documentation and controlled manufacturing standards to ensure full regulatory traceability.

about_role:
Introduction to the VKB Group
The VKB Group is an agricultural company providing support to farmers and producing straight-from-the-farm foods for consumers. Apart from its various consumer brands, the VKB Group is also represented by its regional brands: VKB, GWK and NTK.
Our roots are firmly planted in agriculture, with farming at our core, continuously growing and evolving throughout the years. Starting with providing everything needed on the farm to produce food, we now operate across the entire food supply chain, including processing, logistics, storage, handling and national and international market channels.
This house of brands, established with the support of our farmer shareholders, forms the foundation for building the agribusiness of the future.
More About Engineering Services
The Engineering Services Division plays a critical role in maintaining and optimising the infrastructure that supports VKB Group's grain storage and handling operations. Our teams are responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety and performance of electrical, automation and operational systems that enable grain to move efficiently from producer to market.
By supporting silo operations, grain intake, drying, storage and dispatch activities, Engineering Services helps safeguard one of South Africa's most important agricultural value chains.
Why This Role Matters
This is not a typical electrician position.
As an Electrician within our grain storage and silo operations environment, you will be responsible for maintaining and improving the electrical and automation systems that keep critical agricultural infrastructure operating.
Your expertise will directly influence equipment reliability, operational uptime and the successful movement of grain during peak harvest periods. When systems operate effectively, farmers are able to deliver grain efficiently, operations run smoothly and food security is supported across the country.
This role offers the opportunity to work on complex electrical and automation systems while making a meaningful contribution to South African agriculture.
Why Join VKB?
At VKB Group, your work has a direct impact on the agricultural sector and food supply chain.
You will have the opportunity to:
• Work within one of South Africa's leading grain storage and handling operations.
• Be exposed to large-scale electrical, automation and grain handling systems.
• Play a key role during harvest seasons where operational reliability is critical.
• Participate in modernization, optimisation and continuous improvement projects.
• Develop and mentor apprentices and junior technicians.
• Build a long-term career within a stable, growing agricultural business.
• Work alongside professionals who are passionate about agriculture, innovation and technical excellence.What Success Looks Like

• Grain intake, handling and dispatch operations experience minimal unplanned downtime.
• Electrical and automation faults are diagnosed and resolved efficiently.
• Preventative and predictive maintenance programmes are executed effectively.
• Electrical infrastructure remains compliant, safe and reliable.
• Harvest season operations continue with minimal disruption.

• Opportunities for optimisation and continuous improvement are identified and implemented.
• Strong relationships are built with operational and technical stakeholders.Who Are We Looking For?

Store is looking for a Data / MI Credit Portfolio Analyst to provide reliable, actionable insight into the performance and risk of our consumer credit portfolio.
This is not a traditional Business Analyst role where a detailed specification is handed to you. You will be expected to independently source, investigate, interpret and structure consumer credit data across the full credit lifecycle — from application and approval through to repayments, arrears and collections.
You will play a key role at the intersection of Risk, Finance and BI & Data, building and maintaining daily and weekly reporting, identifying emerging risks and providing insights that support better credit and collections decisions.
The ideal candidate combines strong consumer credit knowledge, advanced SQL and Power BI capability, with the curiosity and initiative to work with complex, disparate data sources and turn them into meaningful business intelligence.
Data Sourcing & Integration
• Identify and engage with relevant systems and stakeholders to source consumer credit data across application, origination, bureau and affordability checks, approval, decisioning, disbursement, repayment and collections.
• Independently determine which data sources are relevant and fit for purpose.
• Investigate and document data sources, structures and lineage to create a reliable reference for the wider team.
• Partner with the BI & Data team to formalise validated data sources within the Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse environment.
• Support the development of sustainable and repeatable reporting solutions.
Data Cleaning, Conforming & Consolidation
• Clean, standardise and consolidate consumer credit data from multiple systems, products and entities.
• Identify inconsistencies and establish common business rules across different data sources.
• Ensure consistent interpretation of credit concepts, including decline reasons, arrears statuses, collections statuses and product terms.
• Develop and maintain a consumer credit KPI and metric glossary.
• Ensure data quality, accuracy and integrity across reporting outputs.
Reporting & Analytics
• Design, develop and maintain daily and weekly Power BI dashboards covering the consumer credit lifecycle.
• Monitor application volumes, approval and decline rates, credit book performance, arrears and collections effectiveness.
• Identify trends, anomalies and emerging risks and translate these into actionable business insights.
• Proactively recommend new KPIs, metrics and reporting views to improve visibility of credit performance.
• Present findings and insights clearly to Risk, Finance and BI & Data stakeholders.
Credit Risk & Collections Monitoring
• Develop and maintain risk-flagging logic across the credit lifecycle.
• Monitor application fraud and affordability indicators, elevated decline patterns and early-stage arrears and collections risks.
• Identify emerging patterns and recommend appropriate risk rules and thresholds.
• Define and maintain escalation processes for identified credit and collections risks.
• Monitor the effectiveness of credit decisioning and collections rules.
• Recommend refinements that support improved recovery outcomes and reduced credit losses.
Automation & Process Understanding
• Maintain a working understanding of automated credit decisioning, workflow and collections tools.
• Understand how rules-based approval and decline engines, automated collections processes and workflow/RPA solutions impact data and reporting.
• Distinguish between automated and manual decisions and actions when interpreting system-generated data.
• Identify opportunities where automation could improve data quality, turnaround times and risk outcomes.
Stakeholder Collaboration
• Work closely with the BI & Data team to support data engineering and long-term reporting sustainability.
• Partner with Risk and Finance stakeholders to ensure reporting aligns with business requirements, risk appetite and relevant regulatory considerations.
• Investigate and resolve ad hoc consumer credit data queries and reporting requirements.
• Build strong working relationships across Risk, Finance and BI & Data.
Required
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Data Science, Statistics, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
• 5+ years' experience within consumer credit, lending or a similar consumer finance data environment.
• Strong working knowledge of the consumer credit lifecycle, including:
• Application and origination
• Credit bureau and affordability assessments
• Approval and decisioning
• Disbursement
• Repayment behaviour
• Arrears
• Collections
• Advanced SQL skills.
• Strong Power BI or equivalent BI dashboard development experience.
• Proven experience building data models or reporting solutions from disparate, poorly documented data sources with limited guidance.
Advantageous
• Working knowledge of automated credit decisioning and rules engines.
• Exposure to workflow automation, RPA or automated collections solutions.
• Experience working with credit bureau data, affordability assessments and credit scores.
• Understanding of responsible lending and relevant credit regulatory considerations.

• Strong analytical and investigative capability.

about_role:
Regional Property Portfolio Manager
Introduction to the VKB Group
The VKB Group is an agricultural company providing support to farmers and producing straight-from-the-farm foods for consumers. Apart from its various consumer brands, the VKB Group is also represented by its regional brands: VKB, GWK and NTK.
Our roots are firmly planted in agriculture, with farming at our core, continuously growing and evolving throughout the years. Starting with providing everything needed on the farm to produce food, we now operate across the entire food supply chain, including processing, logistics, storage, handling and national and international market channels.
This "house of brands", established with the support of our farmer shareholders, forms the foundation for building the agribusiness of the future.
More About VKB Group Properties
The VKB Group owns and manages a diverse portfolio of agricultural, industrial, commercial, retail, storage, and operational properties across the Free State. These properties are critical to supporting the Group's operations and long-term growth strategy.
From grain handling facilities and storage infrastructure to offices, workshops, operational sites, and commercial properties, our portfolio supports every step of the agricultural value chain. Managing these assets requires balancing operational needs, infrastructure investment, compliance, asset preservation, and long-term value creation.
The Property Division plays a vital role in ensuring that our facilities remain safe, efficient, financially sustainable, and capable of supporting the future growth of the VKB Group.
Regional Property Portfolio Manager
Why This Role Matters?
The VKB Group's property portfolio is far more than a collection of buildings; it is a strategic business asset that enables the movement, processing, storage, and distribution of agricultural products across the Free State.
As Regional Property Portfolio Manager, you will serve as the custodian of a significant property portfolio that supports the Group's agricultural and commercial operations. You will be responsible for protecting, maintaining, improving, and optimising these assets while guiding investments that support future growth.
You will influence property strategy, lead infrastructure upgrades, manage capital projects, oversee facilities management, and help ensure that our properties continue to deliver long-term value to the business.
This is a rare opportunity to combine property portfolio management, facilities leadership, infrastructure development, and strategic asset management within one of South Africa's leading agricultural organisations.
Why Join VKB?
Joining the VKB Group means becoming part of a business that plays a meaningful role in supporting agriculture, food production, and rural economic development.
At VKB, you will have the opportunity to:
• Manage a diverse and strategically important property portfolio across the Free State.
• Influence long-term property and infrastructure investment decisions.
• Lead capital improvement and development projects that create lasting business value.
• Collaborate with operational, engineering, financial, and executive stakeholders.
• Drive asset optimisation initiatives that directly impact business performance.
• Work in an environment that values accountability, innovation, integrity, and continuous improvement.
• Grow your career within one of Southern Africa's leading agribusiness groups.What Success Looks Like?

• Asset maintenance and preservation strategies protect long-term property value.
• Facilities support operational excellence across the Group's Free State footprint.

About Core Group
Core Group represents some of the world’s most valued and loved technology brands across Sub-Saharan Africa. Our mission is to empower individuals and organisations through the world’s leading personal technology products and services.
Our expertise spans retail, distribution, supply chain, finance, marketing, sales, customer experience, human resources and business development, with operations across South Africa and key African markets.
About the Role
We are looking for an exceptional Executive Associate to work closely with a senior member of Core Group’s Executive Leadership Team.
This is not a Personal Assistant role. We are looking for a highly capable, commercially minded individual who can work alongside an executive on business priorities, financial analysis, strategic projects, reporting and decision-making.
The successful candidate will ideally come from a Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business Science background and be comfortable working with numbers, interrogating information, preparing business cases and translating complex information into clear recommendations.
You will have direct exposure to senior leadership and will work across different areas of the organisation, helping the executive stay close to key business priorities and ensuring that important initiatives move from discussion through to execution.
This role would suit a high-performing individual who wants to build a career in business leadership, finance, strategy or general management.
Key Responsibilities
You will work closely with the executive across a broad range of business priorities, including:
• Analyse financial, commercial and operational information to support executive decision-making.
• Prepare management reports, financial summaries, dashboards and executive updates.
• Assist with budgets, forecasts, business cases, investment proposals and financial modelling.
• Review business performance against targets and identify trends, risks and areas requiring attention.
• Conduct research and analysis on new opportunities, markets, competitors and strategic initiatives.
• Prepare high-quality presentations and briefing documents for executive and leadership meetings.
• Support the executive in driving strategic projects across different areas of the business.
• Coordinate cross-functional initiatives and ensure actions, deadlines and commitments are followed through.
• Attend key business meetings, understand the discussion and ensure decisions are translated into clear actions.
• Work with Finance and other business areas to obtain, validate and interpret information required for decision-making.
• Assist with process improvement and business optimisation initiatives.
• Track key business priorities and proactively highlight delays, risks or issues.
• Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across the organisation.
• Handle sensitive business and financial information with a high level of discretion and professionalism.
What We're Looking For
We are looking for someone who is bright, ambitious and commercially curious, with the confidence to operate in a senior business environment.
Ideally, you will have:
• A completed Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Science, Investment Management or a related commercial field.
• Honours, postgraduate studies or progress towards a professional finance or accounting qualification would be advantageous.
• Strong academic results.
• Approximately 1–4 years of relevant experience in finance, consulting, audit, corporate finance, strategy, business analysis or a similar environment.
• Strong financial and numerical ability.
• Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large amounts of data.
• The ability to analyse information and turn it into practical business insights.
• Strong PowerPoint and presentation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong attention to detail.
• The ability to manage multiple priorities and work at pace.
• Confidence dealing with senior stakeholders.
• High levels of maturity, professionalism and discretion.
• A proactive mindset – someone who identifies what needs to happen and takes ownership of getting it done.
• Strong business judgement and a genuine interest in understanding how businesses operate.
The Person We Think Will Do Well
You are someone who naturally asks why, wants to understand the numbers behind the business and enjoys solving problems.
You are comfortable moving between detailed financial analysis and broader strategic discussions.
You don't need to be told exactly what to do at every step. You can take a problem, structure it, find the relevant information and come back with a clear view or recommendation.
You are ambitious, but also willing to learn. You are comfortable working closely with senior executives and understand that credibility is built through accuracy, reliability, sound judgement and delivery.
What You'll Gain
This role offers exceptional exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to understand how decisions are made across a large and diverse organisation.
You will gain:
• Direct exposure to Core Group's Executive Leadership Team.
• Hands-on experience in financial and commercial decision-making.
• Exposure to strategy, operations and business performance.
• Experience developing business cases and evaluating new opportunities.
• Involvement in high-impact projects across the organisation.
• A deep understanding of how different business functions work together.
• Executive-level communication and presentation experience.
• Mentorship and exposure to experienced business leaders.
• A strong foundation for future opportunities in finance, strategy, commercial management or general management.
For the right individual, this role can become a significant stepping stone into broader leadership opportunities within Core Group.

Background
The client is running an initiative to modernise approximately 300 IBM ACE integration applications.
Given the scale of the estate and the platform decisions still to be finalised — container platform, compute model, and the per-application migration approach — a contained pilot, rather than a big-bang rollout, is the next step to prove the pattern before wider adoption.
This engagement resources a two-person pilot team to take a small, representative set of ACE workloads from the ~300-application estate, containerise them, and produce a proven, reusable pattern that the wider modernisation programme can adopt.
Purpose of the Engagement
• Prove a containerisation pattern for migrating IBM ACE integration workloads onto AWS container services, implemented in Go and/or Java.
• Deliver pilot workload(s) into a running state on AWS, replacing or wrapping selected existing ACE integration flows.
• Produce reusable platform scaffolding and a migration playbook — reference architecture, CI/CD pipeline templates, and a Go-vs-Java decision framework — so the pattern can be applied across the remaining ~300-application estate.
Scope of Work
In scope
• Platform architecture: confirm target container platform (ECS and/or EKS) and compute model (Fargate vs EC2) for the pilot, building on the platform team's existing ECS-vs-EKS evaluation.
• Go vs Java decision framework: define selection criteria for choosing Go or Java per workload archetype (e.g. throughput, message-flow complexity, team familiarity, library/connector availability), and apply it to the pilot workloads.
• Pilot implementation: select 15 representative ACE workloads, reverse-engineer their integration logic, and re-implement or wrap them as containerised services.
• Platform scaffolding: base container images, CI/CD pipeline templates, configuration and secrets handling, and observability/logging integration for containerised workloads.
• Migration playbook: a documented, repeatable pattern (with worked examples from the pilot) that the wider ~300-application programme can follow.
• Documentation & knowledge transfer: architecture decision records (ADRs), runbooks, and a walkthrough session with the platform and integration teams.
Out of scope
• Migration of the full ~300-application estate — this engagement delivers the pilot and the reusable pattern, not the programme-wide rollout.
• Selection of the long-term target migration approach for the remaining ~300-application estate — that decision sits with the platform architecture team.
• Underlying AWS landing-zone, networking or IAM design outside what the pilot workloads require.
Roles & Responsibilities
RoleResponsibilitiesSenior Software / Platform Engineer (Lead)Owns the containerisation architecture and platform decisions (ECS vs EKS, Fargate vs EC2); defines the Go-vs-Java decision framework; builds platform scaffolding (base images, CI/CD templates, observability integration); defines the migration pattern and playbook; produces ADRs; provides technical direction and review for the Mid-level Engineer.Mid-level Software EngineerImplements pilot containerised workload(s) in Go or Java per the architecture pattern set by the Lead; ports ACE integration flow logic into the target implementation; writes unit and integration tests; contributes to CI/CD pipeline build-out; documents workload-specific migration steps.
Key Deliverables
#DeliverableDescriptionD1Platform reference architectureConfirmed container platform/compute model for the pilot, with supporting rationaleD2Go vs Java decision frameworkDocumented selection criteria, applied to the pilot workloadsD3Pilot workload(s) in production-ready stateSelected ACE workloads running as containerised services on AWSD4Platform scaffoldingBase images, CI/CD pipeline templates, config/secrets and observability integrationD5Migration playbookRepeatable pattern with worked pilot examples, for use across the ~300-app estateD6ADRs & handoverArchitecture decision records, runbooks and knowledge-transfer session
Required Skills & Experience
Lead Software / Platform Engineer
• Strong proficiency in Go and Java, with the judgement to choose between them per use case.
• Hands-on experience with AWS container services — ECS, EKS and Fargate — including production operation.
• Experience with, or fast ability to learn, IBM ACE / IIB integration flow concepts, sufficient to reverse-engineer existing flows.
• CI/CD pipeline design (e.g. GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or equivalent) and Docker/container fundamentals.
• Observability/APM integration experience; familiarity with Dynatrace is advantageous.
• Track record leading platform or application migrations at scale, ideally in a regulated/financial-services environment.

The Integration & API Platform team has completed the API Security Architecture Framework, a GTT architecture-forum-approved framework covering six canonical security patterns (P1–P6) and a clean-slate extended architecture (P7–P9). The extended architecture introduces SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity, OAuth 2.1 / FAPI 2.0, Open Policy Agent (OPA) for policy enforcement.
The framework's four-phase roadmap now moves from design into prototyping — proving the target architecture works in practice and understanding what it will take for existing API consumers, across the L&S, Group Functions and Bank clusters, to migrate onto it.
This engagement is the next step in that roadmap: build a working prototype of the extended security architecture, and turn the abstract framework into a concrete, consumer-facing remediation plan. The initial target architecture the platform is aligning to fronts the API gateway with PingAccess for authentication enforcement: PingAccess authenticates inbound consumer traffic, and the gateway is configured to trust and accept traffic only from PingAccess, with the P7–P9 pattern set layered on top of that trust boundary.
Purpose of the Engagement
• Prototype the PingAccess-fronted gateway architecture as the initial target state — PingAccess enforcing authentication ahead of the gateway, and the gateway trusting only PingAccess-originated traffic — as the foundation for the fuller P7–P9 pattern set (SPIFFE/SPIRE identity issuance, OAuth 2.1 / FAPI 2.0 token flows, OPA policy decisions, and Vault-managed secrets/certificates).
• Assess consumer impact — determine what changes the migration requires of existing API consumers, by cluster and by application, and classify the effort and risk involved.
• Design remediation solutions — produce concrete, implementable remediation guidance mapped to the technology stacks consumers actually run, so consuming teams have a clear path to compliance rather than a framework document.
Scope of Work
In scope
• Prototype build: stand up a working reference implementation with PingAccess fronting the platform's incumbent Gravitee API gateway for authentication enforcement, the gateway configured to trust and accept traffic only from PingAccess, and the P7–P9 pattern set layered on top — all in a non-production environment.
• Consumer inventory & tech-stack discovery: working with cluster architects across L&S, Group Functions and the Bank cluster, inventory API consumers affected by the migration and identify each consumer's authentication method, language/runtime, and hosting model.
• Gap and impact analysis: for each consumer (or consumer archetype), document the delta between current-state and target-state authentication/identity requirements, and classify remediation effort (low / medium / high) and risk.
• Remediation playbooks: produce reusable, stack-specific remediation patterns (e.g. Java/Spring, .NET, Node.js, IBM ACE-based integration flows, and other stacks identified during discovery), each with sample configuration, code snippets, and a validation checklist.
• Rollout recommendation: propose a phased consumer migration sequence, informed by the P3/P5.1.5 HIGH-severity gap priority and the BP2027 roadmap.
• Documentation & knowledge transfer: prototype build notes and runbook, consumer impact report, remediation playbooks, and a walkthrough session with the platform team and cluster architects.
Out of scope
• Production rollout or execution of consumer remediation — this engagement produces the prototype, the impact assessment and the remediation designs, not the migration itself.
• Procurement, licensing or contract negotiation for any tooling used in the prototype.
• Security domains outside API authentication, identity and policy enforcement (e.g. network security, data loss prevention).
Key Deliverables
#DeliverableDescriptionD1Prototype environmentWorking non-production prototype: PingAccess fronting Gravitee with gateway trust restricted to PingAccess-originated traffic, plus P7–P9 (SPIFFE/SPIRE, OAuth 2.1/FAPI 2.0, OPA, Vault) covering P3 and P5.1.5 patternsD2Consumer impact reportConsumer/application inventory with tech-stack profile, gap analysis, and effort/risk classification per clusterD3Remediation playbooksStack-specific remediation guidance with sample configuration and validation checklistsD4Rollout recommendationProposed phased migration sequence aligned to BP2027 roadmap and gap severityD5Build runbook & handoverPrototype build/runbook documentation and knowledge-transfer session to the platform team

Job Title: ServiceNow Data and CMDB Specialist
Office Location:  Johannesburg
Department: IT Service Management Applications
Salary: Market- Related
Working Hours and Working Arrangements
Working hours: 35 hours per week, 09h30–17h30.
Additional hours may be required.
The hybrid working approach allows for up to 40% of working time from home and 60% in the office.
Role Overview
The ServiceNow Data and CMDB Specialist is responsible for the governance, quality and ongoing development of data held within the ServiceNow platform, with particular responsibility for the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), service data, and reporting and insight delivered through or sourced from ServiceNow.
The role ensures that Configuration Items (CIs), their relationships and supporting service data are accurate, complete and kept up to date. This provides a reliable source of information for service management processes, operational decision-making, risk management, automation and the introduction of new services and technologies.
The role also oversees the quality of data supplied to ServiceNow by other systems. Working with source-system owners and integration teams, the role holder establishes clear ownership, agreed data standards and appropriate controls. The role does not own the source systems but is responsible for identifying and coordinating the resolution of issues that affect the quality of data used within ServiceNow.
Requirements
Qualifications
• Relevant practical ServiceNow CMDB, data-governance and reporting experience is more important than holding every listed qualification.
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification or equivalent practical platform experience would be beneficial.
• ServiceNow training or certification relating to CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, Performance Analytics or reporting would be beneficial.
Experience
• At least five years' relevant ServiceNow experience, including practical experience in CMDB, configuration management and platform data.
• Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow CMDB, including CI classes, relationships, lifecycle management, data quality and governance.
• Good understanding of CSDM and how service, application and infrastructure data should be structured and related within ServiceNow.
• Experience of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, Identification and Reconciliation Engine principles, imports and integration data sources.
• Hands-on experience maintaining or improving a CMDB within a medium-to-large organisation, including work with CI classes, relationships, data sources, reconciliation, data-quality controls and remediation.
• Practical experience creating ServiceNow reports and dashboards, turning business requirements into meaningful measures, and checking that reports, dashboards and performance measures are accurate.
• Good understanding of data models, data relationships, data ownership, authoritative sources and data-quality management.
• Experience of Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SQL or another reporting and analytics tool.
• Good understanding of IT service management and how reliable configuration and service data supports Incident, Problem, Change, Asset and Service Level Management.
• Experience considering how data quality and governance underpin ServiceNow AI capabilities such as Now Assist is desirable.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex data issues and recommend practical solutions.
• Experience governing data exchanged between multiple systems.
• Experience working with technical and non-technical data owners to resolve data-quality issues and improve accountability.
•
Skills and Competencies
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data, CMDB and reporting concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Builds positive and collaborative relationships across the company and adapts communication to suit the audience.
• Takes ownership, follows through on agreed actions and uses evidence and sound judgement when making decisions or recommendations.
• Acts with integrity when managing data, presenting results and raising risks or areas of non-compliance.
• Responds positively to change and looks for practical ways to improve the quality and value of ServiceNow data and reporting.
• Shares knowledge and helps colleagues make effective use of ServiceNow data and reporting, contributing to a supportive workplace where people can perform at their best.
Key Responsibilities
• Own the governance, quality and ongoing maturity of the ServiceNow CMDB, ensuring CI data and relationships are accurate, complete, current and fit for purpose.
• Maintain the CMDB data model, CI classes, attributes, relationships and lifecycle standards in line with ServiceNow best practice and the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
• Own the service mapping data model, governance and quality standards, working with service owners and Platform Engineering to ensure business applications, application services, technical services and supporting infrastructure are recorded and related at the appropriate level.
• Work with service, application, infrastructure and data owners to agree ownership, data requirements and responsibilities for maintaining configuration and service data.
• Maintain appropriate controls for creating, updating, reconciling, retiring and deleting CIs.
• Monitor CMDB health through regular data-quality reviews covering completeness, correctness, compliance, duplication, stale records and missing or inaccurate relationships.
• Investigate root causes and work with relevant owners to agree and track corrective action.
• Establish governance standards for data supplied to ServiceNow by other systems, including authoritative sources, ownership, definitions, quality expectations and frequency of updates.
• Maintain a clear record of the main data sources, owners, integration dependencies and agreed controls.
• Work with source-system owners and integration teams to understand how data moves between systems.
• Monitor and reconcile data received through inbound feeds and integrations and coordinate corrective action where issues are identified.
• Consider data-governance requirements when new integrations, services and automation are being designed.
• Work with relevant ServiceNow technical specialists to ensure integrations, discovery sources, imports and automated feeds update ServiceNow data correctly.
• Define and validate CMDB and data requirements for platform changes and integrations.
• Support the effective use of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping and other tools used to populate and maintain the CMDB.
• Work with asset owners to maintain appropriate alignment between configuration and asset data, without taking ownership of the underlying asset-management processes.
• Represent CMDB, data-governance and reporting considerations in relevant project, design and change discussions.
• Promote the effective use of CMDB and service data across Incident, Problem, Change, Asset and other relevant ServiceNow processes.
• Own the standards and governance for ServiceNow reporting.
• Develop shared, cross-platform and management reports, dashboards and performance measures.
• Work with stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into agreed measures.
• Agree definitions and calculation methods for key performance indicators and operational measures.

About Core Group
Core Group represents some of the world’s most valued and loved technology brands across Sub-Saharan Africa. Our mission is to empower individuals and organisations through the world’s leading personal technology products and services.
Our expertise spans retail, distribution, supply chain, finance, marketing, sales, customer experience, human resources and business development, with operations across South Africa and key African markets.

We are looking for an Executive Associate – Finance & Strategy to work closely with a member of Core Group’s Executive Leadership Team.
You will help the executive assess business performance, evaluate opportunities and move key projects forward. Your work will include financial analysis, reporting, business cases, research and working with teams across the organisation. • Supporting the executive with key strategic, commercial and operational priorities.

• Reviewing business performance and identifying trends, risks and opportunities.

• Preparing presentations and briefing documents for executive meetings.
• Supporting projects that involve multiple teams and areas of the business.
• Attending selected leadership meetings and ensuring agreed actions are followed through.
• Working with Finance and other departments to gather and validate information.
• Tracking key projects, deliverables and business priorities.
• Highlighting issues, delays or risks that require executive attention.
• Supporting process improvement and business optimisation initiatives.
• Helping turn executive decisions into clear actions and ensuring momentum is maintained.
• Building strong working relationships with stakeholders across the organisation.
What We’re Looking For
We are looking for someone who is commercially minded, highly analytical and comfortable operating in a senior business environment.
You will ideally have:
• A completed Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related commercial field.
• Strong academic results.
• Honours, postgraduate studies or progress towards a relevant professional qualification would be advantageous.
• Approximately 1–3 years’ experience in finance, audit, consulting, strategy, corporate finance or a similar environment.
• Strong financial and numerical ability.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Strong PowerPoint and presentation skills.
• The ability to analyse large amounts of information and identify the key points.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Excellent attention to detail.
• The ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.
• Confidence engaging with senior stakeholders.
• High levels of professionalism, maturity and discretion.
• A proactive and solutions-focused approach.
• A genuine interest in understanding how businesses operate and make money.
The Person We’re Looking For
You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding how a business works.
You are comfortable with numbers and enjoy digging into the detail, but you can also step back and understand the bigger picture.
You don’t wait to be given every instruction. You take ownership, ask the right questions and work out what needs to happen next.
You are organised, reliable and comfortable working at pace.
Most importantly, you want exposure. You want to learn from experienced business leaders, understand how commercial decisions are made and build the skills that will help you progress into broader leadership roles in the future.
What You’ll Gain
This role offers significant exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to learn how decisions are made across a large and diverse business.
You will gain experience in:
• Financial and commercial decision-making.
• Business strategy and planning.
• Executive reporting and presentations.
• Financial analysis and business cases.
• Cross-functional projects.
• Operational and commercial performance.
• Working with senior stakeholders.
• Understanding how different parts of a business work together.
For the right person, this role can provide a strong foundation for future opportunities within finance, commercial management, strategy or general management across Core Group.

Centurion Debtors Clerk
Location: Centurion, Gauteng
Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent (after 3-month probation period)
Industry: Automotive Parts Importation & Distribution
Salary: R20,000 – R25,000 CTC per month (Negotiable based on experience and qualifications)
About Our Client
Our client is a leading importer and premier distributor of premium automotive replacement parts, workshop equipment, and specialized vehicle components operating across Southern Africa. Built on structured standard operating procedures, robust logistics, and industry-leading systems, the organization fosters a culture of operational efficiency, internal financial control, continuous improvement, and career development.
About the Role
On behalf of our client, we are seeking a meticulous, proactive, and results-driven Debtors Clerk to join their finance team. Reporting directly to the Financial Manager, you will take full accountability for maintaining accurate customer accounts, managing credit control, following up on overdue balances, handling daily banking and cash-ups, and executing month-end reconciliations. This role requires sharp numerical acumen, assertive dispute resolution skills, and the organizational rigor needed to maintain smooth, audit-ready financial operations.
What’s on Offer?
- Basic Salary: R20,000 – R25,000 CTC per month (negotiable based on experience and qualifications).
- Benefits: Membership in the company Provident Fund and an annual December Bonus.
- Career Advancement: Opportunities to gain well-rounded financial exposure and grow within an established, expanding national distributor.
Working Hours & Environment
- Standard Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 – 17:00 (60-minute lunch break). Occasional overtime required during month-end closes, reporting deadlines, or audits.
- Environment: Professional, fast-paced corporate and wholesale distribution finance environment.
- Compliance & Operations: Company financial policies, standard operating procedures, and Health & Safety regulations must be strictly adhered to and upheld at all times.
Key Responsibilities
- Debtors & Credit Control: Timeously distribute monthly customer statements, rigorously pursue overdue accounts, monitor credit limits, and issue final demand notices when required.
- Reconciliations & Queries: Investigate and resolve customer account queries, manage pending credit notes, claims, and refunds, and generate monthly franchise fee invoices.
- Credit Notes & Invoicing: Accurately process and issue authorized credit notes, monitor daily invoice sequence numbers, and maintain systematic invoice filing.
- Cash-Up Balancing & Banking: Balance daily cash-ups (afternoon cash and morning paperwork), complete daily banking runs, and prepare documentation and spreadsheets for scheduled G4S cash collections.
- Petty Cash Management: Disburse petty cash, maintain allocation journals, perform detailed reconciliations, handle paperwork for related entities, and manage cashier floats.
- Filing & Audit Readiness: Maintain structured physical paper banks (cash-ups, credit notes, invoices, and petty cash) and ensure overall records are audit-ready.
- Office & Administrative Support: Procure office and warehouse consumables/cleaning supplies, provide front-desk lunch cover relief at reception, and support the Financial Manager with ad-hoc reporting.
Requirements & Qualifications
- Experience: Minimum 3+ years’ proven finance experience dedicated to debtors, credit control, reconciliations, cash-ups, and month-end reporting.
- Education: Grade 12 / Matric PLUS a completed tertiary qualification (Degree or National Diploma) in Finance or Accounting.
- Systems Knowledge: Advanced proficiency in MS Office (particularly MS Excel, Word, and Outlook) and hands-on experience using recognized financial accounting/ERP software packages.
- Attributes: High attention to detail, strong analytical and numerical reasoning, deadline orientation, and assertive negotiation and conflict resolution skills under pressure.
- Beneficial Experience: Direct exposure to automotive parts, warehousing, or wholesale distribution; familiarity with branch/franchise accounting and multi-float petty cash management.
Strict Legal Requirements
Background screening, credential verification, and reference checks will be conducted on all shortlisted candidates.
- Must be a South African citizen with a valid South African ID.
- Must hold a valid driver's license.
- Must have a clean criminal record.
- Must have a clean credit check (clear ITC record with no adverse listings, judgments, or defaults).
- Must have verifiable, contactable references from previous finance employers.
Required Documentation for Application
Please ensure that you submit the following documentation with your application:
- Detailed CV: Must clearly articulate your finance/debtors track record, accounting software used, and day-to-day reconciliation duties.
- ID Copy: Certified copy required as proof of South African citizenship.
- Driver’s License Copy: Valid copy required for employment records.
- 3 Months Recent Payslips: Your latest three consecutive months of salary advice.
- Supporting Documents: Copies of your Matric certificate, Finance Degree/Diploma, and relevant accounting certifications.

Visit https://www.easternpersonnel.co.za/ and click on Register CV.
Please Note: Only shortlisted candidates who meet all requirements, will be contacted. If you do not hear back within two weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful. Eastern Personnel is fully POPIA compliant, and all personal information will be processed securely and solely for recruitment purposes.

Raizcorp is looking for a mid-to-senior full stack software developer to join its growing development team. The role may be remote (within South Africa), although you must be willing to visit Raizcorp's head office from time to time.
The role
This is a hands-on full-stack role working across four related applications. You’ll spend time extending and maintaining a large, mature multi-tenant SaaS platform, while also contributing to newer Laravel applications that are modernising legacy systems and introducing newer patterns. The work ranges from everyday product development and bug fixing to database changes, integrations, testing, documentation and occasional client-facing UAT support. You’ll need to be comfortable understanding an existing system before changing it, while also being able to build new functionality from a PRD or client brief.
What you'll do
• Build and maintain production features across Laravel, Vue 3 and TypeScript applications, working across both backend and frontend code where required.
• Work with Eloquent models, complex relationships, policies, queues, background jobs and database queries, with attention to performance and tenant data isolation.
• Develop new functionality in both an established SaaS platform and newer applications, following existing architectural patterns rather than introducing unnecessary complexity.
• Design and implement database changes, including safe migrations and data operations in PostgreSQL, with occasional work involving legacy SQL Server and Microsoft Access data.
• Write and maintain automated unit, feature and browser tests, and investigate failures as part of normal development rather than treating testing as a separate phase.
• Work through a PR-based development process: clarify requirements from briefs and PRDs, create focused changes, participate in code review and provide appropriate changelog entries.
• Produce practical technical documentation, including build notes, architecture decisions and documentation of non-obvious behaviour, so that important system knowledge does not remain only in code.
• Support client-facing UAT by preparing test scenarios and seeded data, helping explain changes and resolving issues identified during acceptance testing.
What you'll need
• Solid commercial experience developing applications with PHP and Laravel, including Eloquent, queues, authorisation, migrations and automated testing.
• Production experience with Vue 3 and TypeScript, ideally using Inertia.js or a similar server-driven application architecture.
• Good relational database skills, preferably PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimisation and safe production data changes.
• Experience writing automated tests with Pest or PHPUnit as a normal part of development.
• Comfort working in a large existing codebase: reading and understanding existing behaviour before making changes, and following established patterns.
• Experience with Git and pull-request-based development, including reviewing other developers’ work and responding constructively to review feedback.
• Strong written communication and the ability to discuss requirements and technical issues clearly with non-technical stakeholders.
• A practical approach to development: knowing when to investigate further, when to ask questions and when a smaller change is safer than a large refactor.
Nice to have
• Filament v3/v4 and Livewire.
• Multi-tenant SaaS architecture and tenant-aware queues/caching.
• Tailwind CSS v4, PrimeVue, SurveyJS, CKEditor, AG Grid or similar rich frontend components.
• Domain-Driven Design and state-machine based domain models; ability to read F# is useful but not required.
• Legacy data migration, particularly SQL Server / Microsoft Access to PostgreSQL.
• LLM/AI feature integration, including tool-calling agents and prompt design.
• Laravel Herd, Laravel Cloud, Laravel Forge and GitHub Actions.
• Firebase Authentication, AWS S3, Redis and Laravel Horizon.
• Experience in business-development, entrepreneurship or ed-tech software.
Our stack
Backend
• PHP 8.3+
• Laravel 12 / Laravel 13
• Eloquent, Policies & Gates
• Filament v3/v4, Livewire
• Redis, Horizon, queues
• Spatie Laravel packages
• Laravel AI SDK / OpenAI PHP clientFrontend

Reports to: Head of Financial Operations and Projects
JOB SUMMARY
To monitor, coordinate and provide high-quality management information and to oversee the financial function of CHG hospitals.
REQUIREMENTS
Minimum Qualifications
• CA (SA).
• SAICA Registration required.
• Business Degree advantageous.
Minimum Experience
• 3-5 years’ financial experience.
Key Competencies
• Understanding of the private healthcare industry and hospital operations.
• Financial and Business Acumen.
DELIVERABLES
Provide end-to-end financial management for the assigned hospital facility

Seeking suitable candidates for an Import Freight Controller position, for a well-established clearing and forwarding company, based in Observatory, Cape Town. Preferably someone who has experience in both air and sea freight.
Import Freight Controller must be able to perform the following specific functional responsibilities:
• Be able to interpret a quotation, including the following specific items/terms
• What are the terms of the consignment - ex Works, FOB, CIF, C&F?

• Who is the agent?

• Correctly identify what documentation is required to effect the clearance of the consignment

• Know the company's  value chain (quotes to final delivery)

• Contact the shipper or agent, and request the relevant shipping documentation
• Be able to register the shipment on ShipShape
• Be able to capture the necessary information into ShipShape
• Be able to make a cargo booking with the carrier
• Be able to complete a bill of lading or air way bill
• Be able to complete a certificate of origin or other certificates/permits as/if required.
• Be able to advise the shipper and consignee of the milestone dates of the consignment
• Arrange with a transporter/trucking company for pick-up and delivery of goods to depot
• Follow up with the relevant parties to track the consignment
• Be able to accurately complete the Cover Sheet for invoicing purposes.
• Be able to calculate and record all charges relating to the shipment
• Be able to engage with the relevant parties
• Interacting with the company’s Customs Department to create and submit the BoE
• Interact with the company's Logistics Team to arrange delivery
• Advising the consignee of all charges
• Liaising with the Finance department to create a proforma/draft invoice for the client
• Submit the invoice to the client, and obtain payment prior to submission of customs documentation and delivery
• Ensure the delivery of the cargo
• Ensure that all necessary import documentation has been completed
• Ensure that the cargo has been picked up on time and delivered to consignee.
• Follow up with the client that the delivery was made
• Get feedback from the client regarding service
• Handle unusual circumstances
• Know when additional import documentation is required
• Know how to complete and submit import permit documentation
• Be able to complete documentation required for a provisional or penalty payment salary dependent on experience
