Turn Your Commercial Experience into Entrepreneurial ImpactAre you a financially astute business professional who understands more than just the numbers?
Perhaps you are a financial analyst, commercial manager, finance leader, business operator or entrepreneur with a strong understanding of how business finance, strategy, sales, and operations work together. You may have reached a point in your career where you are looking for something different: an opportunity to use your experience to guide business owners, develop entrepreneurs and create measurable impact.
If you have run your own business, understand the realities of entrepreneurship and are ready to move from analysing or managing businesses to helping entrepreneurs build stronger ones, this could be the career change you have been looking for.
Raizcorp is looking for a seasoned, well-rounded business professional to join us as a business coach.
This is a full-time, salaried role in which you will coach a portfolio of entrepreneurs across every area of their businesses, including finance, strategy, sales, marketing, operations, people and personal development.
You do not need any previous coaching experience. Raizcorp will train you in our internationally recognised coaching methodology. What you do need is substantial business experience, strong commercial judgement, empathy for entrepreneurs and a genuine desire to help others succeed.
What you’ll do
· Hold structured monthly one-on-one coaching sessions with entrepreneurs.
· Help business owners interpret their financial information and use it to make better commercial decisions.
· Guide entrepreneurs in strengthening their strategies, sales approaches, marketing activities, operational systems and people practices.
· Facilitate business simulations and group learning sessions using Raizcorp’s proven programmes and methodology.
· Manage a defined portfolio of entrepreneurs and track progress in areas such as revenue, profitability, business capability and founder development.
· Challenge entrepreneurs to think critically, evaluate trade-offs and take accountability for their decisions.
· Connect the different areas of a business so entrepreneurs can make integrated, forward-looking decisions.
· Remain informed about economic conditions, market shifts and regulations that may affect entrepreneurs and their businesses.
· Collaborate closely with other coaches and specialists to support each entrepreneur’s development journey.
This role may be a strong fit for you if you are:
· A financial analyst or finance professional who has developed a strong understanding of business operations and commercial decision-making.
· A commercial or operational leader who wants to use your experience in a more purpose-driven role.
· A current or former entrepreneur who understands both the rewards and pressures of building a business.
· An experienced business professional looking for a meaningful career change.
· Someone who enjoys developing people, asking insightful questions and helping others arrive at better decisions. Empathy in this role is super important.
· Motivated by the opportunity to influence real business results rather than simply report on them.
What you’ll need
· Between 10 and 15-plus years of experience across corporate, commercial and entrepreneurial environments.
· Experience owning or running your own business at some point in your career. This is a non-negotiable requirement.
· Strong financial and commercial acumen, with the ability to interpret business performance beyond the income statement.
· Experiential depth in business finance, strategy and sales.
· A practical understanding of how marketing, operations, people and finance influence one another.
· The ability to identify patterns, challenge assumptions and help entrepreneurs evaluate business trade-offs.
· High emotional intelligence and genuine empathy for the realities of entrepreneurship.
· A mature, accountable and non-judgemental approach.
· Strong communication and facilitation skills.
· An organised, systematic and proactive working style.
· Confidence using technology and business systems, including Microsoft 365 or Microsoft Office and learner management systems.
· A commerce-related tertiary qualification. An MBA or other master’s-level qualification will be an advantage.
· A valid driver’s licence and your own vehicle.
What you’ll gain
· The opportunity to turn years of commercial and entrepreneurial experience into meaningful impact.
· A career in which you work directly with entrepreneurs and their businesses every day.
· Formal training in an internationally recognised business-coaching methodology.
· Continuous professional development and exposure to businesses across different industries and stages of growth.
· The opportunity to influence revenue, profitability, founder capability and long-term business sustainability.
· A supportive, fiercely caring team culture that backs the jockey—the entrepreneur—not only the horse.
· A rare opportunity to build a new career without leaving the world of business behind.
Ready for a different kind of business career?
You have spent years analysing businesses, leading teams, making commercial decisions or building something of your own.
Now, you could use that experience to help entrepreneurs make better decisions, build stronger businesses and become more capable business leaders.
Move from measuring business performance to helping create it.

THE JOB AT A GLANCE
As the Claims Administrator, you will be reporting to the Team Leader: Claims Administrator. You will be responsible for capturing of claims, following up on outstanding documents from relevant stakeholders and indexing of documents. You will also be responsible for keeping stakeholders informed and updated via various channels i.e. email, telephone, SMS etc. throughout the various stages of the claims processing cycle. • Identify and edit/correct the legibility of scanned documents

• Provide backup services for team members
• Capture Temporary Total Disablement for payment.
Query resolution

• Identify and escalate priority issues
• Act as backup for the Contact Centre for email\calls overflow and during system downtime.

• Carry out all office planning on a regular basis, as issues arise, or in advance of anticipated needs
• Continuously ensure proper housekeeping, safety and security of the Rand Mutual Properties
• Compiling records of office activities i.e. keep an electronic and manual register of walk in clients
• Order and maintain relevant office supplies
• Arrange team meetings and distribute minutes.
Customer Service
• Regularly communicate and liaise verbally and in writing with customers/suppliers/visitors/enquirers and relevant staff, and interpret and respond clearly and effectively to spoken requests over the phone or in person, and to verbal or written instructions

The role is responsible for maintaining the creative quality and consistency of all design output, from initial concept development through to final artwork and production.
The incumbent will translate technical fire-safety products, services and business information into clear, professional and visually engaging communication for both business-to-business and consumer audiences.
Beyond day-to-day design production, the role has an evolving mandate to assist the Marketing Manager in establishing and formalising an internal marketing division. The incumbent will help develop the creative standards, systems, templates and workflows required to improve the division's agility and reduce its reliance on external agencies.

Graphic Design & Creative Production
• Conceptualise and produce high-quality creative work across corporate, marketing, sales, recruitment and internal communication requirements.
• Design material for print and digital platforms, including social media content, digital advertising, brochures, product sheets, presentations, proposals, billboards, signage, exhibition material, website graphics and internal communication.
• Translate technical fire-safety information into clear, accessible and visually engaging communication.
• Develop campaign concepts, creative treatments, mood boards and visual mock-ups that respond effectively to marketing briefs.
• Prepare accurate, production-ready artwork for print, digital publishing and external suppliers.
• Adapt approved creative work into the correct sizes, specifications and formats for different media platforms.
• Maintain organised working files and archives of completed artwork, templates, brand assets and campaign material.
• Quality-control all final artwork for layout, spelling, technical accuracy and production readiness.
Brand Development & Consistency
• Maintain a consistent visual identity and brand tone across all Fidelity Services Group marketing and communication material.
• Ensure that all creative output aligns with Fidelity Services Group brand guidelines.
• Collaborate with the Marketing Manager on concept development for campaigns, launches, events and internal initiatives.
• Work with photographers, videographers, agencies, printers and other creative suppliers to ensure that the approved creative direction is applied correctly.
• Review and quality-control creative output produced by junior team members and external suppliers where applicable.
• Identify opportunities to strengthen and modernise Fidelity Services Group's visual identity without compromising its corporate credibility.
Digital & Motion Design
• Develop digital-first creative content for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Google and other relevant platforms.
• Design animated social media content, digital banners, campaign graphics and basic motion assets.
• Support video production through the development of storyboards, title screens, lower thirds, transitions, presentation graphics and end frames.
• Ensure that creative material is supplied in the correct aspect ratios and technical formats for each digital platform.
• Work closely with videographers and content producers to maintain a consistent visual approach across static and motion-based content.
Team Formalisation & Marketing Support
Evolving Responsibility
• Assist the Marketing Manager in formalising an internal marketing division, including defining design workflows, production standards and creative processes.
• Contribute to developing the equipment, software, templates and resourcing requirements for an in-house creative capability.

• Help establish briefing templates, brand toolkits, approval processes and quality-control standards to streamline creative production.

about_role:
SENIOR PROCUREMENT OFFICER
Drive Strategic Sourcing. Build Global Partnerships. Deliver Exceptional Value.
Are you a strategic, commercially minded procurement professional who thrives on negotiation, supplier relationships and finding innovative ways to secure the right products at the right price?
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Senior Procurement Officer to take ownership of a dynamic procurement function, balancing fast-turnaround local sourcing with high-volume, cost-effective international importing from China.
This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys working across procurement, supplier management, international trade, logistics, quality control and cost optimisation.
🎯 PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
The Senior Procurement Officer will be responsible for ensuring that the procurement department operates efficiently, strategically and seamlessly.
You will develop and implement procurement strategies, build strong local and international supplier partnerships, negotiate competitive commercial terms and ensure that goods and services are sourced at the best overall value while maintaining quality, compliance and delivery standards.
🔑 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management
• Identify, evaluate and qualify local branding houses, stockists and international/Chinese manufacturers.
• Develop and maintain strong, long-term supplier relationships.
• Build strategic partnerships with Chinese agents and factories to secure competitive pricing and priority production capacity.
• Negotiate supplier agreements, pricing, lead times and commercial terms.
• Develop a diversified supplier base to minimise supply-chain risk and over-reliance on individual suppliers.
2. Local & International Procurement
Manage a dual-track procurement strategy:
🇨🇳 China Procurement
• Manage the end-to-end procurement and importing process for high-volume orders.
• Plan around extended international lead times and Chinese public holidays.
• Coordinate production schedules and container space.
• Monitor orders closely from initial quotation through to final delivery. 🇿🇦 Local Procurement
• Source products from reliable local stockists and suppliers for urgent and fast-turnaround requirements.
• Identify opportunities where local sourcing provides advantages in terms of speed, availability and overall cost.
3. Financial Negotiation & Cost Control
• Negotiate highly competitive supplier pricing and payment terms.
• Calculate the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) for imported products.
• Evaluate FOB and CIF pricing while factoring in:
• Customs duties and tariffs
• Agent fees
• Freight costs
• Clearing costs
• Inland logistics
• Other associated import expenses
• Ensure procurement decisions deliver genuine commercial value, not simply the lowest unit price.

The ideal candidate is someone who understands apparel and footwear retail, enjoys working with stock and data, and can turn information into practical action.
This person must not only be able to pull reports, but must also understand what the numbers mean, why stock issues happen, and how to solve them. They must understand the mechanics of inventory planning from the ground up and be able to follow through from planning, to communication, to execution.
The right candidate will be structured, analytical, practical, and hands-on, with a strong ability to solve problems and improve how stock flows through the business.
Job Purpose
The Apparel Inventory Planner is responsible for ensuring that the right products are available in the right stores, in the right quantities, at the right time.
This role manages stock planning, replenishment, allocations, size curves, transfers, stock balancing, and inventory reporting across retail stores, online channels, and warehouse locations.
The role requires someone who understands inventory planning from the ground up — not only the reporting side, but also the working mechanics behind stock movement, replenishment, allocations, store demand, ERP accuracy, warehouse flow, and execution across the business.
The Apparel Inventory Planner plays a critical role in improving stock availability, reducing stock-outs, managing slow-moving stock, supporting better buying decisions, and ensuring that inventory supports sales, customer demand, and profitability.
Key Responsibilities
1. Stock Planning & Replenishment
●    Plan and manage stock levels across all stores, online channels, and warehouse locations.
●    Monitor weekly sales, stock-on-hand, sell-through, weeks-of-cover, and stock availability.
●    Identify fast-moving, slow-moving, and out-of-stock products.
●    Recommend replenishment actions based on sales trends, stock holding, store performance, and customer demand.
●    Ensure key styles, best sellers, and core products are available in the correct quantities and sizes.
●    Maintain proper size curves across footwear, apparel, and accessories.
●    Identify gaps in stock availability before they become sales problems.
●    Support the business in maintaining the correct balance between stock availability and stock efficiency.
2. Allocations & Store Stock Balancing
●    Allocate new stock to stores based on sales history, store grading, product type, size demand, store capacity, and available stock.
●    Review stock distribution regularly and recommend store-to-store transfers where required.
●    Ensure stores are not overstocked or understocked in specific products, categories, or sizes.
●    Support new store openings, promotional launches, campaigns, and seasonal product drops with correct stock allocations.
●    Ensure stock is placed where it has the highest chance of selling.
●    Monitor store stock levels and recommend corrective actions where stores are carrying poor size curves, excess stock, or insufficient depth.
3. Inventory Reporting & Analysis
●    Prepare weekly and monthly inventory reports to support decision-making.
●    Report on key inventory metrics, including:
○    Stock-on-hand
○    Sell-through
○    Weeks-of-cover
○    Stock-outs
○    Slow movers
○    Best sellers
○    Store performance by category
○    Size availability
○    Transfer requirements
○    Replenishment needs
●    Analyse product, store, category, and size performance.
●    Identify risks and opportunities in the stock position.
●    Translate sales and stock data into clear, practical actions.
●    Provide management with meaningful insights, not just reports.
4. ERP & System Management
●    Maintain and monitor accurate product, stock, and planning information on the ERP system.
●    Ensure ERP data supports accurate planning, replenishment, reporting, and stock decision-making.
●    Monitor transfers, shipments, receipts, and stock movements to ensure they are processed correctly.
●    Follow up on unconfirmed shipments, outstanding transfers, receiving issues, and system discrepancies.
●    Work closely with the Stock Controller to identify and resolve stock accuracy issues.
●    Assist with stock take preparation, variance analysis, and stock accuracy improvement.
●    Understand how system transactions impact physical stock, store availability, and reporting accuracy.
5. Planning Principles & Execution
●    Understand planning principles from the ground up through to execution.
●    Understand the full working mechanics of inventory planning, including how sales, stock, replenishment, allocations, transfers, buying, warehouse movement, and store performance all connect.
●    Build planning recommendations that are practical, executable, and aligned with business reality.
●    Identify the root cause of stock issues rather than only reacting to symptoms.
●    Ensure that planning decisions are followed through into action.
●    Work across teams to make sure that plans are implemented properly and that stock movements are completed.
6. Buying & Product Support
●    Support the buying team with stock history, sales data, product performance, and size curve insights.
●    Provide recommendations on reorder quantities, product depth, store allocations, and replenishment requirements.
●    Assist in identifying products that should be repeated, discontinued, marked down, transferred, or rebalanced.
●    Support seasonal, capsule, promotional, and core product planning.
●    Provide input into future stock buys based on actual store and product performance.
●    Help ensure that buying decisions are informed by data, store demand, and practical stock flow.
7. Store & Warehouse Communication
●    Communicate stock movements, transfer requirements, replenishment priorities, and stock actions clearly to stores and warehouse teams.
●    Follow up with stores on receiving, transfers, stock discrepancies, and stock availability issues.
●    Work with store teams to understand customer demand, stock gaps, size requests, and product feedback.
●    Ensure stores follow the correct processes for stock movement, receiving, transfers, and reporting.
●    Work with warehouse teams to ensure stock is dispatched, received, and processed accurately and timeously.
●    Escalate stock issues where needed and drive practical solutions.
8. Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement
●    Identify stock-related problems and work through them logically.
●    Understand the root cause of issues relating to stock-outs, overstocking, poor size curves, delayed transfers, system inaccuracies, or poor sell-through.
●    Recommend practical solutions that improve stock flow and store performance.

about_role:

Dis-Chem Pharmacies require the services of a reputable Pharmacist Assistant Post Basic Qualified - PBQ for their Benmore Gardens store. You will be responsible for dispensing medications, providing pharmaceutical expertise to patients and healthcare professionals, and ensuring the safe and effective use of prescription medications.
Minimum Requirements:
• Grade 12 / Matric
• Post Basic Pharmacist Assistant Qualification
• Registered with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC)
• Willing and able to work retail hours Advantageous:
• Knowledge of Retail/ FMCG operations
• 3rd Additional Language
• Knowledge of or experience in SAP and E-Scripting
• Unisolve Experience
Duties and Responsibilities:
• Pharmacy Council
• A pharmacist's assistant registered in the category pharmacist's assistant (post-basic) may perform the
• following services or acts under the direct personal supervision of a pharmacist in a pharmacy:
• the sale of Schedule 1 and Schedule 2 medicines or scheduled substances
• assist with the compounding, manipulation or preparation of a non-sterile or sterile medicine or scheduled substance according to a formula and Standard Operating Procedures approved by the responsible pharmacist
• assist with the manufacturing of a non-sterile or sterile medicine or scheduled substance according to a formula and Standard Operating Procedures approved by the responsible pharmacist the re-packaging of medicine the distribution and control of stock of Schedule 1 to Schedule 5 medicines or scheduled substances
• the ordering of medicine and scheduled substances up to and including Schedule 5 according to an instruction of a person authorised in terms of the Medicines Act to purchase or obtain such medicine or scheduled substance
• the reading and preparation of a prescription, the selection, manipulation or compounding of the medicine, the labelling and supply of the medicine in an appropriate container following the interpretation and evaluation of the prescription by a pharmacist
• the provision of instructions regarding the correct use of medicine supplied
• the provision of information to individuals in order to promote health
Dispensing of Medication under direct personal supervision of Pharmacist:
• Accurately interpret scripts and act in a professional and responsible manner and within the legal requirements in accordance with the South African Pharmacy Council
• Capture script details accurately and verify patient’s details on the system
• Ensure accurate picking / packing / labelling and checking of medication and be aware of common dosages as well as important drug interactions
• Give accurate instructions to the patients regarding the correct use of medicine supplied
• Keep abreast of changes in medical scheme procedures and requirements for claims and dispensing
• Ensure that all prescriptions entered, are checked for accuracy by a pharmacist and signed by a pharmacist
Customer Service:
• Advise and assist patients at the dispensary, self-medication counter and front-shop
• Follow up with patients regarding script tracking report as requested by the dispensary manager and follow up appointments
• Explain all medical aid cost to patients
• Provide information to individuals in order to promote health
• Follow through on any promises made to customers
Administration:
• Process all paperwork necessary for the accurate submission of claims to medical schemes
• Correct errors on scripts rejected by medical scheme
• Ensure authorization of chronic, HIV and oncology medication
• Maintain customer profiles on the system
• Merge profiles locally and Vexall should be notified to merge profiles centrally
• Take note of any messages on the customer profile and take suitable action
Stock Control:
• Report on low/out of stock levels and stock errors to the dispensary manager
• Facilitate Bi-annual stock takes
• Exercise stock, cash and asset control
General:
• Housekeeping must be in accordance to Dis-Chem standards. Make sure that the store is always clean and tidy.
• Adhere to Dis-Chem policies and procedures and standard operating procedures.
• Adhere to health and safety rules and regulations.
• Fridges and workstations must be clear of clutter and personal belongings.
• All staff must work in Dis-Chem approved uniforms.
ROLE COMPETENCIES
• Knowledge and understanding of Unisolv SAP.
• Finds solutions to potential issues as well as knowing when to escalate the problem
• and what level to escalate it to.
• Excellent communication skills, including the ability to communicate with people from
• all sections of the community.
• Addresses customer queries in a timely manner.
• Takes personal responsibility for the quality and timeliness of work and achieves
• results with little oversight.
• Demonstrate patience and the ability to remain calm in stressful situations.
• Technical skills Computer i.e. Microsoft office, numerical skills, Unisolv, E-Scripting
Special conditions of employment:
• Registered with the South African Pharmacy Council
• Willing and able to work retail hours
• Controlled room temperature, security, limited space, health and safety, risk stock
• Physically fit and able to stand for a long period
• Valid driver’s license
• Clear credit and criminal records
Remuneration and benefits:
• Market-related salary
• Medical aid
• Provident fund
• Staff account

The primary responsibility of the Academic Student Counsellor is to support the academic success and well-being of students at Belgium Campus iTversity. The role involves providing counselling services, interventions, and support programs to students with academic or psychological challenges. The aim is to prevent academic failure, promote mental well-being, and ensure that students have the necessary tools to succeed in their studies, this includes assistance to students with special needs.
1.      Job overview
The aim of this profile is to ensure that the role of the student counsellor here at Belgium campus ITversity is well integrated into the organizations’ strategic vision and mission. Furthermore, that as key participants in the available support services for the students studying at Belgium campus, the candidate accounts for the wellbeing of both the students’ academic progress. Ensuring that they prevent, promote, intervene and refer when appropriate to do so, as a means to adequately assist the student during the fulfilment of their academic studies.
Belgium Campus is committed to offering students with disabilities, or specific needs access to all courses provided by the institution, to ensure the following:
•  Assist students to fully participate, as allowed by your condition and circumstances
•  Assist students to study effectively and on equal terms with other students As an institution of higher education, Belgium Campus ITversity prides itself with being the first South African institution to have a special program for deaf and disabled students. To date, we cater for students with varying disabilities, partially sighted, hard of hearing and profoundly deaf students.
2.    Duties & Responsibilities
The aim of the duties and responsibilities detailed below are intended to provide a general overview of what entails the core duties that are directly linked to the professional aspect of the role. Furthermore, the general duties that highlight the additional measures that the candidate is required to fulfil.
Student support refers to tutoring, mentoring, guidance and counselling to maximise academic performance and attending to students’ academic, and psychological needs – that may impinge on the students’ academic development. The education faculty, academic lecturers and the student support department are partners in the above-mentioned endeavours.
a.  Core duties & Responsibilities – These include student advocacy; student welfare – this includes both social and academic wellbeing; liaison & interaction; special projects and general administration.
b. General Duties & Responsibilities –Attending training for career development; be responsible for ones’ own continuing self-development; ensure good communication systems.
Core duties & Responsibilities
Area
Outcomes
Student counselling
- Act as an advisor and a consultant to students on issues related to their academic development.
- Provide assistance to at-risk students with academic challenges by offering guidance on tools such as study methods, time management skills and note taking skills.
- Screening and identification of academic challenges through individual student counselling
- Providing preventative, developmental counselling services and academic interventions for students who are at-risk.
- Develop and manage intervention programmes with associated intervention programmes and processes made available by the institution.
Special needs students
- Assist students with equity and welfare issues that may be affecting their ability to study.
- Liaise with and refer students to appropriate departments or staff for assistance.
Customer interaction
- Contacting the responsible person who for the students’ fees if the student is reluctant to get assistance for this at-risk academic behaviour.
- Referring the students if need be, to a local educational psychologist.
- Organize and facilitate student support workshops for students at all campuses.
- Organize on-campus activities including one-on-one with students and group-based workshops e.g. career seminars
Reporting
- Provide regular reports to both management and the student support department on the following:
- Quarterly sponsored student reports
- The number of students that the counsellor(s) assisted and mechanisms that were utilized to assist students

Job Summary:
Europcar is seeking a motivated and dedicated Credit Controller to join our team at Bruma, Johannesburg. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and maintaining the company's credit control function, ensuring that all outstanding debts are promptly collected and reconciled. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and experience in credit control within the automotive or rental industry.
Position Overview
The purpose of the position is minimizing risk to the business by monitoring active accounts and managing the credit terms and limits of these accounts through collecting payments timeously. This is done through meeting customer requirements for payment and professionally communicating indebtedness to customers, thereby delivering excellent customer service and reducing/preventing bad debt losses.
Specific Role Responsibilities
• Telephonic and electronic collections of all amounts due.
• KPI would be to log a minimum of 32 customer contacts daily.
• Conduct regular customer visits to build and maintain good customer relationships, and proactive prevention of issues developing.
• Ensure that at least 100% average of the monthly targeted collections is achieved.
• Investigating and logging all queries on outstanding accounts, following up and providing feedback to the customer once queries have been resolved.
• Analysis of overdue amounts on accounts to highlight areas of improvement or problems to be attended to.
• Regular reporting and feedback regarding problem accounts. Escalation of problem accounts to the Credit Manager within prescribed time frames.
• Processing and allocation of all payments received as per the daily bank statement and deposit slips strictly in accordance with the remittance advice from the customer.
• Preparation of journals with supporting documentation. Filing, record keeping and various other admin duties.
• Effectively minimize bad debt and increase collections

Dis-Chem Pharmacies require the services of a Dispensary Manager Trainee for their store in Woodlands Store, To assist in the management of the Dispensary functions by supervising the dispensary including self-medication area and manage subordinated staff.  To provide pharmaceutical care by taking responsibility for the patients related needs and be accountable for meeting these needs. To effectively deliver excellent customer service and stock management.
Requirements:
Essential:
• Grade 12 / Matric
• BPharm / equivalent qualification
• Registered with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC)
• Minimum 2 – 5 years pharmaceutical experience
• Unisolv experience
• Experience in supervising staff
• Computer literate – MS Office Advantageous:
• Previous dispensary management and practical work experience
Duties and Responsibilities:
• Act in accordance with the rules and regulations of the South African Pharmacy Council (“SAPC”).
• Safeguard and safekeeping of schedule 6 medication by administering the process of safekeeping of the medication key including the records and the register.
• Ensure all staff work within SAPC scope of practice.
• Ensure that Good Pharmacy Practice rules and regulations are adhered to by all employees.
• Ensure SAPC registration and annual registration fees are updated consistently.
• Ensure all employees adhere to the confines of the Protection of Personal Information Act (“POPIA”) act to protect confidential information.
• Accurately capture and interpret script details and verify patient’s details on the system.
• Be conscious and mindful of various fraudulent activities such as doctors’ scripts.
• Ensure accurate picking / packing / labeling and checking of medication and be aware of common dosages as well as important drug interactions.
• Provide accurate instructions to patients in relation to accurate usage of medicine supplied.
• Keep abreast of changes in medical aid procedures and requirements for claims and dispensing
• To assist with managing the dispensary stock to minimize stock shrinkage.
• Manage all expired or short dated stock that is held in the dispensary.
• Ensure that expired stock is regularly disposed of and kept separate to usable stock on an ongoing basis.
• Manage dormant, negative stock and ensure follow ups and investigations are conducted.
• Assist in managing stock ordering process is followed to reach maximum purchasing compliance.
• Manage the stock days and ensure that the hot list is checked and managed on regular basis.
• Encourage timely quality care & exceptional customer service and act as the face of the dispensary department.
• Advice and assist patients at the dispensary, self-medication counter and front shop when necessary.
• To provide accurate and precise information to patients such as medical aid costs.
• Able to identify patient requirements and respond in a professional manner at all times.
• Manage customer service initiatives in the dispensary that results in a great customer experience, drives customer loyalty, and achieves great customer satisfaction.
• Process accurately all the paperwork necessary for correct administration of your department.
• Ensure correct process is followed for all paperwork necessary for the accurate submission of claims to medical aids.
• Ensure assistance is offered for authorization of chronic, HIV and AIDS and oncology medication.
• Maintain customer profiles on the system.
• Merge profiles locally and UCS should be notified to merge profiles centrally.
• Take note of any messages on the customer profile and take suitable action.
• Ensure dispensary and self-medication areas are always adequately staffed and staff rosters are in place.
• Ensure staff works within their ethical boundaries as governed by the South African Pharmacy Council.
• Ensure that fridges and work stations are clear of clutter and personal belongings.
• Facilitate the creation of accountable, full service teams who understand and strive to meet the needs of all customers through effective inspirational leadership.
• Take full responsibility for performance of all direct reports, motivating and managing them in relation to quality standards and agreed benchmarks and objectives, focusing on all aspects of sound people management.
• Reinforce continuous respectful communication amongst teams & ensure inclusive work environment.
• Facilitate people management practices including the delivery and submission of applicable HR documentation timeously.
• Authorise all work schedules on Kronos and ensure accurate delivery of information.
• Drive and foster engagement within the store to ensure maximum performance and positive work culture.
• Housekeeping must be in accordance to Dis-Chem standards.
• Adhere to Dis-Chem Policies and Procedures and Standard Operating Procedures.
• Adhere to Health and Safety rules and regulations.
• Adhere to Dis-Chem Uniform and personal appearance policy.

• English and second language – Read, write and speak
• Good communication skills.

• Leadership Skills
• Priorities the needs and experiences of customers and places them at the center of the decision-making process.
• Business Acumen
• Technical Savvy
• Interpersonal Skills
• Culture Champion
• Computer skills: Microsoft (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) Unisolv, SAP, E-Scripting

• Physically fit – standing for long hours

We are looking for a Site Reliability & Production Support Engineer to help ensure the availability, performance and resilience of the systems that support our customers and our business.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Site Reliability & Production Support Engineer to maintain and improve the availability, performance, and resilience of our production systems.
You will own production incidents from investigation through to resolution, implementing fixes yourself where possible and coordinating with other teams or external providers where needed.
You will also address root causes, prevent recurring issues, improve monitoring, and automate support and recovery tasks.
Key Responsibilities
Production support and incident resolution
• Support production applications, APIs, databases, infrastructure, and integrations.
• Own incidents from detection and triage through investigation, service restoration, and closure.
• Prioritise incidents based on severity, business impact, and affected services.
• Investigate issues using logs, metrics, traces, database queries, application code, and infrastructure diagnostics.
• Implement configuration, script, infrastructure, and application code changes within your area of responsibility.
• Carry out controlled rollbacks, failovers, restarts, and message reprocessing with appropriate safeguards.
• Coordinate engineering teams and external providers where their expertise or access is needed, and drive issues through to resolution.
• Keep incident records and communicate impact, progress, and recovery status to stakeholders.
• Participate in an agreed on-call rotation, including support for critical incidents outside business hours.Root cause analysis and prevention
• Conduct root cause investigations and blameless incident reviews.
• Identify causes and contributing factors across applications, infrastructure, processes, and dependencies.
• Document incident timelines, recovery actions, findings, and preventative measures.
• Assign owners to corrective actions, track completion, and verify that fixes address the underlying problem.
• Identify recurring incidents and support requests, and implement changes to prevent them.Reliability and observability
• Define and monitor service level indicators and objectives with engineering and business stakeholders.
• Build and maintain dashboards, alerts, centralised logging, and distributed tracing.
• Monitor system health, performance, dependencies, and customer impact.
• Reduce alert noise and improve failure detection.
• Address reliability risks, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and single points of failure.
• Define and support resilience tests, disaster recovery exercises, and backup and restore testing.Automation and operational improvement
• Automate repetitive support tasks, diagnostics, health checks, and recovery procedures.
• Maintain operational tools, scripts, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.
• Contribute to infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment safeguards.
• Ensure services have the monitoring, health checks, rollback plans, and documentation needed for production support.
• Work with developers to improve timeout handling, retries, idempotency, and graceful failure.
• Follow production access controls, change management, and audit requirements.
Required Experience and Skills
• A Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 5+ years' relevant experience in SRE, production engineering, DevOps, technical application support, or a similar production-focused technical role.
• Experience investigating and resolving production incidents.
• Ability to troubleshoot applications, databases, operating systems, networks, and cloud infrastructure.
• Experience supporting cloud-hosted and on-premises workloads.
• Practical SQL skills, including diagnosing connectivity, query performance, locking, and connection pooling issues.
• Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and distributed tracing tools.
• Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, C#, or Go.
• Ability to read application code, investigate defects, and work with developers on fixes.
• Familiarity with CI/CD, version control, infrastructure as code, and safe production deployments.
• Clear written and verbal communication, especially during incidents.
• Ability to take ownership, solve problems systematically, and prioritise under pressure.Practical production experience is important to us. While 5+ years' relevant experience is preferred, we will consider the depth and relevance of hands-on experience alongside formal qualifications and years of experience.
Advantageous Experience
• Microsoft Azure.
• One or more of .NET, Laravel, Go, Python, or Rust.
• Container platforms and orchestration tools, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar tools.
• Terraform and Git-based delivery pipelines.
• High-volume transactional systems, distributed architectures, or customer-facing financial services platforms.
• Disaster recovery, high availability, and multi-region architectures.
What Success Looks Like
• Faster incident detection and service restoration, with fewer recurring incidents.
• Clear ownership of incidents and corrective actions through to completion.
• Permanent fixes that are verified to address root causes.
• Measurable reliability objectives that inform engineering priorities.
• Useful dashboards, actionable alerts, and up-to-date runbooks.
• Less manual support work through automation and safe, automated recovery.
• Timely, accurate stakeholder communication during incidents.

Introduction to the VKB Group
The VKB Group is an agricultural company, providing support to farmers and producing straight-from-the farm-foods for consumers. Apart from the various consumer brands, the VKB Group is also represented by its regional brands: VKB, GWK and NTK. Our roots are firmly planted in agriculture with farming at our core, continuously growing and evolving throughout the years.
Starting with providing everything needed on the farm to produce food, we now also operate in all areas of the food supply chain: processing, logistics, and national and global market channels.
This “house of brands” we’ve established with the support of our farmer shareholders is the foundation for building the agribusiness of the future.
Our Values
At VKB, we live by five core values:
• HUMBLE: We acknowledge that we are blessed.
• HUNGRY: We don’t settle for mediocrity.
• BOLD: We do what is right, even when it’s difficult.
• SMART: We think carefully before we act.
• TEAM PLAYERS: We achieve more together than alone.Mechanic (Bring Your Skills, Grit & Gear!)
Job Descibtion
The successful candidate will be responsible for the maintenance, servicing, repair, and inspection of agricultural equipment and machinery to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation. This role requires strong technical expertise, attention to detail, and a customer-focused mindset to support both workshop and field service operations.
As part of a CASE Agency, the role will focus specifically on CASE agricultural machinery and equipment, ensuring high service standards in line with manufacturer and VKB requirements.
Ready to join a team where innovation meets horsepower?
If you love solving problems, getting your hands dirty, and working with people who live their values — Hungry, Humble, Smart, Bold, and Team Players — then this is your kind of workshop!
What You’ll Need
• Grade 12 / NQF 4
• Completed N2 — Tractor Mechanic
• 3–5 years’ experience as a mechanic
• A sharp eye for detail — precise, thorough, accurate
• Knowledge of mechanical systems, hydraulics, and basic electrical systems
• A mindset that always looks for ways to add value
• Clear criminal record
• A team-first attitude
What You’ll Be Doing
• Putting together spot-on quotations that match customer needs
• Servicing, repairing, and overhauling agricultural equipment (tractors, implements & more!)
• Ensure that all work sheets for services rendered, are done according to VKB’s policies and procedures
• Playing it safe: sticking to all Health & Safety rules
• Build long-term relationships with customers and suppliers
• Correctly complete all guarantee claims and claims information
• Sharing your knowledge — mentoring others and living the VKB values
• Cross-marketing awesome VKB products and promotions
• Collaborating with internal teams, suppliers and clients
• Tackling daily ad hoc tasks with a smile
Why VKB?
Because here, you’re not just fixing machines — you’re keeping agriculture moving. You’ll be part of a team that supports you, challenges you, and celebrates your wins.

POSITION PURPOSE
TO PROVIDE ON-SITE FACILITIES ADMINISTRATION AND OPERATIONAL COORDINATION AT THE HENSOLDT PREMISES. THE POSITION SUPPORTS THE CLIENT’S ADMINISTRATIVE REQUIREMENTS, STRENGTHENS THE WORKING RELATIONSHIP WITH THE CLIENT, COORDINATES CONTRACTORS AND SUPPLIERS, MANAGES SECURITY ACCESS, MONITORS PLANNED PREVENTATIVE MAINTENANCE, CONTROLS QUOTATION AND APPROVAL WORKFLOWS, SUPPORTS ACCURATE MONTHLY INVOICING AND PROVIDES MONTHLY BUDGET REPORTING.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES
1. Provide dedicated on-site facilities administration support to Hensoldt, maintain constructive working relationships with the client, keep accurate records and provide timely feedback on agreed actions.
2. Coordinate client administrative requests and communicate with contractors, suppliers, Broll teams and authorized Hensoldt representatives to resolve issues within agreed timeframes.
3. Manage contractors and suppliers through the Broll procurement and vetting processes and maintain required compliance information on the relevant Broll systems.
4. Manage contractors and supplier access to the Hensoldt site in accordance with the Hensoldt security process. Obtain and submit required access information and documentation, follow up on approvals, confirm access before attendance and maintain accurate access records.
5. Maintain and monitor the planned preventative maintenance schedule. Confirm service dates with suppliers, obtain Hensoldt security access approval before each scheduled date, notify the relevant client representative and follow up on completion records and outstanding actions.
6. Monitor open work instructions, obtain contractor feedback, update the relevant facilities management systems and provide regular status reports to contractors, technical managers and the client.
7. Obtain quotations for work requested by the client, confirm that each quotation addresses the required scope, submit it to the authorized client representative for approval, retain evidence of approval and schedule the approved supplier to complete the work.
8. Evaluate supplier costs with the Broll Procurement team and support value-for-money decisions while complying with approved procurement processes.
9. Manage the workflow between site operations, suppliers and Broll Finance to support monthly supplier payments.
10. Verify that every invoice pack is complete, accurate and supported by the approved quotation or purchase order, proof of work completed, client sign-off and all other required documentation. Submit complete invoice packs to Broll Finance within monthly cut-off dates and follow up on exceptions or rejected submissions.
11. Prepare and present monthly budget reports to the Hensoldt client. Reconcile actual expenditure, committed costs, approved quotations and outstanding invoices against the approved budget, identify variances and financial risks, and provide supporting explanations and follow-up actions.
12. Manage site data and spreadsheets, promptly report service irregularities, and keep the client and Broll team informed of operational or financial risks.
13. Ensure that equipment replacement, site handovers and related supporting processes are completed in accordance with approved Broll and Hensoldt requirements.
14. Keep contractors and suppliers informed of Hensoldt site requirements, security access procedures, planned work, documentation standards, invoice submission requirements and changes to Broll processes or client instructions.
15. Apply Broll policies and procedures to maintain governance and compliance, and participate in relevant workshops, training, meetings and communications.
PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS
Performance will be measured against the client SLA and agreed service standards, including the accuracy and timeliness of administrative support, client feedback, contractor access arranged before scheduled work, planned preventative maintenance completed as scheduled, quotations submitted and approved without avoidable delay, complete invoice packs delivered to Broll Finance by the monthly cut-off, supplier payment exceptions resolved, and monthly budget reports provided accurately and on time.
Annual increases are based on the increase our client provides to the contract and will then be up to the performance of each individual as to Broll performance KPI.

job_title: APEX Graduate Programme 2027 - Future Leaders Accelerator
about_role:
About APEX
What if your first job was designed to accelerate you towards your future?
APEX is Lesaka’s Future Leaders Accelerator, designed for exceptional graduates who want more than a traditional graduate programme.
From Day 1, you will be a permanent Lesaka employee with real responsibilities, a role in the business and opportunities to work on meaningful challenges.
Over 18 months, you will build your professional, functional, commercial and leadership capability while gaining exposure to one of Africa’s leading fintech businesses.
What you can expect
Real responsibility from Day 1
You will have a permanent role, a line manager and real business deliverables.
Go beyond your function
Gain exposure to Lesaka’s businesses, customers, markets and operations across different functions and geographies.
Work with senior leaders
Engage with executives and work on strategic business challenges that matter to Lesaka.
Build AI and technology capability
You won't just learn about AI. You will identify opportunities to use AI and technology to improve productivity, automate work, enhance customer experiences and solve business problems.
Develop as a future leader
Build capability in commercial thinking, strategic thinking, influencing, communication, collaboration, leadership and personal effectiveness.
Make an impact
Your journey will culminate in an executive-sponsored business challenge and a recommendation presented to senior leadership, alongside a community/CSI contribution.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for exceptional people who have the potential to become future leaders, not simply candidates with strong academic results.
You should have:
• A minimum 75% academic average
• Relevant qualifications aligned to Technology, Finance, Operations
• Evidence of leadership – through university, work, community, entrepreneurial or other experiences
• Strong problem-solving and analytical ability
• A demonstrated desire to create impact and improve how things work
• Curiosity about technology, business and the future of financial services
• The ambition and adaptability to work across functions, businesses and environments  You do not need previous fintech experience. What matters is your potential, mindset, capability and what you have already demonstrated.
What are the roles?
TECHNOLOGY STREAM
• Cybersecurity Analyst – Secure 100+ million customer transactions daily
• Data Analyst – Unlock insights from fintech data at scale
• Developer / Business Analyst – Build the next generation of fintech solutions
• AI/Automation Engineer – Solve problems with AI. Identify automation opportunities.
• Security Operations Analyst – Protect Lesaka's systems and customer data FINANCE STREAM
• Group Accountant – Own accounting across the fintech ecosystem
• Finance Sales Analyst – Understand customer economics. Drive profitable growth.
• Junior Finance Analyst – Build financial discipline and commercial thinking
• Junior Insights Analyst – Turn data into business decisions
• Risk Analyst – Identify, measure, mitigate financial risk OPERATIONS STREAM
• Operations & Projects Graduate – Deliver complex cross-divisional projects
• Commercial Strategy Analyst – Shape Lesaka's competitive strategy
• Junior Commercial Decision Analyst – Make data-driven commercial decisions
• Fraud Risk Analyst – Protect customers. Detect and prevent fraud. Why Lesaka?
Lesaka operates at the intersection of financial services, technology and inclusion, serving consumers, merchants and businesses across our markets.
APEX gives you the opportunity to build your career while contributing to a business that is transforming how people and businesses participate in the economy.
This isn't about spending 18 months moving from one training session to another.
It's about doing real work, solving real problems, learning from exceptional people and building the capabilities to become a future leader.
Ready to build your future?
If you're ambitious, curious, driven to make an impact and ready to take on challenges beyond your current experience, we want to hear from you.
Apply for APEX 2027 and start building what comes next.
To complete your application for the Lesaka APEX Graduate Programme, please ensure that you submit the following documents:

• Academic transcript
• Copies of completed qualifications/certificates, where applicable.Please ensure that all required supporting documents are submitted with your application, as incomplete applications may not be considered. Final year students will be considered.

Oversee enterprise SIEM/SOC operations, manage EDR/XDR deployments, and lead end-to-end incident handling (triage, containment, root-cause analysis, forensic investigation, and post-incident reporting).

Coordinate continuous vulnerability identification and remediation workflows, track penetration testing action items, analyze attacker TTPs, and operationalize external threat intelligence into active defensive postures.

Map technical controls and provide audit assurance against recognized industry frameworks and regulatory mandates (including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and POPIA).

Act as a subject-matter expert across cross-functional engineering teams, drive enterprise security awareness and simulated phishing campaigns, and mentor cybersecurity interns and junior analysts.

The VKB Group is an agricultural company providing support to farmers and producing straight-from-the-farm foods for consumers. Apart from its various consumer brands, the VKB Group is also represented by its regional brands: VKB, GWK and NTK.
Our roots are firmly planted in agriculture, with farming at our core, continuously growing and evolving throughout the years. Position Overview
• Position Title: Assistant FOH Manager
• Department: Restaurants
• Division: Hospitality Division
• Reporting To: Senior FOH Manager
• Second Level Superior: Restaurant Manager
• Direct Reports: Waitrons (17), Bartenders (4), Runners (8), Hosts (2), Reservationists (1), Events & Sales Coordinator (1)
• Salary: R15 000 – R20 000 CTC per month
Role Summary
The Assistant Front of House (FOH) Manager is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the planning, organizing, training, and leadership necessary to achieve restaurant objectives in sales, cost management, employee retention, guest satisfaction, food and beverage quality, cleanliness, and sanitation. This role focuses on maintaining exceptional operational standards while building and leading an energized, cohesive service team.
Key Result Areas & Responsibilities
1. FOH Supervision & Operations (40% Allocation)
• Ensure all food and beverage offerings are consistently prepared and served in line with luxury service standards.
• Manage staff levels, wages, shift hours, and construct FOH rosters aligned with forecasted business volume to meet labor cost targets.
• Conduct ongoing training and professional development for FOH team members.
• Inspect and maintain all front-of-house equipment in proper working condition, following preventative maintenance schedules.
• Monitor daily breakages and waste, taking appropriate action to minimize loss.
• Administer fair, consistent, and prompt corrective actions for policy or procedural violations.
• Maintain productive relationships with key operational suppliers.
2. Guest Experience & Satisfaction (30% Allocation)
• Act as the primary point of contact for customer complaints, resolving issues swiftly and professionally.
• Foster strong, long-term relationships with regular guests, estate residents, and visitors.
• Ensure every guest receives responsive, warm, and attentive service across all dining touchpoints.
3. General Operations, Administration & Compliance (10% Allocation)
• Prepare all required operational paperwork, schedules, and management reports in an organized, timely manner.
• Possess strong math skills to manage POS operations and assist with floor coverage during peak operational periods.
• Collaborate with upper management on hiring, onboarding, and termination decisions.
• Apply core leadership principles: consider the whole business, take accountability, embody professional excellence, invite feedback, and apply lessons learned.
4. Stock, Reservations & Cash Management (12% Allocation)
• Stock Control (5%): Ensure adequate ordering and stock levels for operating equipment (OE) and beverages; verify receiving counts, track beverage pricing, and manage daily stock counts and variance reports.
• Reservations (4%): Oversee host and reservationist operations using DinePlan to maximize table seating and ensure precise booking execution.
• Cash Up & Handover (3%): Control cash and digital receipts via formal reconciliation processes and record detailed daily handovers.
5. Cleaning, Health & Safety (8% Allocation)
• Health & Safety (5%): Maintain full compliance with industry health, safety, and labor regulations across the facility.
• Hygiene & Maintenance (3%): Enforce strict cleaning rosters to keep the FOH environment scrupulously clean; manage cleaning detergent inventory and safe handling protocols.
